我们在掺杂的 Kitaev 蜂窝上构建了两个超导配对模型，其微观内核是推导的而不是假设的。两者均由偶数和奇数奇偶校验配对通道之间的键局部胶中性驱动；手性-宇称连接是由星键几何结构决定的，而不是由微观胶水决定的。 (i) Model~1（奇宇称扇区）：内核遵循纯模型的通量扇区选择规则，固定其分量对角、最近邻可分离、每键秩一的形式，其中 $w_\alpha=J_K^2\chi_\alpha\propto r_\alpha m_\alpha$，其中 $m_\alpha$ 遵循 Hellmann-Feynman 定理， $r_\alpha\simeq0.24$ 是通过数值计算的。自旋顶点态是具有键锁各向异性 $\mathbf d$ 向量的酉三重态；它的间隙是键正弦的克和，因此节点方向由几何形状固定。 (ii) Model~2(even)：内核由区域角手性声子的 $C_3$ 小群选择规则固定，直到我们明确声明其动量约束的库珀通道扩展。

电荷-顶点配对是 $d+id$ 单线态：奇偶分解 $f_\pm=g_\pm+p_\pm$ 投影到 $g_\pm$ 上，因此手性受声子极化影响，$C=\pm4$ 和 $\kappa_{xy}/T=2\kappa_0$。反转泵螺旋度会反转陈数、克尔旋转和热霍尔符号。 (iii) 一般定理：在奇数重键星上，单星手性形状因子的角动量阶梯以宇称交替。由这种键局域形状因子选择的每个手性态都是几何上强制的具有通用振幅比的单重态-三重态复合材料（$n=3$：$d\oplus p$；$n=5$：$g\oplus p$ 或 $d\oplus f$）；相干双星组合可以恢复宇称纯度。混合态的陈数遵循跨拓扑边界的主要壳层成分。旋转胶驱动$C=\pm2$；收费内核$C=\pm4$。

title: Translational and rotational irreversibility in cyclically sheared colloidal suspensions
abstract: We investigate the translational and rotational dynamics of cyclically sheared suspensions over a broad range of particle concentrations. The transition to an irreversible state is studied using a custom confocal-rheometer and colloidal particles synthesized with chemically identical smooth and lobed surfaces. The particle trajectories and rotations are tracked in three dimensions to reveal enhanced effective diffusivities that exhibit flow induced anisotropy that depends on particle concentration and particle morphology. We show that within the irreversible state, the shear induced anisotropy is determined by interparticle friction and interlocking mechanisms that promote mixing and enforce rotational isotropy.
summary: 我们研究了广泛颗粒浓度范围内循环剪切悬浮液的平移和旋转动力学。使用定制的共焦流变仪和化学性质相同的光滑和叶形表面合成的胶体颗粒研究了向不可逆状态的转变。在三个维度上跟踪颗粒轨迹和旋转，以揭示增强的有效扩散率，该扩散率表现出取决于颗粒浓度和颗粒形态的流动引起的各向异性。我们表明，在不可逆状态下，剪切引起的各向异性是由颗粒间摩擦和促进混合并强制旋转各向同性的联锁机制决定的。

title: Hydrodynamics of perceptual matter: from neural representations to collective motion
abstract: How do neural representations of neighbors become collective material behavior? Harmonic Theory (HT) reduces bearing representations to signed perceptual channels traceable to sensory acuity, decision dynamics, and interaction distance. Here we derive a nonlocal kinetic and hydrodynamic theory from the HT particle law without introducing heading alignment. The resulting fields retain HT's order-resolved perceptual spectrum and keep the neural and sensory origin of each coefficient visible. The theory predicts a torque-driven density instability: HT's direct-approach channel turns agents toward density excesses, while self-propulsion carries them inward. For isotropic spatial interactions and positive rotational diffusion, perceptual channel $n$ generically first affects conserved density at spatial order $k^{2n}$, and the full radial transforms select finite pattern wavelengths. Two populations can share the same long-wave instability threshold yet select different initial pattern spacings because their higher perceptual channels differ. Beyond onset, the one-particle continuum sustains a bidirectional nematic column; a prescribed, symmetry-allowed two-stream response amplifies a directional imbalance into sustained polar flow. In a distinct pure-repulsion regime, one-particle calculations show polar transport and translating transverse bands, with late pattern selection sensitive to numerical transport. The framework connects neural and sensory mechanisms to continuum coefficients, instabilities, and alignment-free collective motion.
summary:
邻居的神经表征如何成为集体物质行为？调和理论 (HT) 将方位表征简化为有符号的感知通道，可追溯到感觉敏锐度、决策动态和交互距离。在这里，我们从 HT 粒子定律推导出非局域动力学和流体动力学理论，而不引入航向对齐。由此产生的场保留了 HT 的顺序解析感知谱，并保持每个系数的神经和感觉起源可见。该理论预测了扭矩驱动的密度不稳定：HT 的直接接近通道将介质转向密度过高的方向，而自推进则将它们带入内部。对于各向同性空间相互作用和正旋转扩散，感知通道 $n$ 通常首先影响空间阶 $k^{2n}$ 的守恒密度，并且全径向变换选择有限图案波长。两个群体可以共享相同的长波不稳定性阈值，但选择不同的初始图案间距，因为它们的更高感知通道不同。

除了起始点之外，单粒子连续体还维持双向向列柱；规定的、允许对称的双流响应将方向不平衡放大为持续的极流。在独特的纯排斥状态下，单粒子计算显示极性输运和平移横带，并且后期模式选择对数值输运敏感。该框架将神经和感觉机制与连续系数、不稳定性和无对齐集体运动联系起来。

title: Pairing order and condensate fraction across the BCS-BEC crossover in the two-dimensional attractive Hubbard model
abstract: We report a systematic study of the superconducting ground state in the two-dimensional attractive Hubbard model, employing the {\it numerically exact} auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo method. We focus primarily on the pairing order and condensate fraction across the BCS-BEC crossover. Our numerical calculations cover a broad and physically relevant parameter regime, with the interaction strength $U/t=2\sim 12$ (where $t$ is the nearest-neighbor hopping amplitude) and fermion density $n=0.25\sim 1.0$. We systematically characterize the dependence of the pairing order and condensate fraction on both the interaction strength and fermion density, and perform finite-size extrapolations to obtain their thermodynamic-limit values. As complementary quantities, we also provide high-precision numerical results for the double occupancy and total energy. Furthermore, we investigate the effects of next-nearest-neighbor hopping on the superconducting properties of the model. Our results offer a comprehensive set of unbiased numerical data for the attractive Hubbard model, establishing quantitative benchmarks for understanding superconductivity across the BCS-BEC crossover and for validating future theoretical and numerical approaches.
summary:
我们报告了对二维吸引哈伯德模型中超导基态的系统研究，采用{\它在数值上精确}辅助场量子蒙特卡罗方法。我们主要关注 BCS-BEC 交叉的配对顺序和冷凝分数。我们的数值计算涵盖了广泛且物理相关的参数范围，相互作用强度 $U/t=2\sim 12$ （其中 $t$ 是最近邻跳跃幅度）和费米子密度 $n=0.25\sim 1.0$。我们系统地描述了配对顺序和凝聚态分数对相互作用强度和费米子密度的依赖性，并进行有限尺寸外推以获得它们的热力学极限值。作为补充量，我们还提供双人入住和总能量的高精度数值结果。此外，我们研究了次近邻跳跃对模型超导特性的影响。

我们的结果为有吸引力的哈伯德模型提供了一套全面的无偏数值数据，为理解 BCS-BEC 交叉的超导性以及验证未来的理论和数值方法建立了定量基准。

title: Disorder-driven loss of crystalline coherence in two-dimensional electron solids: Quantum Hartree-Fock and classical molecular dynamics
abstract: We investigate the effects of quenched disorder on two-dimensional electron solids using Hartree-Fock theory and classical molecular dynamics. Increasing disorder weakens crystalline correlations, broadens the structure factor, and reduces the measured coherence length toward the pristine lattice spacing. This evolution is consistent with the Imry-Ma and Larkin picture: random pinning disrupts translational order on sufficiently long scales, and stronger disorder reduces the distance over which crystalline organization survives. Classical simulations further show that stronger pinning raises the temperature for particle rearrangement even after crystalline order has disappeared. Disorder thus suppresses structural coherence while stabilizing an amorphous solid against thermal rearrangement.
summary: 我们使用 Hartree-Fock 理论和经典分子动力学研究了猝灭无序对二维电子固体的影响。无序度的增加会削弱晶体相关性，扩大结构因子，并减少测量到的原始晶格间距的相干长度。这种演化与 Imry-Ma 和 Larkin 的图景一致：随机钉扎破坏了足够长尺度上的平移顺序，而更强的无序性则缩短了晶体组织存活的距离。经典模拟进一步表明，即使在晶序消失后，更强的钉扎也会提高粒子重排的温度。因此，无序抑制了结构相干性，同时稳定了无定形固体以防止热重排。

title: Exact vortex decomposition of the shift current
abstract: Does any integer survive in the shift current, and does the Chern number control its sign? We show that the shift vector is a singular field on the Brillouin torus. Its curl has two sources: the interband Berry curvature and quantised point charges at the zeros of the transition dipole. Inverting this relation gives an exact decomposition of the shift conductivity, valid at every frequency, into one sector linear in the integer charges and three continuous sectors. As a testing ground, we take a graphene-Haldane bilayer: a model that lets us sweep the interband Chern number through five values at fixed gap to isolate its role. We also test the formalism against the time-reversal-symmetric biased AB bilayer. Whenever a charge sits at the band edge, and trigonal warping is present, the integer sector alone accounts for the band-edge peak. The relevant integer is not the Chern number but the winding of that single charge. Its sign, combined with a valley-dependent profile, sets the sign of the photocurrent. In these bilayers, sign reversals across topological transitions follow this winding; the invariant changes with it only when the same gap closing does both. A band-edge charge needs no invariant. It only requires that the two band-edge sublattices not be connected by the nearest-neighbour hopping, and trigonal warping makes it visible.
summary:
移位电流中是否存在任何整数，并且陈数是否控制其符号？我们证明移位向量是布里渊环面上的奇异场。它的旋度有两个来源：带间贝里曲率和过渡偶极子零点处的量子化点电荷。反转这一关系可以将在每个频率都有效的位移电导率精确分解为一个与整数电荷呈线性关系的扇区和三个连续扇区。作为测试场，我们采用石墨烯-Haldane 双层：该模型让我们能够以固定间隙将带间陈数扫过五个值，以隔离其作用。我们还针对时间反转对称偏置 AB 双层测试了形式主义。每当电荷位于能带边缘并且存在三角扭曲时，整数扇区就单独解释了能带边缘峰值。相关的整数不是陈数，而是单个电荷的绕组。它的符号与谷值相关的轮廓相结合，设定了光电流的符号。在这些双层中，拓扑转变中的符号反转遵循这种缠绕；仅当相同的间隙闭合同时满足两者时，不变量才会随之改变。

带边电荷不需要不变量。它只要求两个带边子晶格不通过最近邻跳跃连接，并且三角翘曲使其可见。

title: Quantum spectral thermodynamics and active learning enable million-scale exploration of high-entropy ceramics
abstract: Understanding phase stability and navigating vast compositional spaces in multicomponent solids remain central challenges in solid-state chemistry. Here, we develop a quantum spectral thermodynamic framework connecting interaction-induced phonon spectral broadening to free energy, alongside an uncertainty-guided active-learning workflow that explores 7.7 million high-entropy ceramic configurations at density-functional-theory fidelity, achieving a $10^5$-fold acceleration. We show that phonon self-energy effects arising from chemical disorder provide an intrinsic vibrational contribution to thermodynamic stabilization beyond ideal configurational entropy, compensating unfavorable mixing enthalpies and suppressing phase separation. Across the chemical space, we uncover a robust ~12 at.% solute threshold separating strengthening and softening regimes, associated with the filling of metal-carbon antibonding states. Chemical disorder further enables an unusual combination of high-temperature mechanical stiffness and low thermal conductivity, together with anomalous temperature-dependent lattice heat transport. This work establishes a quantum spectral foundation for connecting many-body interactions to thermodynamics and phase stability, while providing a scalable framework for exploring previously inaccessible multicomponent chemical spaces.
summary:
了解相稳定性并探索多组分固体中广阔的组成空间仍然是固态化学的核心挑战。在这里，我们开发了一个量子光谱热力学框架，将相互作用引起的声子光谱展宽与自由能联系起来，以及不确定性引导的主动学习工作流程，以密度泛函理论保真度探索 770 万种高熵陶瓷配置，实现了 10^5 美元倍的加速。我们表明，化学无序产生的声子自能效应为热力学稳定提供了超越理想构型熵的内在振动贡献，补偿了不利的混合焓并抑制了相分离。在整个化学空间中，我们发现了一个强大的 ~12 at.% 溶质阈值，将强化和软化状态分开，与金属-碳反键合状态的填充相关。化学无序进一步实现了高温机械刚度和低导热率的不寻常组合，以及异常的温度依赖性晶格热传输。

这项工作为将多体相互作用与热力学和相稳定性联系起来建立了量子光谱基础，同时为探索以前无法访问的多组分化学空间提供了可扩展的框架。

title: General boundary conditions for the quasiclassical kinetic equations in the presence of magnetism and unconventional superconductivity
abstract: We present boundary conditions for the quasiclassical Green's functions describing spin active interfaces between two materials, at least one of which is in the diffusive regime. These boundary conditions are developed with the help of the action formalism, and provide clean and easily tractable expressions. We connect our expressions to previous literature in limiting cases and describe normal transport, magneto-resistance transport and spin-precession through the bound ary. By using the Keldysh-Nambu-spin formalism, our equations are valid both in the normal and superconducting state. The construction through the action formalism also allows us to derive the corresponding full counting statistics for charge currents, thermal currents and spin currents. We use this boundary condition to consider the anomalous proximity effect, and to study the Josephson coupling between triplet and spin-split superconductors through a magnetic interface. We find an analytic expression for the zero bias conductance in junctions with a p-wave superconductor and a spin-filter, and show how it depends on the relative orientation of the exchange field and d-vector. For Josephson junctions, we show that, in agreement with time-reversal symmetry, the conditions on the relative orientations of the spins in the materials for the appearance of anomalous Josephson currents, are distinctly different for two spin-split superconductors and a spin-split superconductor with a triplet superconductor. Moreover, we show that the anomalous Josephson currents are only accompanied by a diode effect if both transparencies for spin up and down are nonzero and distinct.
summary:
我们提出了准经典格林函数的边界条件，描述了两种材料之间的自旋活性界面，至少其中一种材料处于扩散状态。这些边界条件是在动作形式主义的帮助下开发的，并提供干净且易于处理的表达式。我们将我们的表达式与限制情况下的先前文献联系起来，并描述了通过边界的正常传输、磁阻传输和自旋进动。通过使用 Keldysh-Nambu-spin 形式，我们的方程在正常状态和超导状态下都有效。通过动作形式主义的构建还使我们能够推导出充电电流、热电流和自旋电流相应的完整计数统计数据。我们使用这个边界条件来考虑反常邻近效应，并通过磁界面研究三重态和自旋分裂超导体之间的约瑟夫森耦合。我们找到了 p 波超导体和自旋滤波器结点中零偏置电导的解析表达式，并展示了它如何依赖于交换场和 d 向量的相对方向。

对于约瑟夫森结，我们表明，与时间反转对称性一致，材料中自旋相对方向的条件对于两个自旋分裂超导体和具有三重态超导体的自旋分裂超导体来说，出现反常约瑟夫森电流是明显不同的。此外，我们表明，如果向上和向下旋转的透明度均非零且不同，则异常约瑟夫森电流仅伴随二极管效应。

title: Self-assembly Monte Carlo reveals localized entanglement in giant polymer melts
abstract: Topological entanglements are central to understanding and predicting the properties of polymer melts. Yet, they make equilibrium sampling computationally challenging, as decorrelation times grow rapidly with chain length. Here, we introduce a Monte Carlo scheme that bypasses typical computational bottlenecks by working in a self-assembly ensemble rather than at fixed composition. Strictly local moves efficiently propagate backbone reconnections across scales while conserving the number of linear chains, achieving near-linear scaling of decorrelation time with system size, $\tau_{\rm eq}\sim V^{1.0}$. With this method, formulated for a fully-packed lattice, we equilibrate periodic systems totalling up to $\simeq 1.1\times 10^9$ monomers, accessing a universal melt regime insensitive to lattice details. We analyze intra- and inter-chain entanglements for chains of up to $N\simeq 5 \times 10^5$ monomers, revealing that they manifest as localized knots and links rather than as global tangles. Finally, we show that the magnitude of the Gauss linking integral between neighbouring chains grows only as $N^{1/4}$.
summary: 拓扑纠缠对于理解和预测聚合物熔体的性能至关重要。然而，它们使平衡采样在计算上具有挑战性，因为去相关时间随着链长度而快速增长。在这里，我们引入了一种蒙特卡洛方案，该方案通过在自组装集成中而不是在固定组合中工作来绕过典型的计算瓶颈。严格局部移动有效地跨尺度传播主干重连接，同时保留线性链的数量，实现解相关时间随系统大小 $\tau_{\rm eq}\sim V^{1.0}$ 的近线性缩放。通过这种针对全堆积晶格制定的方法，我们平衡了总计高达 $\simeq 1.1\times 10^9$ 单体的周期系统，从而获得了对晶格细节不敏感的通用熔化状态。我们分析了最多 $N\simeq 5 \times 10^5$ 单体的链内和链间缠结，揭示它们表现为局部结和链接，而不是全局缠结。最后，我们表明相邻链之间的高斯链接积分的大小仅以 $N^{1/4}$ 的形式增长。

title: Dynamical Valence Fluctuations and Magnetic Anisotropy in Sm(Co,Cu)$_5$
abstract: The magnetic properties of Sm-based intermetallics are governed by a delicate interplay between localized $4f$ states, exchange interactions, and valence fluctuations, yet the role of dynamical $4f$ correlations remains poorly understood. Here we investigate the electronic structure and magnetic anisotropy of SmCo$_5$ and SmCu$_5$ using self-consistent DFT+$U$(ED), which explicitly treats dynamical fluctuations of the Sm $4f$ shell. We find that SmCo$_5$ exhibits pronounced Sm$^{2+}$--Sm$^{3+}$ valence fluctuations, with the $4f$ ground state dominated by $f^5$ and $f^6$ configurations. The resulting dynamical $4f$ correlations yield near compensation of the Sm spin and orbital moments and provide a quantitative description of the electronic structure, magnetic moments, and large uniaxial magnetic anisotropy of SmCo$_5$. Upon replacing Co with Cu, the balance shifts toward the $f^6$ configuration, with substantial changes in the Sm spin and orbital moments. In SmCu$_5$, this evolution of the $4f$ configuration is accompanied by a pronounced reduction of both the total magnetic moment and magnetic anisotropy. These results demonstrate that dynamical $4f$ valence fluctuations are essential for understanding the contrasting magnetic properties of SmCo$_5$ and SmCu$_5$ and provide a microscopic framework for describing magnetic anisotropy upon Co to Cu substitution in Sm(Co,Cu)$_5$.
summary:
Sm 基金属间化合物的磁性受局部 $4f$ 态、交换相互作用和价态波动之间微妙的相互作用控制，但动态 $4f$ 相关性的作用仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用自洽 DFT+$U$(ED) 研究 SmCo$_5$ 和 SmCu$_5$ 的电子结构和磁各向异性，明确处理 Sm $4f$ 壳层的动态涨落。我们发现 SmCo$_5$ 表现出明显的 Sm$^{2+}$--Sm$^{3+}$ 价态波动，其中 $4f$ 基态由 $f^5$ 和 $f^6$ 配置主导。由此产生的动态 $4f$ 相关性产生了 Sm 自旋和轨道矩的近似补偿，并提供了 SmCo$_5$ 的电子结构、磁矩和大单轴磁各向异性的定量描述。用 Cu 取代 Co 后，平衡转向 $f^6$ 配置，Sm 自旋和轨道矩发生显着变化。在 SmCu$_5$ 中，$4f$ 配置的演变伴随着总磁矩和磁各向异性的显着降低。

这些结果表明，动态 $4f$ 价态波动对于理解 SmCo$_5$ 和 SmCu$_5$ 的对比磁性至关重要，并为描述 Sm(Co,Cu)$_5$ 中 Co 取代 Cu 时的磁各向异性提供了微观框架。

title: Confined Riesz gas: From Newtonian Dynamics to Emergent Hydrodynamics
abstract: We investigate the real-time dynamics of the Riesz gas (RG), a paradigmatic system of particles with power-law interactions that encapsulates several many-body interacting classical systems. While the equilibrium properties of the system have been extensively studied the connection between microscopic dynamics, macroscopic evolution and thermalization has remained largely unexplored. Combining extensive large-scale Newtonian simulations with a hydrodynamic framework formulated in terms of three coarse grained fields -- density, velocity, and temperature -- we establish a direct and quantitative correspondence between the two descriptions. The hydrodynamic theory incorporates two phenomenological transport coefficients, the bulk viscosity $\xi$ and thermal conductivity $\kappa$, which encode dissipative effects at a macroscopic level. By analyzing representative classes of initial conditions, such as dome-like and Newton-cradle-type profiles, we find excellent agreement between microscopic and hydrodynamic evolution over a broad range of timescales, starting from relatively early all the way up to times at which steady state is attained. Notably, this agreement persists across a substantial window of $\xi$ and $\kappa$, demonstrating the robustness of the emergent hydrodynamic description. Our results provide a systematic validation of hydrodynamics in the RG and establish a concrete bridge between Newtonian dynamics and continuum theories in systems with power-law interactions, starting from first principles.
summary:
我们研究了里斯气体（RG）的实时动力学，这是一种具有幂律相互作用的粒子范式系统，封装了几个多体相互作用的经典系统。虽然系统的平衡特性已被广泛研究，但微观动力学、宏观演化和热化之间的联系在很大程度上仍未得到探索。将广泛的大规模牛顿模拟与根据三个粗粒场（密度、速度和温度）制定的流体动力学框架相结合，我们在这两种描述之间建立了直接和定量的对应关系。流体动力学理论结合了两个现象学传输系数，即体积粘度 $\xi$ 和导热系数 $\kappa$，它们在宏观层面上编码耗散效应。通过分析代表性的初始条件类别，例如圆顶状和牛顿摇篮型剖面，我们发现在广泛的时间尺度上，从相对早期开始一直到达到稳态的时间，微观演化和流体动力学演化之间具有极好的一致性。

值得注意的是，这一一致性在 $\xi$ 和 $\kappa$ 的相当大的窗口中持续存在，证明了新兴流体动力学描述的稳健性。我们的结果为 RG 中的流体动力学提供了系统验证，并从第一原理开始，在具有幂律相互作用的系统中的牛顿动力学和连续介质理论之间建立了一座具体的桥梁。

title: Interacting quantum criticality with U(1) symmetry breaking in 1+1 dimensions
abstract: The Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner theorem motivates the expectation that continuous symmetries remain unbroken in one-dimensional quantum ground states. Here, contrary to this expectation, we demonstrate the spontaneous breaking of U(1) spin-rotation symmetry and the emergence of an interacting quantum critical point in lattice spin-$1/2$ and spin-$1$ chains. Using subsystem Binder scaling, we locate the critical point and determine the correlation-length critical exponent as $\nu = 0.60 \pm 0.02$, distinct from the Gaussian value $0.5$ but consistent with the perturbative renormalization-group prediction. We further analyze the finite-size scaling of the lowest neutral excitation gap and obtain the dynamical critical exponent $z=1.986 \pm 0.005$. The result $z < 2$ is incompatible with microscopic realizations of this critical theory by frustration-free models, implying a mechanism for continuous symmetry breaking in one-dimensional quantum ground states distinct from frustration freeness.
summary: 霍恩伯格-梅明-瓦格纳定理激发了人们的期望，即在一维量子基态中连续对称性保持不破缺。在这里，与这种预期相反，我们证明了 U(1) 自旋旋转对称性的自发破缺以及晶格自旋 $1/2$ 和自旋 $1$ 链中相互作用量子临界点的出现。使用子系统 Binder 缩放，我们定位临界点并将相关长度临界指数确定为 $\nu = 0.60 \pm 0.02$，与高斯值 $0.5$ 不同，但与扰动重整化群预测一致。我们进一步分析了最低中性激励间隙的有限尺寸缩放，并获得动态临界指数 $z=1.986 \pm 0.005$。结果 $z < 2$ 与无挫败模型对这一关键理论的微观实现不相容，这意味着一维量子基态中连续对称破缺的机制与无挫败性不同。

title: Strain tunability of electron and hole g-factors in CsPb$X_3$: bulk and nanocrystals
abstract: In this paper, we theoretically study the electron and hole $g$-factors in inorganic lead-halide perovskites for the reference cubic phase. We employ an 18-band $k \cdot p$ model and determine its parameters using target band structures obtained from DFT calculations. We use the linear response theory to calculate the $g$-factors and investigate their dependence on external strain. We then perform real-space calculations of the electron and hole $g$-factors in perovskite nanocrystals. We show that the bulk $g$-factors can be tuned over a wide range by external strain. In some cases, strain can be used to tune the $g$-factor through zero. By contrast, the carrier $g$-factors in CsPb$X_3$ nanocrystals are considerably less sensitive to strain due to quantum confinement.
summary: 在本文中，我们从理论上研究了参考立方相的无机卤化铅钙钛矿中的电子和空穴 $g$ 因子。我们采用 18 频带 $k \cdot p$ 模型，并使用从 DFT 计算获得的目标能带结构确定其参数。我们使用线性响应理论来计算 $g$ 因子并研究它们对外部应变的依赖性。然后，我们对钙钛矿纳米晶体中的电子和空穴 $g$ 因子进行实空间计算。我们表明，大量的 $g$ 因子可以通过外部应变在很宽的范围内进行调整。在某些情况下，应变可用于将 $g$ 因子调整为零。相比之下，由于量子限制，CsPb$X_3$ 纳米晶体中的载流子 $g$ 因子对应变的敏感度要低得多。

title: Imaginary magnetic fields for ultracold atoms
abstract: We propose a four-level scheme for generating a uniform imaginary magnetic field for ultracold atoms using Raman coupling and state-dependent particle losses. Eliminating two lossy auxiliary states and subsequently projecting onto one of the two remaining Raman dressed atomic states, the atomic motion is affected by an imaginary vector potential with a constant curl corresponding to a spatially uniform imaginary synthetic magnetic field. We analytically derive the Gaussian wavepacket dynamics for atoms in such a synthetic magnetic field and study the width-dependent transport, which is unique to non-Hermitian systems. We find numerical agreement between the two-level non-Hermitian Hamiltonian and the adiabatic projection description, confirming the applicability of the latter adiabatic approach.
summary: 我们提出了一种四级方案，利用拉曼耦合和状态相关的粒子损失为超冷原子生成均匀的虚磁场。消除两个有损辅助态并随后投影到剩余的两个拉曼修饰原子态之一上，原子运动受到虚矢量势的影响，该虚矢量势具有与空间均匀的虚合成磁场相对应的恒定旋度。我们分析推导了这种合成磁场中原子的高斯波包动力学，并研究了非厄米系统所独有的宽度相关输运。我们发现两级非厄米哈密顿量和绝热投影描述之间的数值一致，证实了后者绝热方法的适用性。

title: Supplementary Notes on VOA and 2D SCFT
abstract: Sections 2--3 of this note were prepared primarily for the author's private use, as a means of organizing the materials in (generally non-holomorphic) conformal field theory (CFT) on 2-dimensions in the language of the vertex operator algebra, and also of collecting subtle details. The choice of topics is intended to supplement introductory physics textbooks on the subject. Section 4 deals with (generally non-holomorphic) Type 0 CFTs in the language of vertex operator superalgebra (SVOA). Formulations of crossing symmetry and intertwining superoperators [resp. CFT vertex superoperators] of states in the Ramond (SVOA-twisted) sector [resp. the Ramond--Ramond sector] are presented by using two auxiliary parameters. The formulation allows systematic generalization to the class of simple current extensions characterized by four conditions: (1) the vanishing third cohomology, (2) skew-symmetric bimultiplicative form, (3) fixed-point-free action of simple currents, and (4) one additional condition described in the main text.
summary: 本说明的第 2--3 节主要是为作者个人使用而准备的，作为用顶点算子代数语言组织二维（通常是非全纯）共形场论 (CFT) 材料的一种手段，也是收集微妙细节的一种手段。主题的选择旨在补充该主题的入门物理教科书。第 4 节使用顶点算子超代数 (SVOA) 语言处理（通常是非全纯的）0 型 CFT。交叉对称性和交织超级算子的公式[分别。 Ramond（SVOA 扭曲）扇区各州的 CFT 顶点超级运营商] Ramond--Ramond 扇区]通过使用两个辅助参数来呈现。该公式允许系统地推广到由四个条件表征的简单电流扩展类别：（1）消失的第三上同调，（2）斜对称双乘形式，（3）简单电流的无定点作用，以及（4）正文中描述的一个附加条件。

title: Comment on ''Chiral electromagnetic surface waves on Chern-Simons interfaces'' Phys.Rev.D114(2026)L051903 and on arXiv:2606.12513 by N. Kaloper
abstract: We demonstrate that Maxwell electrodynamics interacting with a planar Chern-Simons interface does not have plane wave solutions localized on the interface. We re-examine the derivation of such waves presented by N. Kaloper in [Phys.Rev.D114(2026)L051903] and show that at an intermediate step certain terms were missed in an equation therein. Taking these terms into account changes the final conclusion of [Phys.Rev.D114(2026)L051903]. We also show that the method used in [ arXiv:2606.12513 [hep-th]] to reproduce the same result is not consistent.
summary: 我们证明了与平面 Chern-Simons 界面相互作用的麦克斯韦电动力学在界面上没有局域化的平面波解。我们重新检查了 N. Kaloper 在 [Phys.Rev.D114(2026)L051903] 中提出的此类波的推导，并表明在中间步骤中方程中遗漏了某些项。考虑这些术语会改变 [Phys.Rev.D114(2026)L051903] 的最终结论。我们还表明，[ arXiv:2606.12513 [hep-th]] 中使用的重现相同结果的方法并不一致。

title: Complex Worldline Instantons in (Anti-)de Sitter Space
abstract: We study complex saddle points of the worldline path integral for massive charged particles in two-dimensional maximally symmetric backgrounds threaded by homogeneous electric fields. Within the worldline formalism, we show that the semiclassical saddles generically require complexifying both the target spacetime and the proper-time parameter. The resulting solutions comprise two slices of a single complex family, distinguished by the direction of proper-time evolution. The one evolving in imaginary proper time carries an action that typically controls the exponential suppression of non-perturbative effects, while that evolving in real proper time may encode additional complex phases responsible for quantum interference between saddles. Treating this family as a whole, we give a prescription for constructing and classifying all topologically inequivalent instanton sectors, and we find that the worldline action depends only on their topological data, namely winding numbers around the compact directions and certain isolated punctures. Moreover, in Anti-de Sitter spacetime, the qualitative structure of the solutions is governed by the dimensionless ratio $R |eE|/m$ ($R$ being the curvature radius), which distinguishes sub-extremal, extremal, and super-extremal regimes. By contrast, no analogous distinction occurs in de Sitter---where the instantons are insensitive to this ratio---or in Minkowski spacetime, which lacks a curvature scale altogether. We also recast the action as a sum over residues of the relevant (non-conserved) conjugate momentum, making transparent which analytic data control each contribution. Finally, we discuss the subtleties that arise when solutions built in various local patches are lifted to global (Anti-)de Sitter space. These impose further necessary conditions on which saddles can in principle contribute to the one-loop path integral.
summary:
我们研究由均匀电场穿过的二维最大对称背景中大量带电粒子的世界线路径积分的复杂鞍点。在世界线形式主义中，我们表明半经典鞍座通常需要复杂化目标时空和固有时间参数。由此产生的解决方案包含一个复杂族的两个部分，通过适当时间演化的方向来区分。在假想的适当时间演化的一个动作通常控制非微扰效应的指数抑制，而在真实的适当时间演化的则可能编码负责鞍座之间的量子干涉的附加复杂相位。将这个家族视为一个整体，我们给出了构建和分类所有拓扑不等价瞬时子扇区的处方，并且我们发现世界线行为仅取决于它们的拓扑数据，即围绕紧致方向和某些孤立穿刺的缠绕数。

此外，在反德西特时空中，解的定性结构由无量纲比率$R |eE|/m$（$R$是曲率半径）控制，它区分次极值、极值和超极值状态。相比之下，在德西特（瞬子对此比率不敏感）或完全缺乏曲率尺度的闵可夫斯基时空中，没有发生类似的区别。我们还将该作用重新定义为相关（非保守）共轭动量的残差之和，从而使分析数据控制每个贡献变得透明。最后，我们讨论将各种本地补丁中构建的解决方案提升到全局（反）德西特空间时出现的微妙之处。这些施加了进一步的必要条件，鞍点原则上可以对单环路径积分做出贡献。

title: Magnetic Higher-Form Symmetries as Dual Fundamental $\infty$-Groupoids
abstract: We develop a higher-geometric framework for magnetic higher-form symmetries of pre-quantum field theories. The magnetic (topological) charges of a sigma-model with stacky target are encoded by the shape of the target, equivalently of its stack of fields, which is op-dual to the flat automorphism group controlling electric symmetries. Magnetic symmetry backgrounds are obtained by dualizing these charges against a chosen moduli stack of topological field theories, generalizing Pontryagin duality, and act on the theory by stacking. Cohesive modalities allow for targets with non-finite and non-discrete data. When the dualizing stack is a grouplike $E_\infty$-object, we prove a fibration theorem expressing the magnetic symmetries of an electrically gauged theory in terms of those of the ungauged theory and of the gauge group, computed by a homotopy-fixed-point spectral sequence with an explicit first page. For moduli stacks of higher $U(1)$-gerbes with connection, encoding bulk topological local Lagrangians, we prove a factorization theorem: the magnetic symmetry backgrounds of any connected target split, non-canonically, into Pontryagin duals of its integral homology groups, and are necessarily flat, as a consequence of dualizing discrete charges against a target with connections. We illustrate both theorems with pure $\mathrm{Pin}^\pm(2)$ gauge theory: $O(2)$ carries invertible magnetic $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetries in form degrees $d-3$, $d-4$ and $d-5$ that are absent for $\mathrm{Pin}^-(2)$, the first two distinguished by a single differential of the spectral sequence. Gauging and physical applications are developed in upcoming work.
summary:
我们为前量子场论的磁高级形式对称性开发了一个更高的几何框架。具有堆叠目标的西格玛模型的磁（拓扑）电荷由目标的形状编码，相当于其场的堆叠，这与控制电对称性的平面自同构群是对偶的。磁对称背景是通过将这些电荷与拓扑场论的选定模堆栈对偶、推广庞特里亚金对偶性并通过堆栈作用于理论来获得的。内聚模式允许目标具有非有限和非离散数据。当对偶堆栈是群状$E_\infty$-对象时，我们证明了一个纤维化定理，该定理根据未计量理论和规范群的磁对称性来表达电计量理论的磁对称性，并通过具有明确第一页的同伦定点谱序列计算。

对于具有连接的更高 $U(1)$-gerbes 的模堆栈，编码体拓扑局部拉格朗日量，我们证明了一个因式分解定理：任何连接目标的磁对称背景非规范地分裂为其积分同源群的庞特里亚金对偶，并且必然是平坦的，这是对具有连接的目标进行对偶化离散电荷的结果。我们用纯 $\mathrm{Pin}^\pm(2)$ 规范理论来说明这两个定理：$O(2)$ 具有可逆磁 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 对称性，形式为 $d-3$、$d-4$ 和 $d-5$，而 $\mathrm{Pin}^-(2)$ 则不存在这些对称性，前两个通过谱序列的单微分来区分。测量和物理应用将在接下来的工作中开发。

title: SU($N$) QCD, four-manifolds and Segre numbers
abstract: We study correlation functions of topologically twisted $\mathcal N=2$ supersymmetric QCD with gauge group $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ on a compact four-manifold $X$. We derive the Coulomb branch integral for all $N$, including new couplings to background fluxes for the flavor symmetry. For $X$ of simple type with $b_2^+>1$, the correlators become sums over a finite number of strong-coupling singularities on the Coulomb branch, and can be expressed using a number of Coulomb branch couplings. The sum contains the $\mathcal N=1$ vacua, which become the supersymmetric vacua when the $\mathcal N=2$ theory is broken to $\mathcal N=1$ by an adjoint mass deformation, and whose contribution we attribute to the instanton branch. We focus on asymptotically free $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ QCD with $N_f<2N$ equal mass hypermultiplets, and conjecture that its instanton contribution to topological correlators agrees with the generating function of virtual Segre numbers of rank $N$, which are intersection numbers on the moduli space of semistable sheaves on an algebraic surface. We present a precise dictionary for all $N$ between universal series for Segre numbers and Coulomb branch couplings at the $\mathcal N=1$ vacua. The calculation of these couplings requires new higher-rank techniques, involving Siegel modular forms, an exact $\mathbb Z_N$ symmetry, charge conjugation symmetry, factorisation of the Seiberg--Witten curve, and the blowup formula. For pure $\mathrm{SU}(N)$, our result agrees with earlier work by Mariño and Moore, and the twisted correlators give the $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ Donaldson invariants of $X$. For $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ QCD, we determine closed-form expressions for all 13 Coulomb branch couplings for each $N_f=1,\dots, 5$, and find precise agreement with results of Göttsche and Kool for virtual rank 3 Segre numbers.
summary:
我们研究了紧凑四流形 $X$ 上拓扑扭曲 $\mathcal N=2$ 超对称 QCD 与规范群 $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ 的相关函数。我们推导出所有 $N$ 的库仑分支积分，包括与风味对称性的背景通量的新耦合。对于 $b_2^+>1$ 的简单类型 $X$，相关器变为库仑分支上有限数量的强耦合奇点的和，并且可以使用多个库仑分支耦合来表示。总和包含$\mathcal N=1$真空，当$\mathcal N=2$理论被伴随质量变形打破为$\mathcal N=1$时，它变成超对称真空，我们将其贡献归因于瞬子分支。我们关注具有$N_f<2N$等质量超多重态的渐近自由$\mathrm{SU}(N)$ QCD，并推测其对拓扑相关器的瞬子贡献与阶$N$的虚Segre数的生成函数一致，该数是代数曲面上半稳定滑轮模空间上的交数。

我们为 Segre 数的通用级数和 $\mathcal N=1$ 真空处的库仑分支耦合之间的所有 $N$ 提供了一个精确的字典。这些耦合的计算需要新的更高阶技术，包括西格尔模形式、精确的 $\mathbb Z_N$ 对称性、电荷共轭对称性、Seiberg-Witten 曲线的因式分解以及爆炸公式。对于纯 $\mathrm{SU}(N)$，我们的结果与 Mariño 和 Moore 的早期工作一致，并且扭曲相关器给出了 $X$ 的 $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ 唐纳森不变量。对于 $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ QCD，我们确定了每个 $N_f=1,\dots, 5$ 的所有 13 个库仑分支耦合的闭合形式表达式，并发现与虚拟等级 3 Segre 数的 Göttsche 和 Kool 结果精确一致。

title: Quantum covariant bit threads
abstract: Entanglement entropy plays a central role in holography. The quantum extremal surface (QES) formula is the standard tool in settings where both dynamics and bulk quantum corrections are important, such as in black hole evaporation. We derive and explore QES-equivalent prescriptions --- quantum covariant bit threads --- that formulate holographic entanglement entropy in terms of minimal or maximal bulk flows rather than extremal surfaces. Like classical covariant bit threads, our prescriptions come in two types: (typically) spacelike V-flows, and timelike U-flows. To account for bulk quantum corrections, the flow lines can start and end at points in the bulk, with the distribution of endpoints controlled by bulk entanglement entropies. In our bit thread language, the QES is a quantum bottleneck to the flow, with some threads passing through it (accounting for the area term in the generalized entropy) and others jumping across it (accounting for the entropy term). Our prescriptions provide a complementary perspective to the QES formula and offer new insights on important phenomena such as black hole evaporation, islands, and baby universes.
summary: 纠缠熵在全息术中起着核心作用。量子极值表面 (QES) 公式是动力学和体量子校正都很重要的环境中的标准工具，例如黑洞蒸发。我们推导并探索了与 QES 等效的处方——量子协变比特线程——根据最小或最大体流而不是极值表面来制定全息纠缠熵。与经典的协变位线程一样，我们的方案有两种类型：（通常）类空间 V 流和类时 U 流。为了考虑体量子校正，流线可以在体中的点开始和结束，端点的分布由体纠缠熵控制。在我们的位线程语言中，QES 是流的量子瓶颈，一些线程穿过它（考虑广义熵中的面积项），而其他线程则跳过它（考虑熵项）。我们的处方为 QES 公式提供了补充视角，并为黑洞蒸发、岛屿和婴儿宇宙等重要现象提供了新的见解。

title: Exact effective central charges for a family of 3d superconformal field theories
abstract: We conjecture an exact formula for the effective central charge, ceff, of a family of three- dimensional superconformal field theories related to Chern-Simons theory on a three-manifold by the 3d-3d correspondence. The formula determines ceff , which governs the growth of a protected sector of states in the conformal theory, in terms of the dimension of a particular space of modular forms. We confirm our approach by checking against known results computed through resurgent continuation.
summary: 我们通过 3d-3d 对应推测了与三流形陈-西蒙斯理论相关的一系列三维超共形场论的有效中心电荷 ceff 的精确公式。该公式根据模形式的特定空间的维度确定了 ceff ，它控制着共形理论中受保护的状态部门的增长。我们通过检查通过复苏延续计算出的已知结果来确认我们的方法。

title: Wilson line defect indices for M2-brane SCFTs
abstract: We investigate line defect Coulomb and Higgs indices in 3d $\mathcal{N}\ge 4$ supersymmetric gauge theories. The normalized line defect indices defined by ratios of the decorated defect indices to the ordinary indices yield well-defined integer values, the line defect Witten indices in the unit R-charge fugacity limit. We propose general formulae for these Witten indices in both Coulomb and Higgs limits for the theories without Chern-Simons terms, and we show that both count the states invariant under the residual gauge group left unbroken at a generic point of the branch, which we read off from the vacuum equations. Furthermore, we find powerful algebraic recursion relations for Wilson line defect Coulomb indices in the 3d SCFTs describing M2-branes, including ADHM-type theories and ABJ(M) theories. These relations imply that higher rank line defect indices are recursively determined by lower rank data across $U(N)$, $USp(2N)$, $SO(2N)$ and $SO(2N+1)$ ADHM-type theories and ABJ(M) theories.
summary: 我们研究 3d $\mathcal{N}\ge 4$ 超对称规范理论中的线缺陷库仑指数和希格斯指数。由装饰缺陷指数与普通指数之比定义的归一化线缺陷指数产生明确定义的整数值，即单位 R 电荷逸度极限内的线缺陷维滕指数。我们在没有陈-西蒙斯项的理论的库仑和希格斯极限中提出了这些维滕指数的通用公式，并且我们表明，两者都计算了在分支的通用点处保持完整的剩余规范群下的状态不变，这是我们从真空方程中读出的。此外，我们在描述 M2 膜的 3d SCFT 中发现了威尔逊线缺陷库仑指数的强大代数递归关系，包括 ADHM 型理论和 ABJ(M) 理论。这些关系意味着较高的秩线缺陷指数是由 $U(N)$、$USp(2N)$、$SO(2N)$ 和 $SO(2N+1)$ ADHM 型理论和 ABJ(M) 理论中的较低秩数据递归确定的。

title: Anomaly-free six-dimensional $Sp(1)_R$-gauged supergravities
abstract: We study anomaly constraints in six-dimensional $N=(1,0)$ supergravity with gauged $Sp(1)_R$ symmetry, one tensor multiplet, $n_V$ vector multiplets and $n_H$ hypermultiplets. Imposing cancellation of local gravitational, gauge and mixed anomalies, together with the embedding of the anomaly coefficients in a unimodular rank-two string charge lattice, the number of vector multiplets is sharply constrained: the only allowed positive values are $n_V=12$ and $n_V=96$. For a neutral abelian factor, or drone, the anomaly equations force the corresponding row and column of the abelian gauge-kinetic matrix to vanish. Such a factor therefore cannot be retained as an ordinary propagating vector multiplet. For $n_V=96$, within the class of semisimple non-$R$ gauge algebras containing no $A_1$ or $A_2$ factor, the exhaustive spectra-assembly calculation yields no drone-free spectrum. For $n_V=12$, the semisimple non-$R$ branch is necessarily $A_1^3$. In the doublet/adjoint truncation described in the text, we find $4{,}337{,}331$ consistent models, classified by $102$ anomaly-vector classes. We also consider the reductive branch $A_2\times U(1)\times Sp(1)_R$. For $A_2$ representations in $\{\mathbf 1,\mathbf 3,\overline{\mathbf 3}, \mathbf 6,\overline{\mathbf 6},\mathbf 8\}$ and primitive $U(1)$ charge assignments with $|q|\le 2$, we find $178{,}538$ solutions, classified by $21$ sets of anomaly vectors.
summary:
我们研究六维 $N=(1,0)$ 超重力中的异常约束，具有测量的 $Sp(1)_R$ 对称性、一个张量多重态、$n_V$ 向量多重态和 $n_H$ 超多重态。通过消除局部引力、规范和混合异常，以及将异常系数嵌入单模二阶弦电荷晶格中，矢量多重态的数量受到严格限制：唯一允许的正值是 $n_V=12$ 和 $n_V=96$。对于中性阿贝尔因子或无人机，异常方程迫使阿贝尔规范动力学矩阵的相应行和列消失。因此，这样的因子不能被保留为普通的传播矢量多重态。对于 $n_V=96$，在不包含 $A_1​​$ 或 $A_2$ 因子的半简单非 $R$ 规范代数类中，详尽的谱组装计算不会产生无无人机谱。对于 $n_V=12$，半简单非 $R$ 分支必然是 $A_1​​^3$。在文中描述的双峰/伴随截断中，我们发现 $4{,}337{,}331$ 一致模型，按 $102$ 异常向量类分类。我们还考虑还原分支 $A_2\times U(1)\times Sp(1)_R$。

对于 $\{\mathbf 1,\mathbf 3,\overline{\mathbf 3}, \mathbf 6,\overline{\mathbf 6},\mathbf 8\}$ 中的 $A_2$ 表示以及 $|q|\le 2$ 的原语 $U(1)$ 电荷分配，我们找到 $178{,}538$ 解，按 $21$ 组分类异常向量。

title: Higher-form Symmetries of Linearized Gravity in Maximally Symmetric Spaces
abstract: We formulate the gravitational field on maximally symmetric spacetimes as a gauge theory, and investigate higher-form symmetries of the linearized gravitational field via a series expansion in Newton's gravitational constant. To treat gravity as a gauge theory, the MacDowell-Mansouri formulation based on Cartan geometry is utilized. We show the existence of a 1-form symmetry in linearized gravity on Minkowski spacetime. Furthermore, for other maximally symmetric spacetimes (de Sitter and anti-de Sitter spacetimes) with a small cosmological constant, we demonstrate the existence of an approximate 1-form symmetry in the corresponding linearized gravity, detailing its explicit dependence on the cosmological constant.
summary: 我们将最大对称时空上的引力场表述为规范理论，并通过牛顿引力常数的级数展开来研究线性化引力场的更高形式的对称性。为了将重力视为规范理论，采用了基于嘉当几何的麦克道尔-曼苏里公式。我们证明了闵可夫斯基时空中线性化引力中存在 1 型对称性。此外，对于其他具有小宇宙学常数的最大对称时空（德西特和反德西特时空），我们证明了相应的线性引力中存在近似1-形式对称性，详细说明了其对宇宙学常数的明确依赖性。

title: Wald entropy and Wen-Zee type gauge-curvature coupling in 2+1-dimensional gravity
abstract: The Wen-Zee term is a mixed gauge-curvature coupling in the topological Chern-Simons description of a quantum Hall fluid, encoding the electric charge bound to spatial curvature. We investigate a Lorentz-covariant generalisation of this coupling, expanding its scope to black-hole spacetimes and determine its contribution to horizon entropy. Such a coupling arises naturally in three-dimensional Chern-Simons gravity based on the Maxwell algebra. We show that its Wald entropy contribution is a horizon boost charge, given by a loop integral of the additional gauge field projected along the tangent to the bifurcation circle. This contribution can be nonzero even when the mixed term vanishes on shell. We show that the integral admits an Abelian holonomy interpretation when the projection direction is covariantly constant. We evaluate the charge on a flat cosmological solution and, using smooth horizon fields and a specified thermal ensemble, on an AdS-Lorentz black hole. These results connect the geometric response familiar from quantum Hall physics to gravitational horizon thermodynamics.
summary: Wen-Zee 项是量子霍尔流体的拓扑 Chern-Simons 描述中的混合规范-曲率耦合，编码与空间曲率绑定的电荷。我们研究了这种耦合的洛伦兹协变推广，将其范围扩展到黑洞时空，并确定其对视界熵的贡献。这种耦合在基于麦克斯韦代数的三维陈-西蒙斯引力中自然出现。我们表明，其沃尔德熵贡献是地平线增强电荷，由沿分叉圆切线投影的附加规范场的环积分给出。即使混合项在壳上消失，该贡献也可以不为零。我们证明，当投影方向是协变常数时，积分接受阿贝尔完整解释。我们评估了平坦宇宙学解上的电荷，并使用平滑地平场和指定的热系综，评估了 AdS-洛伦兹黑洞上的电荷。这些结果将量子霍尔物理学中常见的几何响应与引力视界热力学联系起来。

title: Majorana bilinears, compact modular seeds and the approach to the Tsirelson bound
abstract: In this work we study the Bell-CHSH inequality in the vacuum of the free massive Majorana field in $1+1$ dimensions, taking as the dichotomic observables of the two parties even bilinears of smeared fields localized in the right and in the left Rindler wedges. The test functions are generated from seeds in the modular-frequency variable through the Tomita-Takesaki operator of the right wedge and, on the side of the left wedge, through its adjoint multiplied by $i$, which accounts for twisted duality. For seeds supported at positive modular frequency the one-particle overlaps between the two parties do not depend on the modular weights, and we obtain the Bell parameter in closed form. When the seeds are phase rotations of a single compact bump, the bilinears generate a copy of the Pauli algebra in each wedge, and we compute exactly the correlation matrix of the vacuum restricted to the two copies. The optimal settings violate the classical bound up to spectral widths more than twice as large as those reached with planar settings. We also show that the Tsirelson bound is never attained in the wedge vacuum for any choice of dichotomic observables, and that approaching it forces the modular spectral weight of the Bell vectors to concentrate at the spectral point $\lambda=1$ of the modular operator. This establishes in a precise way how the even sector of the free Majorana field realizes the Summers-Werner mechanism.
summary:
在这项工作中，我们研究了 $1+1$ 维度的自由大马约拉纳场真空中的 Bell-CHSH 不等式，甚至将位于右侧和左侧 Rindler 楔中的涂抹场的双线性作为双方的二分可观测量。测试函数是通过右楔的 Tomita-Takesaki 算子从模频率变量中的种子生成的，在左楔的一侧，通过其伴随乘以 $i$，这说明了扭曲对偶性。对于以正模频率支持的种子，两方之间的单粒子重叠不依赖于模权重，并且我们获得闭合形式的贝尔参数。当种子是单个紧凑凸块的相位旋转时，双线性在每个楔中生成泡利代数的副本，并且我们精确计算仅限于两个副本的真空相关矩阵。最佳设置违反了光谱宽度的经典界限，其光谱宽度是平面设置所达到的光谱宽度的两倍以上。

我们还表明，对于任何二分可观测量的选择，在楔形真空中永远不会达到 Tsirelson 界，并且接近它会迫使贝尔向量的模谱权集中在模算子的谱点 $\lambda=1$ 处。这以精确的方式建立了自由马约拉纳场的偶数扇区如何实现萨默斯-沃纳机制。

title: An Observer in de Sitter Space, and Rereading Everett
abstract: After re-examining a classic article by Hugh Everett, I will discuss the entropy of de Sitter space from the standpoint of an observer living in the space. This provides a nice example of the importance -- for certain questions -- of taking seriously the fact that in cosmology any observer is really part of the universe that is being observed. (This article has appeared in a special issue of International Journal of Modern Physics A in honor of Gerard 't Hooft.
summary: 在重新审视 Hugh Everett 的一篇经典文章后，我将从生活在空间中的观察者的角度讨论德西特空间的熵。这提供了一个很好的例子，说明了对于某些问题来说，认真对待这样一个事实的重要性：在宇宙学中，任何观察者实际上都是被观察宇宙的一部分。 （本文发表在国际现代物理学杂志 A 的特刊上，以纪念杰拉德·特·霍夫特。

title: Scalar potential bounds on one-parameter Calabi-Yau threefolds with fluxes
abstract: We study the refined de Sitter conjecture (RdSC), the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture (TCC) and the species scale $\Lambda_s$ in the multifield flux potential of type IIB string theory compactified on one-parameter Calabi--Yau threefolds. The scalar potential depends on the axio-dilaton and on the single complex-structure modulus, and is no-scale along the Kähler directions. Restricting to $h^{2,1}=1$ allows us to work with the exact periods obtained from the Picard--Fuchs equations rather than with their large-complex-structure expansion, and therefore to probe the conifold region. For the mirror quintic, $(h^{2,1},h^{1,1})=(1,101)$, we scan 200 flux configurations and find unstable extrema in $96\%$ of the cases, with $c'=0.18$. Once the Kähler runaway is taken into account, the no-scale structure fixes the logarithmic slope of the potential at every critical point to the universal value $\sqrt6$, so that the first RdSC condition is satisfied throughout. Statistically, the complex structure is the heavier sector and the axio-dilaton dominates the unstable directions. For the TCC we obtain analytic results valid for the whole class of one-parameter models: the slope approaches the universal value $2$ at large complex structure, diverges at the conifold, and equals exactly $\sqrt2$ in the axio-dilaton directions, where the leading potential takes a single $SL(2)$-covariant form, as the multifield evolutions confirm numerically. The TCC further translates into a lower bound on the compactification volume, $v>v_0\sim e^{N}$, controlled by the number of e-folds. Finally, the field displacements along our trajectories are compatible with the species-scale field-range bound, and restoring the volume dependence of $\Lambda_s$ shows that $V\lesssim3\Lambda_s^2$ is implied by the TCC volume bound, which is thus the genuine constraint on these models.
summary:
我们研究了改进的德西特猜想（RdSC）、跨普朗克检查猜想（TCC）和在单参数 Calabi-Yau 三重上压缩的 IIB 型弦理论多场通量势中的物种尺度 $\Lambda_s$。标量势取决于轴膨胀和单个复杂结构模量，并且沿凯勒方向是无标度的。限制为 $h^{2,1}=1$ 允许我们使用从 Picard-Fuchs 方程获得的精确周期，而不是使用它们的大复杂结构展开，从而探测圆锥折叠区域。对于镜像五次方程 $(h^{2,1},h^{1,1})=(1,101)$，我们扫描 200 个通量配置并在 $96\%$ 的情况下找到不稳定的极值，其中 $c'=0.18$。一旦考虑到凯勒失控，无标度结构将每个临界点处势能的对数斜率固定为通用值$\sqrt6$，从而始终满足第一个RdSC条件。从统计上看，复杂结构是较重的部分，轴膨胀在不稳定方向上占主导地位。

对于 TCC，我们获得了对整个一参数模型类有效的分析结果：斜率在大型复杂结构处接近通用值 $2$，在圆锥形处发散，并且在轴膨胀方向上恰好等于 $\sqrt2$，其中主导势采用单个 $SL(2)$ 协变形式，正如多场演化在数值上所证实的那样。 TCC 进一步转化为压实体积的下限 $v>v_0\sim e^{N}$，由 e 折叠的数量控制。最后，沿着我们的轨迹的场位移与物种尺度的场范围界限兼容，并且恢复 $\Lambda_s$ 的体积依赖性表明 $V\lesssim3\Lambda_s^2$ 是由 TCC 体积界限隐含的，因此这是对这些模型的真正约束。

title: The Phenomenology of the Dark Dimension and Non-Supersymmetric Strings
abstract: Swampland principles, combined with the smallness of dark energy $\Lambda$, lead to the dark dimension scenario, with one extra dimension of micron size. We review this scenario and its predictions: KK graviton dark matter (or the KK tower of the quintessence field into which the gravitons convert), neutrino masses tied to $\Lambda^{1/4}$ via a bulk $B-L$ gauge symmetry, QCD axion decay constant $f_a\sim \Lambda^{1/12}\sim 10^9-10^{10}$ GeV at the 5d Planck scale $M_5$, connecting electroweak hierarchy to $\Lambda^{1/6}$, and a relation between the GUT and weak scales with $M_5$ as the geometric mean. The dark dimension also provides a concrete realization of an evolving dark sector: the evolution of its diameter correlates the variation of dark energy with that of the dark matter mass, fitting the recent DESI DR2 (+CMB+supernovae) data while avoiding the phantom crossing that the $w_0w_a$CDM parametrization would suggest---the apparent phantom behavior instead arises from the evolving dark matter mass. The fits suggest that the dark energy field sits in the interior of moduli space, near an unstable critical point. Motivated by this, we review recent progress on non-supersymmetric string vacua: isolated critical points protected by duality symmetries, in non-geometric flux compactifications and in Scherk--Schwarz compactifications of M-theory, and an emerging duality web for non-supersymmetric strings. This note is based on two talks given by the author at String Phenomenology 2026 (Paris) and Strings 2026 (Shanghai).
summary:
沼泽原理与暗能量 $\Lambda$ 的微小结合，导致了暗维度场景，具有一个微米大小的额外维度。我们回顾一下这个场景及其预测：KK 引力子暗物质（或引力子转换成的精髓场的 KK 塔）、中微子质量通过大块 $B-L$ 规范对称性与 $\Lambda^{1/4}$ 联系在一起、QCD 轴子衰变常数 $f_a\sim \Lambda^{1/12}\sim 10^9-10^{10}$ 在 5d 普朗克处的 GeV尺度$M_5$，将电弱层次结构连接到$\Lambda^{1/6}$，以及GUT和弱尺度之间的关系，以$M_5$作为几何平均值。暗维度还提供了不断演变的暗部门的具体实现：其直径的演变将暗能量的变化与暗物质质量的变化相关联，拟合最近的 DESI DR2（+CMB+超新星）数据，同时避免 $w_0w_a$CDM 参数化所暗示的幻影交叉——明显的幻影行为反而源于不断演变的暗物质质量。拟合结果表明暗能量场位于模空间的内部，靠近不稳定的临界点。

受此启发，我们回顾了非超对称弦真空的最新进展：受对偶对称性保护的孤立临界点、非几何通量紧致化和 M 理论的 Scherk-Schwarz 紧致化，以及非超对称弦的新兴对偶网络。本文基于作者在 String Phenomenology 2026（巴黎）和 Strings 2026（上海）上的两次演讲。

title: $BF$ effective action topological implications
abstract: We investigate the effective action of a 7-dimensional topological $BF$ theory under a 4-dimensional reduction. We discuss the topological implications of the resulting theory and analyze the corresponding field equations. In particular, we derive exact solutions to these equations of motion in both Minkowski and Schwarzschild spacetimes.
summary: 我们研究了 7 维拓扑 $BF$ 理论在 4 维约简下的有效作用。我们讨论了所得理论的拓扑含义并分析了相应的场方程。特别是，我们在闵可夫斯基和史瓦西时空中导出了这些运动方程的精确解。

title: From Critical Zero Modes to Interior Dynamics in Holographic Superconductors
abstract: We study how the critical behavior of holographic superconductors controls the interior geometry of charged black holes. Although the exterior condensate vanishes at criticality, the critical zero mode develops logarithmic oscillations near the Reissner--Nordström Cauchy horizon, rendering the interior critical limit nonuniform. We show that the transmitted critical-mode amplitude, together with local Cauchy-horizon quantities, fixes both the leading Einstein--Rosen collapse $\Delta z_{\rm ER}$ width and the phase $\Theta_J$ in the subsequent Josephson regime. If the condensate obeys $t\equiv1-T/T_c\propto\epsilon^{2r}$, then $\Delta z_{\rm ER}\propto t^{1/r}$ and $\Theta_J\propto t^{-1/r}$. This Josephson phase is transferred to the first Kasner epoch, producing oscillatory Kasner exponents and an accumulation law $t_n\sim n^{-r}$ for successive zeros of the scalar velocity. The critical zero mode fixes the leading collapse and phase coefficients, which are quantitatively confirmed by fully nonlinear solutions in both the ordinary and tricritical cases. At low temperature, the interior instead depends on the infrared completion of the zero-temperature geometry. Thus near-critical scaling is governed by critical-mode transmission, whereas the low-temperature behavior is controlled by the infrared endpoint.
summary:
我们研究全息超导体的临界行为如何控制带电黑洞的内部几何形状。尽管外部凝结物在临界点消失，但临界零模式在赖斯纳-诺德斯特罗姆柯西视界附近产生对数振荡，使得内部临界极限不均匀。我们表明，传输的临界模式振幅与局部柯西视界量一起固定了领先的爱因斯坦-罗森塌缩 $\Delta z_{\rm ER}$ 宽度和随后的约瑟夫森体系中的相位 $\Theta_J$。如果凝聚态服从 $t\equiv1-T/T_c\propto\epsilon^{2r}$，则 $\Delta z_{\rm ER}\propto t^{1/r}$ 和 $\Theta_J\propto t^{-1/r}$。该约瑟夫森阶段转移到第一个 Kasner 历元，产生振荡 Kasner 指数和标量速度连续零点的累积定律 $t_n\sim n^{-r}$。临界零模式固定了前导塌陷和相位系数，这些系数在普通和三临界情况下都通过完全非线性解定量地得到了证实。在低温下，内部反而依赖于零温几何结构的红外完成。

因此，近临界缩放由临界模式传输控制，而低温行为由红外端点控制。

title: Inflationary magnetogenesis in Proca electrodynamics with Schwinger particle production
abstract: We investigate inflationary magnetogenesis with massive vector fields, including charged scalar particle production via the Schwinger effect and its backreaction on the background electric energy density. Initially neglecting the Schwinger effect, we quantize the vector field and solve the equations of motion for transverse and longitudinal modes, computing the energy momentum tensor. We then incorporate the backreaction of the electric energy density and show that the longitudinal energy density is subleading compared to the electric background. Since the electric energy density dominates the magnetic contribution, we can treat the former separately from the perturbative contributions. We adopt this approach when studying particle production via the Schwinger effect, assuming that its backreaction acts only on the background electric energy density. The latter is computed using a classical background electromagnetic field minimally coupled to a quantum complex scalar field. The magnetic and longitudinal components are instead described through quantum fields. In this framework, the Schwinger production affects only the electric energy density, as long as it remains dominant compared to the other components. As a consistency check, we verify that for a null coupling constant we recover the same electric energy density as obtained within the fully quantum electromagnetic description. Finally, we show that for non-null coupling constants Schwinger particle production drastically reduces the electric energy density during the final stages of inflation.
summary:
我们研究了大矢量场的膨胀磁生作用，包括通过施温格效应产生带电标量粒子及其对背景电能密度的反反应。最初忽略施温格效应，我们量化矢量场并求解横向和纵向模式的运动方程，计算能量动量张量。然后，我们结合了电能密度的反反应，并表明与电背景相比，纵向能量密度是次领先的。由于电能密度在磁贡献中占主导地位，因此我们可以将前者与微扰贡献分开对待。我们在通过施温格效应研究粒子产生时采用这种方法，假设其反反应仅作用于背景电能密度。后者是使用与量子复标量场最小耦合的经典背景电磁场来计算的。相反，磁性和纵向分量是通过量子场来描述的。

在此框架中，施温格产量仅影响电能密度，只要它与其他组件相比仍然占主导地位。作为一致性检查，我们验证对于零耦合常数，我们恢复了与在全量子电磁描述中获得的相同的电能密度。最后，我们表明，对于非零耦合常数，施温格粒子的产生会大大降低膨胀最后阶段的电能密度。

title: Extremal black hole throats from non extremal near horizon expansions
abstract: We show how extremal near horizon geometries can be recovered from the non extremal near horizon expansion for smooth stationary black hole families admitting a smooth extremal limit. In Gaussian null coordinates common to the family, we apply the near extremal scaling of the surface gravity together with a radial scaling and a rescaling of Killing time. Although the physical surface gravity vanishes, the scaled horizon can retain a finite surface gravity. The extremal near horizon geometry is obtained when this scaled surface gravity is taken to zero. Under the near extremal scaling and the time rescaling, the quadratic radial term in the temporal metric component can survive, while higher radial orders vanish. Expansion through second order is therefore sufficient and is necessary whenever the quadratic term has a nonzero limiting coefficient in the chosen chart. We derive a common pullback prescription for extracting the near horizon coefficients and recover the known throats of Reissner-Nordström, Kerr, Kerr-Newman, and charged rotating Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) black holes. Neutral rotating BTZ provides a case in which the string Carroll expansion already suffices.
summary: 我们展示了如何从承认平滑极值极限的平滑静止黑洞族的非极值近地平线膨胀中恢复极值近地平线几何形状。在该系列常见的高斯零坐标中，我们应用表面重力的近极值缩放以及径向缩放和杀戮时间的重新缩放。尽管物理表面重力消失，但缩放地平线可以保留有限的表面重力。当按比例缩放的表面重力为零时，获得极值近地平线几何形状。在近极值缩放和时间重新缩放下，时间度量分量中的二次径向项可以保留，而更高的径向阶消失。因此，只要二次项在所选图表中具有非零限制系数，二阶展开就足够了，并且是必要的。我们推导出了一个常见的回撤方案，用于提取近视界系数并恢复 Reissner-Nordström、Kerr、Kerr-Newman 和带电旋转 Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) 黑洞的已知喉部。中性旋转 BTZ 提供了弦卡罗尔展开已经足够的情况。

title: More on the Celestial Soft Symmetry Algebra in the ${\cal N}=8$ Supergravity
abstract: We construct the operator product expansions (OPEs) of the ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ currents (obtained from the antiholomorphic light transform) with the matter fields in the ${\cal N}=8$ supergravity. The corresponding (anti)commutators are obtained from the double contour integrals using the above OPEs. By computing the triple (anti)commutators consisting of current-current-matter (i.e., the Jacobi identity for fixed last element), the previously known ${\cal N}=8$ celestial soft symmetry algebra between these currents (in the antiholomorphic sector) is reproduced. We repeat the above procedure by taking the holomorphic light transform and the OPEs of the ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$ currents with the matter fields and the corresponding (anti)commutators are obtained. We also obtain another type of ${\cal N}=8$ celestial soft symmetry algebra between these currents (in the holomorphic sector). As a subalgebra in the antiholomorphic and holomorphic sectors, there exists the ${\cal N}=8$ extended BMS (Bondi, van der Burg, Metzner, and Sachs in 1962) algebra. We analyze the above results from the ${\cal N}=8$ conformally {\it soft} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ (or ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$) currents in the antiholomorphic (or holomorphic) sector. The nontrivial soft theorems for the graviton, the gravitinos and the graviphotons are described. Finally, using the shadow transform (the consecutive composition of holomorphic and antiholomorphic light transforms), we obtain the OPEs of the ${\cal N}=8$ {\it shadow} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ (or ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$) currents with the matter fields where the stress-energy tensor, the supercurrents and the supertranslation generator of the ${\cal N}=8$ extended BMS algebra are identified.
summary:
我们使用 ${\cal N}=8$ 超重力中的物质场构造 ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ 电流（从反全纯光变换获得）的算子乘积展开（OPE）。使用上述 OPE 从双轮廓积分获得相应的（反​​）换向器。通过计算由电流-电流-物质（即固定最后一个元素的雅可比恒等式）组成的三重（反）换向子，可以重现这些电流（在反全纯扇区中）之间先前已知的 ${\cal N}=8$ 天体软对称代数。我们通过进行全纯光变换来重复上述过程，并获得 ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$ 电流与物质场的 OPE 以及相应的（反​​）换向器。我们还获得了这些电流之间的另一种类型的 ${\cal N}=8$ 天体软对称代数（在全纯扇区中）。作为反全纯和全纯扇区中的子代数，存在 ${\cal N}=8$ 扩展 BMS（Bondi、van der Burg、Metzner 和 Sachs，1962 年）代数。

我们从反全纯（或全纯）扇区中的${\cal N}=8$共形{\it soft} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$（或${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$）电流分析上述结果。描述了引力子、引力子和引力光子的非平凡软定理。最后，使用阴影变换（全纯和反全纯光变换的连续组合），我们获得了 ${\cal N}=8$ {\it Shadow} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ （或 ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$）电流与物质场的 OPE，其中 ${\cal 的应力能量张量、超电流和超平移生成器N}=8$ 扩展 BMS 代数已确定。

title: Einstein--Maxwell Sum Rules and the Persistence of the Smooth-Brane No-Go Theorem
abstract: We investigate whether a minimally coupled Abelian Maxwell sector can relax the Gibbons--Kallosh--Linde (GKL) obstruction to smooth five-dimensional warped braneworlds. For a canonical scalar field coupled to a bulk Maxwell field, we derive the one-parameter family of global consistency conditions while keeping the tangential F_{{\mu}{\nu}} and mixed F_{{\mu}5} sectors separate. This decomposition is essential because the Maxwell stress tensor is not traceless in five dimensions. We show that electromagnetic terms formally modify the integrated GKL constraints, but this modification does not provide a consistent evasion of the no-go theorem under the standard assumptions. Exact four-dimensional Poincaré invariance excludes a nonzero deterministic classical Maxwell field from the background, since its field strength would select preferred four-dimensional directions. The Maxwell sector therefore vanishes in the symmetric background and the usual smooth-brane obstruction is recovered. We also identify which assumptions must be relaxed for a nontrivial electromagnetic contribution and distinguish this background result from local consistency conditions for bulk gauge-field localization.
summary:
我们研究最小耦合阿贝尔麦克斯韦扇区是否可以放松吉本斯-卡洛什-林德（GKL）障碍以平滑五维扭曲膜世界。对于耦合到体麦克斯韦场的规范标量场，我们推导了全局一致性条件的单参数族，同时保持切向 F_{{\mu}{\nu}} 和混合 F_{{\mu}5} 扇区分开。这种分解至关重要，因为麦克斯韦应力张量在五个维度上并不是无迹可循的。我们证明电磁项形式上修改了积分 GKL 约束，但这种修改并没有在标准假设下提供一致的回避定理。精确的四维庞加莱不变性将非零确定性经典麦克斯韦场从背景中排除，因为其场强会选择首选的四维方向。因此，麦克斯韦扇区消失在对称背景中，并且恢复了通常的光滑膜障碍。

我们还确定了对于重要的电磁贡献必须放宽哪些假设，并将该背景结果与体积规范场定位的局部一致性条件区分开来。

title: Global Consistency of Cosmological Braneworlds in Palatini and Metric-Affine f(R) Gravity
abstract: We investigate global consistency conditions for five-dimensional warped braneworlds in Palatini and metric-affine gravity. Starting from the generalized Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde framework, we derive integrated sum rules for cosmological warped geometries and examine how independent connection degrees of freedom modify the standard Einstein-gravity obstruction to smooth compact braneworlds. The analysis separates geometric, matter, and non-Riemannian contributions and clarifies the conditions under which the usual no-go result can be modified. We show that the generalized consistency relations provide necessary global constraints on admissible configurations and identify the terms responsible for possible departures from the Riemannian case. The results establish a systematic framework for testing the global consistency of smooth five-dimensional braneworlds in gravitational theories with independent affine structure.
summary: 我们研究了 Palatini 和度量仿射引力中五维扭曲膜世界的全局一致性条件。从广义的吉本斯-卡洛什-林德框架开始，我们推导出宇宙扭曲几何的积分和规则，并研究独立连接自由度如何修改标准爱因斯坦引力障碍以平滑致密膜世界。该分析将几何、物质和非黎曼贡献分开，并阐明了可以修改通常不可行结果的条件。我们表明，广义一致性关系为可接受的配置提供了必要的全局约束，并确定了可能偏离黎曼情况的术语。研究结果建立了一个系统框架，用于测试具有独立仿射结构的引力理论中光滑五维膜世界的全局一致性。

title: Black Hole Entropy and Holographic Entanglement Entropy in DGP Brane Gravity
abstract: We investigate the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity with gravitational dynamics localized on the brane. We first consider the DGP brane model, in which an Einstein-Hilbert term is included in the brane action, and derive the condition under which the gravitational entropy of a braneworld black hole agrees with the holographic entanglement entropy. We show that the two entropies coincide when a specific condition involving the extrinsic curvature of the brane is satisfied. In particular, this condition is automatically satisfied for static configurations. We then generalize the brane-localized Einstein-Hilbert term to higher-curvature gravitational theories. For Lovelock gravity and $f(R)$ gravity on the brane, we derive the corresponding conditions for the equality between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy and show that they take the same form as that obtained for Einstein gravity. Although the equality is not guaranteed for general stationary configurations, the required condition is satisfied for static braneworld black holes, leading to an agreement between the two entropies. These results clarify the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity and contribute to a deeper understanding of holography in braneworld settings.
summary:
我们研究了膜世界引力中引力熵和全息纠缠熵之间的关系以及局域于膜上的引力动力学。我们首先考虑DGP膜模型，其中膜作用中包含爱因斯坦-希尔伯特项，并推导了膜世界黑洞的引力熵与全息纠缠熵一致的条件。我们证明，当满足涉及膜的外在曲率的特定条件时，这两个熵是一致的。特别是，静态配置会自动满足此条件。然后，我们将膜定域的爱因斯坦-希尔伯特项推广到更高曲率的引力理论。对于膜上的Lovelock引力和$f(R)$引力，我们推导了引力熵和全息纠缠熵之间相等的相应条件，并表明它们采用与爱因斯坦引力所获得的相同的形式。虽然对于一般的静止构型不能保证相等，但对于静态膜世界黑洞来说满足了所需的条件，导致两个熵之间一致。

这些结果阐明了膜世界引力中引力熵和全息纠缠熵之间的关系，有助于更深入地理解膜世界环境中的全息术。

title: IR flow of stochastic power spectra for interacting spectator scalars in the inflationary de Sitter spacetime
abstract: In this work we investigate the behaviour of early inflationary cosmic correlation functions under the flow of the infrared scale for interacting spectator scalar field theories. We start with the derivation of the one-loop effective potentials for $\phi^4$, $\phi^4$-Yukawa and broken phase $O(N)$ model in the inflationary de Sitter spacetime, first using the local Schwinger-DeWitt expansion propagator, and next using the exact de Sitter propagator. The Schwinger-DeWitt expansion being valid in a sub-Hubble length scale, furnishes suitable framework to determine the leading curvature corrections to high energy phenomena having sub-Hubble Compton wavelengths. These effective potentials show spontaneous symmetry breaking pattern, and are next used as ultraviolet boundary conditions in the Wetterich equation generating the desired IR flow. The flow is shown to drive the theory towards symmetry restoration. Using these IR-improved effective potentials, we next compute the stochastic power spectra and spectral indices for the temporally coincident two point correlation function of the spectator scalar. We show that the results corresponding to the aforementioned two kind of propagators are roughly in qualitative agreement with each other, but may differ quantitatively significantly. Both of them show increase in the spectral index in the deep IR for $\phi^4$ and $\phi^4$-Yukawa. The effect of fermionic interaction has been emphasised. Also for the case of the $O(N)$ scalar, we demonstrate that the effective potential's shape becomes more and more insensitive to the flow as $N$ gets large. Implication of this on the correlation function has been discussed.
summary:
在这项工作中，我们研究了早期膨胀宇宙相关函数在红外尺度流动下的行为，以用于相互作用的观察标量场理论。我们首先推导膨胀德西特时空中 $\phi^4$、$\phi^4$-Yukawa 和破相 $O(N)$ 模型的单环有效势，首先使用局部施温格-德威特展开传播器，然后使用精确的德西特传播器。施温格-德威特展开式在亚哈勃长度尺度下有效，提供了合适的框架来确定对具有亚哈勃康普顿波长的高能现象的主要曲率校正。这些有效电势显示出自发对称破缺模式，接下来用作 Wetterich 方程中的紫外线边界条件，生成所需的红外流。该流程被证明可以推动理论走向对称性恢复。使用这些红外改进的有效势，我们接下来计算观众标量的时间重合的两点相关函数的随机功率谱和谱指数。

我们表明，与上述两种传播器相对应的结果在质量上大致一致，但在数量上可能存在显着差异。它们都显示 $\phi^4$ 和 $\phi^4$-Yukawa 的深红外光谱指数有所增加。费米子相互作用的影响得到了强调。同样对于 $O(N)$ 标量的情况，我们证明随着 $N$ 变大，有效势的形状对流量变得越来越不敏感。已经讨论了这对相关函数的影响。

title: Momentum Flux for Small-Amplitude Oscillons
abstract: An oscillon in scalar field theory in $(1+1)$-dimensions is an oscillating, localised, almost periodic classical solution that slowly radiates and decays to the vacuum solution. We calculate its momentum flux integrated over a period, which would be zero for an exact breather. For an oscillon of small amplitude $\eps$, truncated at order $\eps^N$, we show that the integrated momentum flux is of leading order $\eps^{N+4}$ for even $N$ and $\eps^{N+5}$ for odd $N$, except for $N=1$, where it is of order $\eps^4$. It is therefore very small.
summary: $(1+1)$维标量场论中的振荡是一种振荡的、局部的、几乎周期性的经典解，它缓慢地辐射并衰减到真空解。我们计算其在一段时间内积分的动量通量，对于精确的喘息时间，该动量通量为零。对于小振幅 $\eps$ 的振荡，按阶 $\eps^N$ 截断，我们表明，偶数 $N$ 的积分动量通量为前导阶 $\eps^{N+4}$，奇数 $N$ 的积分动量通量为 $\eps^{N+5}$，但 $N=1$ 除外，其阶为 $\eps^4$。因此它非常小。

title: Nonlocal Dirac theory in curved spacetime and the Bunch--Davies vacuum
abstract: We formulate a nonlocal spin-$1/2$ field theory in curved spacetime in which the form factor is a nonpolynomial entire function of the covariant Dirac operator. We derive the corresponding nonlocal Dirac equation and analyze its coupling to gravity and to a $\rm U(1)$ gauge field. As an application, we study the theory in the open chart of de Sitter spacetime and construct the associated nonlocal Bunch--Davies modes. The nonlocal dynamics can be mapped, branch by branch, onto the local Dirac equation with an effective mass $M_n$. For the exponential form factors considered here, the effective masses are expressed in terms of branches of the Lambert-$W$ function. We show that the Euclidean analyticity structure of the Bunch--Davies construction is preserved. On the physical positive-residue branch, the Bogoliubov coefficients, squeezing parameter, occupation number, and entanglement entropy acquire explicit nonlocal corrections, while the absence of physical fermionic supercurvature modes is preserved. The local theory is smoothly recovered in the limit $\Lambda\to\infty$.
summary: 我们在弯曲时空中制定了非局域自旋 $1/2$ 场论，其中形状因子是协变狄拉克算子的非多项式整函数。我们推导了相应的非局部狄拉克方程并分析了它与重力和 $\rm U(1)$ 规范场的耦合。作为应用，我们研究了德西特时空开图中的理论，并构造了相关的非局域 Bunch--Davies 模。非局部动力学可以逐个分支映射到具有有效质量 $M_n$ 的局部狄拉克方程。对于此处考虑的指数形状因子，有效质量以 Lambert-$W$ 函数的分支表示。我们证明了 Bunch--Davies 结构的欧几里得解析结构得以保留。在物理正余数分支上，Bogoliubov 系数、压缩参数、占用数和纠缠熵获得显式非局部校正，同时保留物理费米子超曲率模式的缺失。局部理论在$\Lambda\to\infty$极限下顺利恢复。

title: A local second law for black hole dynamics in the charged large-$D$ membrane paradigm
abstract: The large-$D$ membrane paradigm provides a perturbative, non-gravitational description of black hole dynamics. While the local second law of thermodynamics has been established for neutral membranes, the explicit determination of the local entropy production equation within the charged large-$D$ membrane framework remains unsolved. In this paper, we compute the subleading-order correction to the divergence of the membrane velocity for a charged black hole in a flat background. We evaluate the corresponding scalar Einstein-Maxwell constraint equation at the physical event horizon via the non-affine null Raychaudhuri equation, and relate the physical horizon expressions to the auxiliary membrane kinematics, demonstrating that the membrane velocity produces a non-negative divergence at the first non-vanishing order in the membrane worldvolume, which is driven by two quadratic forms: the membrane shear and a novel contribution generated purely by the Maxwell field. Using this result, we construct the membrane entropy current and prove that its divergence is non-negative through this order, thereby establishing the local second law for the charged large-$D$ membrane paradigm.
summary: 大$D$膜范式提供了黑洞动力学的微扰、非引力描述。虽然中性膜的局部热力学第二定律已经建立，但带电大$D$膜框架内局部熵产生方程的明确确定仍未解决。在本文中，我们计算了平坦背景中带电黑洞膜速度散度的次主导阶校正。我们通过非仿射零 Raychaudhuri 方程评估物理事件视界处相应的标量爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦约束方程，并将物理视界表达式与辅助膜运动学联系起来，证明膜速度在膜世界体积的第一非零阶上产生非负发散，这是由两个二次形式驱动的：膜剪切和纯粹由麦克斯韦场产生的新贡献。利用这一结果，我们构建了膜熵流，并通过该顺序证明其散度是非负的，从而建立了带电大$D$膜范式的局部第二定律。

title: Quantum Gravity in the Landau background gauge
abstract: We examine, in the Landau background gauge, the effective action of a quantum theory of gravitational and matter fields. We analyse the BRST invariance of this theory and study the Ward identities which implement the symmetry of the background effective action. The off-shell and on-shell counterterm Lagrangians are explicitly calculated in this gauge at one-loop order. We argue that the matter self-energy in the Landau background gauge, which is finite to this order, may be finite also at higher loops.
summary: 我们在朗道背景规范中研究了引力场和物质场量子理论的有效作用。我们分析了该理论的BRST不变性，并研究了实现背景有效作用对称性的Ward恒等式。壳外和壳内反项拉格朗日量在此规范中以单循环顺序显式计算。我们认为朗道背景规范中的物质自能在这个量级上是有限的，在更高的环上也可能是有限的。

title: de Sitter Wavefunction from Quadrangular Polylogarithms: Polygon Graphs
abstract: We present an explicit formula for the $n$-gon graph contribution to the integrand of the cosmological wavefunction for conformally coupled $\phi^3$ theory in de Sitter space. Our result relies on the fact that its symbol satisfies total compatibility with respect to the $B_{2n-1}$ cluster algebra. We introduce $B$-type quadrangular polylogarithms, constructed from centrally symmetric quadrangulations of a $4n$-gon, and show that the $n$-gon wavefunction coefficient is expressed by a natural weight-$n$ function of this class. We prove our formula by directly relating the recursive differential equation satisfied by these wavefunction coefficients to a recursive coproduct formula for $B$-type quadrangular polylogarithms, with the remaining additive constant fixed by the soft limit.
summary: 我们提出了一个显式公式，用于说明德西特空间中共形耦合 $\phi^3$ 理论的 $n$-gon 图对宇宙波函数被积函数的贡献。我们的结果依赖于这样一个事实：它的符号满足 $B_{2n-1}$ 簇代数的完全兼容性。我们引入了 $B$ 型四角多对数，由 $4n$ 边形的中心对称四边形构造而成，并表明 $n$ 边形波函数系数由此类的自然权重 $n$ 函数表示。我们通过将这些波函数系数满足的递归微分方程直接与 $B$ 型四角多对数的递归余积公式相关联来证明我们的公式，其余加性常数由软极限固定。

title: Time-dependent integrable quantum field theories with dynamical boundaries
abstract: We present a method for constructing time-dependent integrable chiral quantum field theories on a finite spatial interval from the scattering and reflection data of an autonomous integrable model. Each particle carries a spectral label that is constant along its free trajectory. Requiring a right--left scattering event at a fixed time to be independent of its position forces the map from characteristic coordinates to spectral labels to be affine, with the same slope for both chiralities. As a result, all bulk scattering events at a given time sample one common spectral argument, and the two boundary reflections sample the corresponding endpoint arguments. The bulk and boundary drives are not independent time-dependent deformations: their time dependence is fixed by the same affine spectral coordinate. Successive reflections at the two endpoints translate the spectral label by a finite amount. Following a particle through a complete round trip then produces a difference transport whose consistency gives the boundary quantum Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov equations. The Yang--Baxter and reflection equations ensure local compatibility, while BqKZ flatness ensures compatibility of complete round trips. We then reconstruct the local Hamiltonian by inverting the one- and two-particle matching problems. The bulk matrix fixes the contact interaction, while the reflection matrix fixes the corresponding boundary coupling. The same autonomous factorized data determine the boundary qKZ transport problem and the local driven Hamiltonian. Once the boundary qKZ system is solved, its characteristic pullback gives the corresponding time-dependent many-body wavefunction. We illustrate the construction with rational $SU(N)$ models and an $O(3)$-invariant model with dynamical boundary impurities, obtaining driven Kondo interactions whose couplings are fixed by the same affine spectral coordinate.
summary:
我们提出了一种根据自主可积模型的散射和反射数据在有限空间间隔上构造时间相关可积手性量子场论的方法。每个粒子都带有一个沿其自由轨迹恒定的光谱标签。要求固定时间的左右散射事件与其位置无关，迫使从特征坐标到光谱标签的映射是仿射的，两种手性具有相同的斜率。因此，给定时间的所有体散射事件都会对一个公共光谱参数进行采样，并且两个边界反射会对相应的端点参数进行采样。体驱动和边界驱动不是独立的时间相关变形：它们的时间相关性由相同的仿射谱坐标固定。两个端点处的连续反射将光谱标签平移有限的量。跟随一个粒子完成一次完整的往返，然后产生一个差分传输，其一致性给出了边界量子克尼日尼克-扎莫洛奇科夫方程。

Yang--Baxter 和反射方程确保局部兼容性，而 BqKZ 平坦度确保完整往返的兼容性。然后，我们通过反转一粒子和两粒子匹配问题来重建局部哈密顿量。体矩阵固定接触相互作用，而反射矩阵固定相应的边界耦合。相同的自主因式分解数据确定了边界 qKZ 传输问题和局部驱动的哈密顿量。一旦边界 qKZ 系统被求解，其特征回调就给出相应的瞬态多体波函数。我们用有理 $SU(N)$ 模型和具有动态边界杂质的 $O(3)$ 不变模型来说明构造，获得驱动的近藤相互作用，其耦合由相同的仿射谱坐标固定。

title: Quenched Growth of Normal Matrices and Harmonic Measure
abstract: The eigenvalues of a large normal random matrix form a two-dimensional Coulomb gas. At fixed weight, the spectral droplet grows with the matrix rank, and its semiclassical density increment is harmonic measure. We freeze an $N$-eigenvalue configuration and sample $M$ further eigenvalues using the projection onto polynomials of degree less than $N+M$ that vanish at the frozen points. Their conditional law is an exact polynomial ensemble in the potential of the frozen charges. For a regular analytic droplet, we prove that the spatial distribution of the new eigenvalues converges to harmonic measure on the old boundary when $M/\log N\to\infty$ and $M/N\to0$. This convergence holds conditionally on the frozen spectrum, outside a set of frozen configurations whose probability tends to zero. The equilibrium process formed from orthogonal polynomials of degrees $N,\ldots,N+M-1$ has the same limit. An exact finite-rank identity relates polynomial moments of the conditional mean to fluctuations of the frozen spectrum, with a remainder from polynomial modes of degree $N+M$ and above.
summary: 大的正态随机矩阵的特征值形成二维库仑气体。在固定权重下，光谱液滴随矩阵秩增长，其半经典密度增量是调和测度。我们冻结 $N$ 特征值配置，并使用在冻结点消失的次数小于 $N+M$ 的多项式上的投影来采样 $M$ 个进一步的特征值。他们的条件律是冻结电荷势的精确多项式系综。对于规则的解析液滴，我们证明当 $M/\log N\to\infty$ 和 $M/N\to0$ 时，新特征值的空间分布收敛到旧边界上的调和测度。这种收敛有条件地保持在冻结谱上，在一组概率趋于零的冻结配置之外。由 $N,\ldots,N+M-1$ 次正交多项式形成的平衡过程具有相同的极限。精确的有限秩恒等式将条件均值的多项式矩与冻结频谱的波动相关联，余数来自 $N+M$ 及以上的多项式模式。

title: Branching Gaps, Coexistence, and Boundary Influence for the Ising Model on Spherically Symmetric Trees
abstract: In this paper, we study the ferromagnetic nearest-neighbor Ising model on rooted spherically symmetric trees with one or \(q\) children per vertex, according to a prescribed sequence of branching levels. Unbounded runs of one-child levels force uniqueness at every nonzero homogeneous field and every finite inverse temperature. We quantify this effect through the locations of sufficiently long nonbranching stretches. Conversely, uniqueness need not entail any uniform rate: for each prescribed vanishing sequence, we construct a density-one tree whose finite-volume boundary influence decays more slowly along a subsequence. The tree retains branching number \(q\), although its nonzero-field coexistence region disappears. For eventually bounded gaps, we prove an optimal uniform comparison with the periodic tree having the largest allowed gap and obtain an explicit interval of coexistence fields. Thus bounded gaps are equivalent, within this family, to coexistence at some finite temperature and nonzero field. For eventually periodic gaps, Gibbs uniqueness is equivalent to fixed-point uniqueness of the full-period return map. A negative Schwarzian derivative yields a complete classification: in the supercritical regime the map has three fixed points inside a closed coexistence interval, two at its endpoints, and one outside. The nonzero endpoints are automatically nondegenerate folds, with square-root splitting of the merging branches.
summary:
在本文中，我们根据规定的分支级别序列，研究每个顶点有一个或 \(q\) 个子节点的有根球对称树上的铁磁最近邻伊辛模型。单子级的无界运行迫使每个非零均匀场和每个有限逆温度具有唯一性。我们通过足够长的非分支延伸的位置来量化这种效应。相反，唯一性不需要任何统一的速率：对于每个规定的消失序列，我们构造一棵密度一树，其有限体积边界影响沿着子序列衰减得更慢。该树保留了分支数 \(q\)，尽管其非零场共存区域消失了。对于最终有界间隙，我们证明了与具有最大允许间隙的周期树的最佳一致比较，并获得了共存场的显式区间。因此，在这个族中，有界间隙等效于在某个有限温度和非零场下的共存。对于最终的周期间隙，吉布斯唯一性相当于全周期回归图的定点唯一性。

负施瓦茨导数产生完整的分类：在超临界状态下，映射在闭合共存区间内具有三个固定点，两个位于其端点，一个位于外部。非零端点自动是非简并折叠，具有合并分支的平方根分裂。

title: A Self-Generated Local Structural Prior for Resolving Target Merging in Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT)
abstract: Electrical impedance tomography (EIT) is an ill-posed inverse imaging technique with limited and spatially nonuniform resolution. Conductivity targets located in regions with degraded spatial sensitivity may be reconstructed as a single connected region, resulting in the loss of spatial separability between neighboring structures. In this work, we propose a self-generated local structural prior for suppressing target merging in EIT reconstruction. First, an initial conductivity image is obtained from the measured boundary data using an existing EIT reconstruction method. This reconstruction is subsequently used as a reference image to construct a Gaussian similarity matrix according to the intensity similarity between image pixels. The adaptively chosen eigenvector of the covariance matrix is then employed to extract the principal structural information of the reference image. A localized structural mask is constructed and incorporated into a subsequent EIT reconstruction to preserve the spatial separability of neighboring targets. Numerical and water tank experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively separates neighboring conductivity targets that are merged by conventional EIT reconstruction methods.
summary:
电阻抗断层扫描 (EIT) 是一种不适定的逆成像技术，分辨率有限且空间不均匀。位于空间敏感性降低的区域中的电导率目标可以被重建为单个连接区域，导致相邻结构之间的空间可分离性丧失。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种自生成的局部结构先验，用于抑制 EIT 重建中的目标合并。首先，使用现有的 EIT 重建方法从测量的边界数据获得初始电导率图像。随后将该重建用作参考图像，根据图像像素之间的强度相似度构建高斯相似度矩阵。然后采用自适应选择的协方差矩阵的特征向量来提取参考图像的主要结构信息。构建局部结构掩模并将其合并到随后的 EIT 重建中，以保留相邻目标的空间可分离性。

数值和水箱实验结果表明，该方法有效地分离了由传统 EIT 重建方法合并的相邻电导率目标。

title: Supersymmetric semi--infinite cohomology and $N = 2$ superconformal structures
abstract: We study supersymmetric semi-infinite cohomology and its $N = 2$ superconformal structure via the BRST reduction of an $N = {\frac{3}{2}}$ superconformal structure on the super-affine vertex algebra associated to a super Manin pair arising from the Kazama--Suzuki $N = 2$ condition. Moreover, we realize super coset models in terms of relative supersymmetric semi-infinite cohomology.
summary: 我们通过对超仿射顶点代数上 $N = {\frac{3}{2}}$ 超共形结构的 BRST 约简来研究超对称半无限上同调及其 $N = 2$ 超共形结构，该超仿射顶点代数与 Kazama-Suzuki $N = 2$ 条件产生的超 Manin 对相关。此外，我们根据相对超对称半无限上同调实现了超陪集模型。

title: Covariant Euler-Poincaré Reduction for Field Theories on Centered Semidirect Products
abstract: Let $G$ be a Lie group equipped with commuting left and right linear representations on a vector space $V$, and let $G\Join V$ be the associated centered semidirect product. We develop a reduction scheme for covariant field theories on principal bundles with structure group $G\Join V$ from both Lagrangian and Hamiltonian perspectives, obtaining the reduced Euler-Poincaré and Lie-Poisson field equations decomposed into their $\mathfrak g$- and $V$-components, where $\mathfrak g$ is the Lie algebra of $G$. We also derive the reduced multisymplectic form formula, as well as the Noether and energy-momentum balance laws. Our reduction results are compared with those for principal bundles with standard semidirect-product structure groups, and the role of the centered variables is investigated: they retain the original two-sided geometric data and separate the left and right contributions via the heart and diamond operators. The framework is then applied to a two-sided matrix microstructural model and to the second-order jet group on $\mathbb R^r$, $G_r^2$. For the matrix model, the conjugation representation decomposes $\operatorname{Mat}(3)$ into scalar, vector, and symmetric-traceless sectors, clarifying its precise relation to director and alignment-tensor variables without identifying it with standard nematodynamics. For the one-dimensional jet group on a $(1+1)$-dimensional Minkowski base, we obtain a semilinear symmetric-hyperbolic system and an exact traveling conversion front with explicit energy-momentum exchange between the linear- and quadratic-jet sectors. Its hyperbolic-target interpretation yields a conserved positive energy for the linearized perturbations. A nonlinear numerical experiment illustrates the reduced evolution and reconstruction of the group-valued field, with consistency assessed through mesh refinement and an independent wave-map computation.
summary:
