令 $G$ 为在向量空间 $V$ 上配备有交换左、右线性表示的李群，并令 $G\Join V$ 为关联的中心半直积。我们从拉格朗日和哈密顿的角度开发了结构群 $G\Join V$ 的主丛协变场论的约简方案，获得了分解为 $\mathfrak g$- 和 $V$- 分量的约简欧拉-庞加莱和李-泊松场方程，其中 $\mathfrak g$ 是 $G$ 的李代数。我们还推导了简化多重辛形式公式，以及诺特定律和能量动量平衡定律。我们的约简结果与具有标准半直积结构群的主丛的结果进行了比较，并研究了中心变量的作用：它们保留了原始的两侧几何数据，并通过心形和菱形算子分离了左右贡献。然后将该框架应用于双面矩阵微观结构模型和 $\mathbb R^r$, $G_r^2$ 上的二阶射流组。

对于矩阵模型，共轭表示将 $\operatorname{Mat}(3)$ 分解为标量、向量和对称无迹扇区，阐明了其与导向变量和对齐张量变量的精确关系，而无需使用标准线动力学来识别它。对于 $(1+1)$ 维 Minkowski 基上的一维射流群，我们获得了半线性对称双曲线系统和精确的行进转换前沿，线性射流扇区和二次射流扇区之间具有显式能量动量交换。它的双曲目标解释为线性化扰动产生了守恒的正能量。非线性数值实验说明了群值场的减少演化和重建，并通过网格细化和独立的波图计算评估了一致性。

title: Dynamical quasi-symmetry of the classical Kepler-Coulomb problem and the conservation of the Laplace-Runge-Lenz vector
abstract: The paper studies a classical non-relativistic particle moving in $\mathbb{R}^{N}$, $(N\geqslant2)$, in the presence of the Kepler-Coulomb force $\boldsymbol{F}(\boldsymbol{r})=\alpha\boldsymbol{r}/r^{3}$, $(\alpha\neq0)$. It is shown that the extended-configuration-space transformation involving the projective transformation of the radius vector $\boldsymbol{r}\to\boldsymbol{R}=\boldsymbol{r}/(1+\boldsymbol{c}\cdot\boldsymbol{r})$ and the differential time scaling $\mathrm{d}t\to\mathrm{d}T=\mathrm{d}t/(1+\boldsymbol{c}\cdot\boldsymbol{r})^{2}$, where $\boldsymbol{c}$ is a real vector-valued parameter with dimensions of inverse length, constitutes a dynamical quasi-symmetry in the sense that it maps Newton's equation of motion $m(\mathrm{d}^{2}\boldsymbol{r}/\mathrm{d}t^{2})=\alpha\boldsymbol{r}/r^{3}$ into the equation $m(\mathrm{d}^{2}\boldsymbol{R}/\mathrm{d}T^{2})=(\alpha\boldsymbol{R}/R^{3}) \operatorname{sgn}(1-\boldsymbol{c}\cdot\boldsymbol{R})$. This quasi-symmetry is independent of, yet complementary to, the well-known Kepler-Coulomb dynamical symmetry, which is SO($N+1$) for negative energies and SO($N,1$) for positive energies. A detailed analytical and graphical analysis of induced mappings between non-degenerate conic trajectories associated with the original and transformed systems is presented. Mappings between velocity hodographs are also briefly discussed. It is then proved that the conservation of energy in the transformed motion implies the conservation of the Laplace-Runge-Lenz vector in the original dynamics.
summary:
本文研究了在开普勒-库仑力 $\boldsymbol{F}(\boldsymbol{r})=\alpha\boldsymbol{r}/r^{3}$, $(\alpha\neq0)$ 存在的情况下在 $\mathbb{R}^{N}$, $(N\geqslant2)$ 中运动的经典非相对论粒子。结果表明，扩展配置空间变换涉及半径向量 $\boldsymbol{r}\to\boldsymbol{R}=\boldsymbol{r}/(1+\boldsymbol{c}\cdot\boldsymbol{r})$ 的投影变换和微分时间缩放$\mathrm{d}t\to\mathrm{d}T=\mathrm{d}t/(1+\boldsymbol{c}\cdot\boldsymbol{r})^{2}$，其中$\boldsymbol{c}$是具有反长度维度的实向量值参数，在映射牛顿运动方程的意义上构成动力学拟对称性将 $m(\mathrm{d}^{2}\boldsymbol{r}/\mathrm{d}t^{2})=\alpha\boldsymbol{r}/r^{3}$ 代入方程 $m(\mathrm{d}^{2}\boldsymbol{R}/\mathrm{d}T^{2})=(\alpha\boldsymbol{R}/R^{3}) \operatorname{sgn}(1-\boldsymbol{c}\cdot\boldsymbol{R})$。这种准对称性独立于众所周知的开普勒-库仑动力学对称性，但与之互补，即负能量为 SO($N+1$)，正能量为 SO($N,1$)。

提出了与原始系统和变换系统相关的非简并圆锥轨迹之间的诱导映射的详细分析和图形分析。还简要讨论了速度记录仪之间的映射。然后证明了变换运动中的能量守恒意味着原始动力学中的拉普拉斯-龙格-楞次向量守恒。

title: Alternative Hamiltonian and Lagrangian Approaches for Constrained Systems
abstract: While standard Hamiltonian and Lagrangian methods are powerful for unconstrained classical systems, they are not directly suited to constrained ones, despite the existence of well-established treatments in the literature. In this paper, we present an alternative approach to deriving a generalized Hamiltonian and Lagrangian framework, based on the revised Barcelos-Wotzasek (BW) symplectic algorithm. This method enables a consistent and successful construction of the standard Lagrangian and Hamiltonian descriptions for constrained systems.
summary: 虽然标准哈密顿法和拉格朗日方法对于无约束经典系统非常强大，但它们并不直接适合受约束系统，尽管文献中存在完善的处理方法。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于改进的 Barcelos-Wotzasek (BW) 辛算法推导广义哈密顿量和拉格朗日框架的替代方法。该方法能够一致且成功地构造约束系统的标准拉格朗日和哈密顿描述。

title: A bulk--edge correspondence for two-dimensional self-adjoint boundary and interface problems
abstract: This paper analyzes the quantized asymmetric transport along the boundary of a two-dimensional topological insulator occupying a half plane, or along the interface separating two insulators. In contrast with problems posed on the Euclidean plane, terminating a sample requires a choice of self-adjointrealization, $H_L$, and we show that a quantized transport depends on that choice. The physical observable modeling the asymmetric transport is the edge, or interface, current $\sigma_I[H_L]=\Tr\,i[H_L,P]\varphi'(H_L)$. It is shown to be well defined along two routes. For Shapiro--Lopatinski elliptic realizations, we use estimates from Boutet de Monvel's calculus to show that the current observable is a well-defined trace, that $\mathcal I=2\pi\sigma_I[H_L]$ is a Fredholm index, and that it is stable under deformations and compactly supported changes of the operator and of its termination. For translation invariant operators along the edge, a spectral analysis defines $\mathcal I$ when the edge spectrum escapes a bulk gap at large momenta. $\mathcal I$ is then also a spectral flow and a Maslov index. Our main theorem is a bulk--edge correspondence \[ \mathcal I=\cR-\cR_L+\eta\bigl(L_\infty,\Lm^\Phi(+)\bigr)-\eta\bigl(L_\infty,\Lm^\Phi(-)\bigr), \] We determine the range of $\mathcal I$. We extend the formula to interfaces with arbitrary transmission conditions. At the transparent condition, the invariant equals the bulk-difference invariant of the Euclidean plane. Eight examples illustrate the theoretical findings.
summary:
本文分析了沿着占据半平面的二维拓扑绝缘体的边界或沿着分隔两个绝缘体的界面的量子化不对称输运。与欧几里得平面上提出的问题相反，终止样本需要选择自伴随实现 $H_L$，并且我们表明量化传输取决于该选择。模拟非对称传输的物理可观测值是边缘或界面，当前 $\sigma_I[H_L]=\Tr\,i[H_L,P]\varphi'(H_L)$。它被证明沿着两条路线被明确界定。对于 Shapiro--Lopatinski 椭圆实现，我们使用 Bouet de Monvel 微积分的估计来表明当前可观测值是一个明确定义的迹， $\mathcal I=2\pi\sigma_I[H_L]$ 是一个 Fredholm 指数，并且它在变形和紧支持算子及其终止的变化下是稳定的。对于沿边缘的平移不变算子，当边缘谱在大动量下逃逸块间隙时，谱分析定义$\mathcal I$。 $\mathcal I$ 也是一个谱流和一个马斯洛夫指数。

我们的主要定理是块边对应 \[ \mathcal I=\cR-\cR_L+\eta\bigl(L_\infty,\Lm^\Phi(+)\bigr)-\eta\bigl(L_\infty,\Lm^\Phi(-)\bigr), \] 我们确定 $\mathcal I$ 的范围。我们将该公式扩展到具有任意传输条件的接口。在透明条件下，不变量等于欧几里得平面的体差不变量。八个例子说明了理论发现。

title: On the signaling dimension of the cross-polytope
abstract: In the general probabilistic model of information theory, the signaling dimension of a given communication protocol (or, equivalently, of its state space) is the smallest possible complexity of a classical communication protocol capable of perfectly simulating the given one in terms of input-output correlations. The signaling dimensions of three-, four-, and five-dimensional cross-polytopes have been known to be 3. We give an upper and a lower bound for signaling dimensions of higher dimensional cross-polytopes.
summary: 在信息论的一般概率模型中，给定通信协议（或者等效地，其状态空间）的信令维度是能够在输入输出相关性方面完美模拟给定通信协议的经典通信协议的最小可能复杂度。已知三维、四维和五维交叉多胞体的信号维度为3。我们给出了更高维度交叉多胞体的信号维度的上限和下限。

title: Asymptotically free solutions of the scalar flow equations
abstract: We analyse solutions of the flow equations of the renormalisation group for the n-point Schwinger functions of scalar field theory in four-dimensional Euclidean space with nonpolynomial boundary conditions. We show that there exist UV asymptotically free solutions of this type which are Bose symmetric, invariant under the Euclidean group, analytic in the flow parameter and the momenta, and satisfy the Osterwalder-Schrader growth condition.
summary: 我们分析了具有非多项式边界条件的四维欧几里得空间中标量场理论的 n 点施温格函数的重正化群流动方程的解。我们证明存在这种类型的UV渐近自由解，它是玻色对称的，在欧几里得群下不变，在流动参数和动量上是解析的，并且满足Osterwalder-Schrader增长条件。

title: Entropy Contraction and Hypercontractivity for Gaussian Quantum Markov Semigroups
abstract: In this paper, we study finite-mode Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups with a faithful invariant Gaussian state. We present an algebraic characterization of the complete modified logarithmic Sobolev inequality relative to the fixed-point algebra, and we obtain the corresponding optimal constant under the assumption that the drift evolution $e^{t\mathbf{Z}}$ converges as $t\to\infty$. We establish hypercontractivity for such quantum Markov semigroups with Hurwitz drift, in the sense that every fixed pair $1<p<q<\infty$ is attained at sufficiently large times. We find that the usual reverse hypercontractive curves with a positive rate from time zero can fail in general, but every fixed pair $1/2 < p < q < 1$ is attained at sufficiently large times under the Hurwitz assumption. We also systematically investigate the $p$-logarithmic Sobolev inequality and show that the $p$-logarithmic Sobolev constant can be negative for $0 < p < 1/2$.
summary: 在本文中，我们研究具有忠实不变高斯态的有限模式高斯量子马尔可夫半群。我们提出了相对于定点代数的完整修正对数 Sobolev 不等式的代数表征，并在漂移演化 $e^{t\mathbf{Z}}$ 收敛为 $t\to\infty$ 的假设下获得了相应的最优常数。我们建立了带有 Hurwitz 漂移的量子马尔可夫半群的超收缩性，从某种意义上说，每个固定对 $1<p<q<\infty$ 都是在足够长的时间达到的。我们发现，从时间零开始具有正速率的通常反向超收缩曲线通常会失败，但在 Hurwitz 假设下，每个固定对 $1/2 < p < q < 1$ 都可以在足够长的时间内获得。我们还系统地研究了 $p$-对数 Sobolev 不等式，并表明 $p$-对数 Sobolev 常数在 $0 < p < 1/2$ 时可以为负。

title: Quantum Fluctuations in Bose--Einstein Condensates:Microscopic Correlations and Moment Bounds
abstract: We study higher moments of quantum fluctuations and microscopic correlation energy in the three-dimensional Gross--Pitaevskii regime. For a smooth, compactly supported, nonnegative radial interaction and an $N$-independent normalized initial condensate wave function in $H^6$, we propagate the third spectral moment of a positive correlated energy along the exact many-body evolution. A uniform initial bound controls the third moment of the depletion number and sixth moments of collective one-particle fluctuations on every compact time interval, independently of $N$. For a nonzero interaction and a smooth, compactly supported initial condensate, we also identify the excitation-energy measure at scale $N^2$, weighted by the first energy. This limit holds for norm-convergent pure-state families with a uniform bound on the initial third correlated-energy moment. Its positive-energy part is a spectral measure of the relative scattering operator $-2\Delta+v$, multiplied by a time-dependent dressed contact. We compute the radial density and prove strict positivity of the contact for nonzero references with finite kinetic energy and finite mean excitation number. The same evolving states have bounded physical fluctuation moments and excitation-energy moments of order $p>1$ bounded below by a positive multiple of $N^{2p-2}$, in the extended spectral sense. Inverse powers of the positive initial energy construct admissible pure and mixed families. For the norm-convergent pure-state class, we determine the scaled interaction-energy moments for $1\le p<2$ and bound the second moment by $O(N^2)$. A finite cubic approximation has norm error $O(N^{-3/16})$ on the energy form domain and $O(N^{-5/4})$ on a stronger initial domain of its generator.
summary:
我们研究了三维 Gross-Pitaevskii 体系中量子涨落的高阶矩和微观相关能。对于 $H^6$ 中的平滑、紧支撑、非负径向相互作用和 $N$ 独立的归一化初始凝聚波函数，我们沿着精确的多体演化传播正相关能量的第三谱矩。统一的初始边界控制每个紧凑时间间隔上的耗尽数的第三矩和集体单粒子涨落的第六矩，与 $N$ 无关。对于非零相互作用和平滑、紧支撑的初始凝聚体，我们还确定了 $N^2$ 尺度的激发能量测量，并由第一个能量加权。该限制适用于范数收敛的纯态族，在初始第三相关能量矩上具有统一的界限。其正能量部分是相对散射算子 $-2\Delta+v$ 的光谱测量，乘以时间相关的修饰接触。我们计算径向密度并证明具有有限动能和有限平均激发数的非零参考的接触的严格正性。

在扩展谱意义上，相同的演化态具有 $p>1$ 阶的物理涨落矩和激发能量矩，其下界为 $N^{2p-2}$ 的正倍数。正初始能量的倒数幂构造了可接受的纯族和混合族。对于范数收敛的纯态类，我们确定 $1\le p<2$ 的缩放相互作用能矩，并将第二个矩限制为 $O(N^2)$。有限三次近似在能量形式域上具有范数误差 $O(N^{-3/16})$，在其生成器的更强初始域上具有 $O(N^{-5/4})$。

title: Electrostatic inequalities and stability of matter on asymptotically Euclidean manifolds
abstract: We prove stability of nonrelativistic fermionic matter in the presence of fixed nuclei \(\{R_j\}\) on an asymptotically Euclidean Riemannian manifold \((M,g)\). Upper and lower bounds on sectional curvatures are assumed, but no specific sign conditions on the curvature are imposed. The proof follows the route of Lieb-Thirring and electrostatic inequalities, the latter being proved by means of a Voronoi decomposition type argument which is however based on the Green functions \(\{G(\,\cdot\,,R_j)\}\) rather than the distance function.
summary: 我们证明了渐近欧几里德黎曼流形 \((M,g)\) 上固定核 \(\{R_j\}\) 存在时非相对论费米子物质的稳定性。假设了截面曲率的上限和下限，但没有对曲率施加特定的符号条件。证明遵循 Lieb-Thirring 和静电不等式的路线，后者通过 Voronoi 分解型论证来证明，但该论证基于格林函数 \(\{G(\,\cdot\,,R_j)\}\) 而不是距离函数。

title: A Cohomological Characterization of the Clifford Hierarchy
abstract: The Clifford hierarchy plays a central role in fault-tolerant quantum computation, but its higher levels remain only partially understood. Recent work on quantum higher order Fourier analysis characterizes membership in the Clifford hierarchy using quantum derivatives, but does not provide an explicit description of the individual levels. In this work, we address this problem by showing that the collection of quantum derivatives of a unitary operator forms a non-abelian \(1\)-cocycle, and conversely that every such \(1\)-cocycle arises from a unitary operator. This yields a recursive cohomological characterization of the Clifford hierarchy. We then specialize this framework to the third level and decompose the cocycle data into symplectic, affine, and phase components, each admitting a cohomological interpretation. As applications, we give a new proof that every two-qudit gate in the third level of the Clifford hierarchy is semi-Clifford, and prove for the first time that every three-qudit gate in the third level is semi-Clifford.
summary: Clifford 层次结构在容错量子计算中发挥着核心作用，但其更高层次仍然只有部分被理解。最近关于量子高阶傅里叶分析的工作使用量子导数来表征 Clifford 层次结构中的成员资格，但没有提供各个级别的明确描述。在这项工作中，我们通过证明酉算子的量子导数的集合形成一个非阿贝尔 \(1\)-余循环来解决这个问题，相反，每个这样的 \(1\)-余循环都来自于一个酉算子。这产生了 Clifford 层次结构的递归上同调特征。然后，我们将该框架专门化到第三层，并将余循环数据分解为辛、仿射和相位分量，每个分量都接受上同调解释。作为应用，我们给出了Clifford层次结构第三层中的每个二量子体门都是半Clifford的新证明，并首次证明了第三层中的每个三量子体门都是半Clifford。

title: The Quantum Sphere: A Physically Realizable Optimization Benchmark with Provable Linear Convergence in White- and Black-Box Settings
abstract: We revisit an established Quantum Control objective, characterize its exact local metric geometry, and reposition it as a rigorous benchmark for Search and Optimization. The trap-free topology of the landscape, established two decades ago, guarantees unhindered optimal pathways, but global topology alone does not govern convergence speed. Although the so-called Quantum Sphere is defined by the fourth power of the control field, we show that its yield gap admits an exact representation as a nonnegative linear combination of $\sin^2$ terms. From this single identity, we derive a two-sided quadratic sandwich with ratio $4/\pi^2$ on a certified, worst-case quarter-wave region, proving the optimal peak nondegenerate modulo its affine gauge and well-conditioned. For white-box optimization, on a halved (eighth-wave) region, the objective satisfies a Polyak-Łojasiewicz inequality with an explicit constant, granting Gradient Descent a linear rate of $1 - 16/(\pi^4\kappa_r)$, where $\kappa_r$ is the condition number of the relevant Hessian block. For black-box optimization, we prove that the elitist single-parent Evolution Strategy converges linearly, almost surely and in expected hitting time, from a certified sublevel set, despite the landscape's continuous gauge symmetry and its lattice of periodic optima; the certified level is explicit whenever the landscape is trap-free, and near the optimum the strategy provably sees only the quadratic tangent of the peak. Systematic numerical simulations corroborate the theory. Finally, we show that additive input (actuator) noise reweights each term of the representation by a Debye-Waller factor without disrupting the landscape's structure, and outline open challenges: output (signal) noise, far-field plateau escape, angular-synchronization certificates, and another physically scalable benchmark (SHG with Glass).
summary:
我们重新审视既定的量子控制目标，描述其精确的局部度量几何形状，并将其重新定位为搜索和优化的严格基准。二十年前建立的无陷阱拓扑保证了不受阻碍的最佳路径，但全局拓扑本身并不能控制收敛速度。尽管所谓的量子球是由控制场的四次方定义的，但我们表明它的产率差距允许精确表示为 $\sin^2$ 项的非负线性组合。从这个单一恒等式中，我们在经过认证的最坏情况四分之一波区域上推导出比率为 $4/\pi^2$ 的双面二次三明治，证明了最佳峰值非简并模其仿射规范和条件良好。对于白盒优化，在减半（第八波）区域上，目标满足具有显式常数的 Polyak-Łojasiewicz 不等式，使梯度下降的线性速率为 $1 - 16/(\pi^4\kappa_r)$，其中 $\kappa_r$ 是相关 Hessian 块的条件数。

对于黑盒优化，我们证明了精英单亲进化策略几乎可以肯定地在预期的命中时间内从经过认证的子级别集线性收敛，尽管景观具有连续的规范对称性及其周期性最优的格子；当景观没有陷阱时，认证水平是明确的，并且接近最佳值时，该策略可以证明只能看到峰值的二次正切。系统的数值模拟证实了这一理论。最后，我们表明，加性输入（执行器）噪声通过 Debye-Waller 因子重新加权表示的每一项，而不会破坏景观的结构，并概述了开放的挑战：输出（信号）噪声、远场平台逃逸、角度同步证书和另一个物理可扩展基准（SHG with Glass）。

title: Generalised Bit-Vector Abstractions for Formal Verification of Quantum Error-Detection and Entanglement Circuits over {H,X,C-NOT}: CSS Constructions, Soundness, and Mutation-Based Validation
abstract: Formal verification of quantum circuits becomes difficult as circuit size grows because exhaustive reasoning over the Hilbert space is computationally expensive. In previous work [1], we introduced a bit-vector abstraction that separates superposition tracking from basis-state behavior, enabling SMT-based verification of fixed-size error-detection and entanglement circuits built from H, X, and C-NOT gates. This paper extends the framework in five directions. First, we generalise correctness properties to parametrised repetition and concatenated phase-flip codes with up to 101 logical elements. Second, we verify syndrome extraction for CSS codes specified by arbitrary parity-check matrices, including the Steane, [[15,7,3]] Hamming, [[15,1,3]] Reed-Muller, and rotated surface codes with distances up to 101. We consider arbitrary error patterns, detection up to a specified weight, and recovery using a classical decoder, with counterexamples beyond each code's correction or detection capability. Third, we characterize the {H,X,C-NOT} fragment for which the abstraction faithfully represents Hilbert-space semantics. We prove soundness, demonstrate necessity with counterexamples, validate the characterisation against state-vector simulation, and prove the six lemmas from the original work. Fourth, a mutation study using 13 operators identifies equivalent mutants and detects all 622 non-equivalent mutants within the evaluated fault model. Fifth, a direct Z3 implementation verifies GHZ circuits with up to 262,144 qubits across three topologies on a 16GB laptop. Random H+C-NOT networks show verification cost rises sharply with depth when outputs depend on many inputs. The approach does not target general stabilizer circuits, Y-type stabilizers, fault-tolerant protocols, or physical noise; we identify extensions needed to address these cases.
summary:
随着电路尺寸的增大，量子电路的形式验证变得困难，因为希尔伯特空间上的详尽推理的计算成本很高。在之前的工作 [1] 中，我们引入了一种位向量抽象，它将叠加跟踪与基本状态行为分开，从而能够对由 H、X 和 C 非门构建的固定大小错误检测和纠缠电路进行基于 SMT 的验证。本文从五个方向扩展了该框架。首先，我们将正确性属性推广到参数化重复和具有最多 101 个逻辑元素的级联相位翻转码。其次，我们验证由任意奇偶校验矩阵指定的 CSS 代码的综合症提取，包括 Steane、[[15,7,3]] Hamming、[[15,1,3]] Reed-Muller 和距离高达 101 的旋转表面代码。我们考虑任意错误模式、高达指定权重的检测以及使用经典解码器的恢复，并提供超出每个代码的校正或检测能力的反例。第三，我们描述了 {H,X,C-NOT} 片段，其抽象忠实地表示了希尔伯特空间语义。

我们证明了合理性，用反例证明了必要性，根据状态向量模拟验证了表征，并证明了原始工作中的六个引理。第四，使用 13 个算子的突变研究识别等效突变体并检测评估故障模型内的所有 622 个非等效突变体。第五，直接 Z3 实现可在 16GB 笔记本电脑上跨三种拓扑验证具有高达 262,144 个量子位的 GHZ 电路。随机 H+C-NOT 网络表明，当输出依赖于许多输入时，验证成本会随着深度而急剧上升。该方法不针对通用稳定器电路、Y型稳定器、容错协议或物理噪声；我们确定解决这些情况所需的扩展。

title: Exponentially Compressed and Garbage-Free Alias Sampling for Polynomial State Preparation
abstract: Coherent alias sampling implement an important subroutine for block encoding and qubitization based quantum simulation using quantum lookup table. Related constructions exploit data lookup and matrix structure to implement block encodings for use in quantum singular value transformation. For a state on $n$ qubits, constructing and storing the alias table requires both classical and quantum resources exponential in $n$. We show that when the amplitudes are samples of a polynomial of degree at most $d$, the table can be represented and evaluated coherently with cost polynomial in $n$, $d$, exponentially reduced from $\Theta(2^n)$ classical and quantum cost. We construct a quantum circuit for coherently computing the alias table for polynomial states using reversible integer arithmetic. By employing fast arithmetic, we construct a deterministic circuit for preparing polynomial states over Clifford+$T$ with a complete gate count of $\tilde{O}(ndB+B^2)$, where arithmetic width $B=\tilde{O}(dn+d\log(d+1))$. In the high precision limit for state fidelity $\epsilon$ with fixed $n$ and $d$, it is sufficient have $B=\Theta(\log(1/\epsilon))$ and the complete gate count becomes $O(\log^3(1/\epsilon)\log\log(1/\epsilon))$. Additionally, the effective representation of the alias table can also be used for classical sampling algorithms. Furthermore, we develop a novel technique for uncomputing the auxilary register generated by coherent alias sampling. This technique opens a research direction in sampling based initial state preparation.
summary:
相干别名采样使用量子查找表实现了基于块编码和量子位化的量子模拟的重要子程序。相关构造利用数据查找和矩阵结构来实现用于量子奇异值变换的块编码。对于 $n$ 量子位上的状态，构建和存储别名表需要以 $n$ 为指数的经典资源和量子资源。我们证明，当振幅是次数最多为 $d$ 的多项式样本时，该表可以用 $n$、$d$ 中的成本多项式一致地表示和评估，从 $\Theta(2^n)$ 经典成本和量子成本呈指数减少。我们构建了一个量子电路，用于使用可逆整数算术连贯地计算多项式状态的别名表。通过采用快速算术，我们构建了一个确定性电路，用于在 Clifford+$T$ 上准备多项式状态，完整的门数为 $\tilde{O}(ndB+B^2)$，其中算术宽度 $B=\tilde{O}(dn+d\log(d+1))$。

在固定 $n$ 和 $d$ 的状态保真度 $\epsilon$ 的高精度限制中，有 $B=\Theta(\log(1/\epsilon))$ 就足够了，完整的门计数变为 $O(\log^3(1/\epsilon)\log\log(1/\epsilon))$。此外，别名表的有效表示也可用于经典采样算法。此外，我们开发了一种新技术来取消计算相干别名采样生成的辅助寄存器。该技术开辟了基于采样的初始状态准备的研究方向。

title: Driven-Dissipative Ground State Preparation: Mixing Time and Randomness
abstract: Dissipative protocols offer a route to ground state preparation that does not require a large initial overlap with the ground state. To move beyond time independent Lindbladians and randomized Lindbladians sampled from a fixed distribution, we study driven-dissipative protocols in which the generator varies over time. Our construction uses a family of randomized Lindbladians whose jump operators are obtained by averaging the unitary evolution of random matrices under a fixed target Hamiltonian. We show that empirical averages of these Lindbladians drive arbitrary initial density matrices to low energy states. The resulting mixing time bounds depend on the Hamiltonian only through its eigenvalue distribution and remain valid even for cold starts.
summary: 耗散协议提供了一种不需要与基态有大量初始重叠的基态准备途径。为了超越时间无关的 Lindbladians 和从固定分布中采样的随机 Lindbladians，我们研究了驱动耗散协议，其中生成器随时间变化。我们的构造使用一系列随机 Lindbladians，其跳跃算子是通过在固定目标哈密顿量下对随机矩阵的酉演化进行平均而获得的。我们证明了这些 Lindbladians 的经验平均值将任意初始密度矩阵驱动到低能态。由此产生的混合时间界限仅取决于哈密顿量的特征值分布，并且即使在冷启动时也保持有效。

title: Realizing Braided Fusion 2-Categories as (3+1)D Mixed-State Topological Orders
abstract: We construct large families of mixed-state topological orders in (3+1)D, including intrinsically mixed-state topological orders. We realize these theories by relating the data parameterizing braided fusion 2-categories to the strong higher-form symmetries and their anomalies that characterize mixed-state topological order. We focus here on bosonic theories, which include theories which admit an emergent fermion in the spectrum of line operators. Our general framework is exemplified on the lattice, where we present concrete models and identify how the data of braided fusion 2-categories are physically encoded. We then formalize this data and show that every braided fusion 2-category arises from a general construction (decoherence followed by strong and weak gauging) as the category of topological operators of a (3+1)D mixed state, with intrinsically mixed-state topological orders distinguished by the presence of strong higher-form symmetries whose anomalies cannot be realized in any (3+1)D gapped ground state. Notably, we show that (3+1)D admits a new mechanism with no (2+1)D counterpart: intrinsically mixed-state order whose topological operators braid non-degenerately, but which carries a gravitational anomaly.
summary:
我们在 (3+1)D 中构造了大族混合态拓扑序，包括本质上混合态拓扑序。我们通过将参数化编织融合 2 类别的数据与表征混合状态拓扑顺序的强高级形式对称性及其异常相关联来实现这些理论。我们在这里关注玻色子理论，其中包括承认线算符谱中出现涌现费米子的理论。我们的总体框架在点阵上进行了举例说明，其中我们提出了具体模型并确定了编织融合 2 类别的数据如何进行物理编码。然后，我们将这些数据形式化，并表明每个编织融合 2 类别都源自作为 (3+1)D 混合态拓扑算子类别的一般结构（退相干，然后是强和弱测量），其本质上混合态拓扑顺序的特征是存在强更高形式的对称性，其异常不能在任何 (3+1)D 有隙基态中实现。

值得注意的是，我们证明 (3+1)D 承认一种没有 (2+1)D 对应物的新机制：本质上混合状态的顺序，其拓扑算子非简并编织，但带有重力异常。

title: On Information Propagation in Krylov Subspaces
abstract: Krylov subspace methods provide an efficient tool for modeling any quantum initial value problem as a one dimensional chain. A time ordered path formulation, in which the dynamical generator successively splits probability between paths, yields a speed limit within such dynamical subspaces. For power law growing Lanczos coefficients $b_n \sim n^\delta$ we find super ballistic lightcones, with an exponentially spreading lightcone for maximal growth $\delta = 1$. Causality in the Krylov chain constrains the Lanczos coefficients to grow at most linearly. We illustrate the validity of the above in the $SL(2, R)$ and Heisenberg Weyl algebras, and in a many body skew field Ising model. Moreover, we extend the above bound to the family of $Q$ complexities. Lastly, mapping to a spin chain gives a Lieb Robinson bound analogue and opens the problem to standard condensed matter methods.
summary: Krylov 子空间方法提供了一种有效的工具，可以将任何量子初始值问题建模为一维链。时间排序路径公式（其中动态生成器连续分割路径之间的概率）在此类动态子空间内产生速度限制。对于幂律增长的 Lanczos 系数 $b_n \sim n^\delta$，我们发现超级弹道光锥，具有指数扩展的光锥以实现最大增长 $\delta = 1$。 Krylov 链中的因果关系限制 Lanczos 系数最多线性增长。我们在 $SL(2, R)$ 和 Heisenberg Weyl 代数以及多体偏斜场 Ising 模型中说明了上述的有效性。此外，我们将上述限制扩展到 $Q$ 复杂性系列。最后，映射到自旋链给出了李布罗宾逊束缚类似物，并将问题开放给标准凝聚态方法。

title: Robustness of Quantum Signal Processing and Resource-aware Polynomial Design
abstract: Quantum signal processing (QSP) realizes operator functions through polynomial transformations of a finite degree. In addition to function approximation errors, realistic implementations incur algorithmic errors also when encoding the input operator and in synthesizing gates into a discrete fault-tolerant gate set. We provide an end-to-end analysis of these errors and show that the input error propagation is governed by the operator-Lipschitz constant $L_\star$ of the implemented function. We then derive an efficient classical algorithm to compute tight lower and upper bounds on $L_\star$, and we show that these bounds induce in turn lower and upper bounds on the total quantum-resource cost (for instance, $T$-gate count) needed for QSP implementations compatible with a target total error. We further devise a procedure to search for a polynomial with minimum cost based solely on its coefficients, yielding a resource-aware polynomial-design procedure for QSP. We illustrate the resulting method for ground state energy estimation via eigenvalue thresholding for the H$_6$ molecular Hamiltonian. In the tested hardware profiles, the resource-aware family improves the total-error budget and reduces the modeled $T$-gate count by $51.9\%$--$56.7\%$ relative to the standard analytical polynomial obtained from an error-function approximation.
summary:
量子信号处理（QSP）通过有限次多项式变换来实现算子函数。除了函数逼近错误之外，在对输入运算符进行编码以及将门合成为离散容错门集时，实际实现也会产生算法错误。我们对这些错误进行了端到端分析，并表明输入错误传播由已实现函数的算子 Lipschitz 常量 $L_\star$ 控制。然后，我们推导出一种有效的经典算法来计算 $L_\star$ 上的严格下限和上限，并且我们表明，这些界限反过来会导致与目标总误差兼容的 QSP 实现所需的总量子资源成本（例如，$T$ 门计数）的下限和上限。我们进一步设计了一个过程，仅根据其系数来搜索具有最小成本的多项式，从而产生 QSP 的资源感知多项式设计过程。我们通过 H$_6$ 分子哈密顿量的特征值阈值说明了基态能量估计的最终方法。

在测试的硬件配置文件中，相对于从误差函数近似获得的标准分析多项式，资源感知系列改进了总误差预算，并将建模的 $T$ 门计数减少了 $51.9\%$--$56.7\%$。

title: Exact Temporal Criticalities of Entanglement and Negativity in Gaussian and Non-Gaussian Dissipative Kitaev Chains
abstract: When the two largest eigenvalues of an entanglement or negativity spectrum meet, the gap of the corresponding entanglement or negativity Hamiltonian closes while entropies stay smooth, an event we call a temporal criticality. We ask when such criticalities occur in open fermionic systems, in which order, and whether they precede the geometric decoherence time, at which the negativity starts to fall. We compare loss and gain, which respect fermion parity only on average (weak symmetry) and keep the state Gaussian, with density dephasing, which respects it in every jump (strong symmetry) and makes the state non-Gaussian. We find that Gaussianity, rather than the symmetry, fixes the criterion for a criticality. In a Gaussian state the entanglement gap of a subsystem closes exactly when its two parity sectors carry equal weight, and the negativity gap closes exactly when this happens for the subsystem or its complement, so the negativity criticality never comes after the entanglement one. Uniform balanced loss and gain only shrink the two parities and leave both criticalities in place at every rate, for any quadratic Hamiltonian. In an open Kitaev chain, weak imbalanced loss and gain shift the criticalities by amounts set by the occupations at the cut, and at strong rates they allow a closing near the relaxation time only when an odd number of neighboring sites pass half filling. For dephasing we solve the non-Gaussian dynamics exactly at the point where the bond terms of the chain commute. Weak dephasing delays both criticalities and, away from the chain ends, moves them ahead of the parity balance, where the parity rules of Gaussian states would place them. As the dephasing rate approaches critical damping, both criticalities recede to infinite time, and at strong dephasing the negativity starts to fall long before either gap begins to shrink.
summary:
当纠缠或负谱的两个最大特征值相遇时，相应纠缠或负性哈密顿量的间隙闭合，同时熵保持平滑，我们将这种事件称为时间临界性。我们询问这种临界何时出现在开放费米子系统中，以何种顺序出现，以及它们是否先于负性开始下降的几何退相干时间。我们比较损失和增益，它仅平均尊重费米子宇称（弱对称性）并保持状态高斯，而密度相移则在每次跳跃时尊重它（强对称性）并使状态非高斯。我们发现高斯性而不是对称性确定了临界性的标准。在高斯状态下，子系统的纠缠间隙恰好在其两个奇偶扇区具有相同权重时闭合，而负间隙恰好在子系统或其补体发生这种情况时闭合，因此负临界性永远不会出现在纠缠之后。对于任何二次哈密顿量，均匀平衡的损失和增益只会缩小两个奇偶性，并在每个速率下保留两个临界点。

在开放的基塔耶夫链中，弱的不平衡损失和增益会根据削减时的职业设定的数量来改变临界点，并且在强速率下，只有当奇数个相邻站点通过半填充时，它们才允许在松弛时间附近关闭。对于移相，我们精确地在链键项交换点处求解非高斯动力学。弱相移会延迟这两个临界点，并且远离链端，将它们移到奇偶平衡之前，即高斯态的奇偶规则将它们放置在奇偶平衡之前。当失相速率接近临界阻尼时，两个临界值都会后退到无限时间，并且在强失相时，负值在任一间隙开始缩小之前很久就开始下降。

title: Efficient Quantum Monte Carlo through Cluster Expansions
abstract: The sign problem remains a major obstacle to extending the success of Monte Carlo methods to generic quantum many-body systems. A powerful alternative relies on cluster expansions, which provide convergent representations of free energies and related quantities, with applications ranging from tensor network contractions to quantum dynamics and circuits. Within their convergence regime, these expansions often yield deterministic polynomial-time algorithms. However, such methods require exhaustive enumeration of connected clusters, leading to a computational overhead of $(N\varepsilon^{-1})^{\mathcal{O}(\log\Delta)}$, where $N$ is the system size, $\varepsilon$ the desired precision, and $\Delta$ the interaction-graph degree. This becomes particularly severe in long-range systems, where $\Delta\equiv N$, resulting in quasi-polynomial runtimes. Here, we introduce a Markov chain algorithm that samples cluster expansions directly in the space of connected clusters, replacing deterministic enumeration by Monte Carlo sampling. Because sampling occurs in an abstract cluster space rather than a physical configuration space, the conventional exponential sign problem is absent within the convergence regime. For general polymer models, we establish an FPRAS with runtime $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^4\varepsilon^{-3})$. For quantum partition functions at temperatures $\beta\leq\beta_{\mathrm{sampling}}\equiv\mathcal{O}(1)$, this improves to $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^{3+1/D}\varepsilon^{-3})$, where $D$ is the lattice dimension. The framework directly applies to long-range quantum systems with interactions $\propto1/r^\alpha$, including $2$-local models with $\alpha>2D$.
summary:
符号问题仍然是将蒙特卡罗方法的成功扩展到通用量子多体系统的主要障碍。一个强大的替代方案依赖于簇扩展，它提供自由能和相关量的收敛表示，其应用范围从张量网络收缩到量子动力学和电路。在其收敛机制内，这些扩展通常会产生确定性多项式时间算法。然而，此类方法需要对连接的簇进行详尽的枚举，从而导致计算开销为 $(N\varepsilon^{-1})^{\mathcal{O}(\log\Delta)}$，其中 $N$ 是系统大小，$\varepsilon$ 是所需的精度，$\Delta$ 是交互图度。这在远程系统中变得尤其严重，其中 $\Delta\equiv N$，导致拟多项式运行时间。在这里，我们引入了一种马尔可夫链算法，该算法直接在连接的簇的空间中对簇扩展进行采样，用蒙特卡罗采样代替确定性枚举。

由于采样发生在抽象簇空间而不是物理配置空间中，因此收敛机制中不存在传统的指数符号问题。对于一般的聚合物模型，我们建立一个运行时 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^4\varepsilon^{-3})$ 的 FPRAS。对于温度 $\beta\leq\beta_{\mathrm{sampling}}\equiv\mathcal{O}(1)$ 下的量子配分函数，这改进为 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^{3+1/D}\varepsilon^{-3})$，其中 $D$ 是晶格维度。该框架直接适用于具有 $\propto1/r^\alpha$ 相互作用的远程量子系统，包括 $\alpha>2D$ 的 $2$-局部模型。

title: Quantum Query Complexity and Span Programs from Pre-Geometry
abstract: Span programs provide a general method for designing quantum query algorithms, and for Boolean coordinate queries their optimum cost agrees with the general adversary bound. We develop a matroidal organization of this optimization that separates dependence data determined by the query problem from the dependence structure chosen by a span program. The resulting source matroid records query dependence, target determination, and separation data, while a program matroid records dependencies among the target and response-labeled input elements of a candidate program. When a query problem admits a source matroid, we use its structure to organize adversary upper and lower bounds. For separating binary query sets in this setting, the global matroid-span-program optimum equals $\mathrm{Adv}^{\pm}_{\mathcal Q}(f)$. For a fixed regular program matroid, projective uniqueness reduces optimization over real representations to positive element weights. We express positive and negative costs as weighted basis ratios and derive exact $1$-, $2$-, and $3$-sum reductions, giving a compositional evaluation of the fixed-weight objective along a Seymour decomposition. For pointed $R_{10}$ closure, exact certificates give $3.9087553<\mathrm{Adv}^{\pm}_{\mathcal Q_R}(f_R)<3.9301$. The natural $R_{10}$ program has optimized cost $5$, while another regular program has cost at most $\sqrt{87/5}$. Recursive self-composition yields a family on $N$ input bits with randomized query complexity $\Omega(N^{0.7324867\ldots})$, an explicit quantum algorithm using $O(N^{0.6500178\ldots})$ queries, and $Q(F)=\Theta(N^\alpha)$ for $0.6204277\ldots<\alpha<0.6229063\ldots$.
summary:
Span 程序提供了设计量子查询算法的通用方法，对于布尔坐标查询，其最佳成本与一般对手的界限一致。我们开发了这种优化的矩阵组织，它将查询问题确定的依赖数据与跨度程序选择的依赖结构分开。生成的源拟阵记录查询依赖性、目标确定和分离数据，而程序拟阵记录候选程序的目标和响应标记的输入元素之间的依赖性。当查询问题承认源拟阵时，我们使用其结构来组织对手的上限和下限。为了在此设置中分离二进制查询集，全局 matroid-span-program 最优值等于 $\mathrm{Adv}^{\pm}_{\mathcal Q}(f)$。对于固定的常规程序拟阵，投影唯一性减少了对正元素权重的实际表示的优化。我们将正成本和负成本表示为加权基础比率，并得出精确的 1 美元、2 美元和 3 美元总和减少量，从而沿着 Seymour 分解对固定权重目标进行组合评估。

对于指向 $R_{10}$ 闭包，精确证书给出 $3.9087553<\mathrm{Adv}^{\pm}_{\mathcal Q_R}(f_R)<3.9301$。自然的$R_{10}$程序的优化成本为$5$，而另一个常规程序的成本最多为$\sqrt{87/5}$。递归自组合在 $N$ 个输入位上生成一个族，具有随机查询复杂度 $\Omega(N^{0.7324867\ldots})$，这是一种使用 $O(N^{0.6500178\ldots})$ 查询的显式量子算法，以及 $Q(F)=\Theta(N^\alpha)$ $0.6204277\ldots<\alpha<0.6229063\ldots$。

title: Benchmarking Ansatze for Pauli Correlation Encoding in the Maximum Independent Set Problem
abstract: The increasing complexity of 5G and emerging 6G wireless networks has intensified the need for scalable optimization techniques capable of addressing computationally challenging combinatorial problems. While quantum optimization offers a promising alternative, current near-term quantum hardware remains limited by qubit availability, noise, and scalability constraints. Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE) has emerged as a qubit-efficient optimization framework that addresses these challenges through polynomial variable compression. However, the impact of compression on representability and solution recovery remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the hypothesis that increasing compression ratios introduce representability constraints arising from algebraic closure relationships among encoded Pauli observables. Using Maximum Independent Set benchmark problems, we evaluate multiple PCE ansatz designs and compression ratios. We find that ansatz selection is critical to both solution quality and feasibility, with two ansatz families consistently outperforming alternatives and achieving approximation ratios approaching 0.9. Furthermore, increasing circuit repetitions provides limited benefit and can degrade performance. Most notably, reducing compression by increasing the number of available qubits significantly improves raw solution quality, while post-processed performance remains comparatively stable. These findings suggest that representability effects play an important role in compressed PCE encodings and provide new insight into the relationship among compression, ansatz design, decoding, and solution quality in scalable quantum optimization.
summary:
5G 和新兴 6G 无线网络的复杂性日益增加，加剧了对能够解决计算上具有挑战性的组合问题的可扩展优化技术的需求。虽然量子优化提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但当前的近期量子硬件仍然受到量子位可用性、噪声和可扩展性约束的限制。泡利相关编码 (PCE) 已成为一种量子位高效优化框架，通过多项式变量压缩解决这些挑战。然而，压缩对可表示性和解恢复的影响仍然知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们研究了这样一个假设：增加压缩比会引入由编码泡利可观测量之间的代数闭包关系引起的可表示性约束。使用最大独立集基准问题，我们评估了多个 PCE ansatz 设计和压缩比。我们发现 ansatz 选择对于解决方案质量和可行性都至关重要，两个 ansatz 系列始终优于替代方案，并实现接近 0.9 的近似比率。

此外，增加电路重复次数带来的好处有限，并且会降低性能。最值得注意的是，通过增加可用量子位的数量来减少压缩可以显着提高原始解决方案的质量，同时后处理的性能保持相对稳定。这些发现表明，可表示性效应在压缩 PCE 编码中发挥着重要作用，并为可扩展量子优化中压缩、模拟设计、解码和解决方案质量之间的关系提供了新的见解。

title: Certification failure in variational-principle observables
abstract: Algorithms which prepare states via the variational principle assume that closeness in energy implies closeness in state; we formalise how this assumption can fail by showing that a ground-state energy estimate converged to within $\epsilon$ of the true value is compatible with observable expectation values in error by up to $\sqrt{2\epsilon\chi_O}$ at leading order, where $\chi_O$ is the static susceptibility of the observable. As a result, the observable error can be orders of magnitude larger than the energy error, a mechanism we call non-linear error amplification, and because a variational algorithm cannot guarantee the correctness of these properties from energy alone, energy does not necessarily certify an observable. In light of our findings, we examine three algorithms: the variational quantum eigensolver on the transverse-field Ising chain, the density-matrix renormalisation group on a pair of weakly coupled hydrogen chains, and Krylov quantum diagonalisation on lithium fluoride. In each case we demonstrate that a well-converged energy can leave observables uncertified.
summary: 通过变分原理准备状态的算法假设能量接近意味着状态接近；我们通过证明收敛到真实值 $\epsilon$ 范围内的基态能量估计与可观测期望值兼容，误差高达 $\sqrt{2\epsilon\chi_O}$ 领先顺序，来形式化这一假设如何失败，其中 $\chi_O$ 是可观测值的静态磁化率。因此，可观测误差可能比能量误差大几个数量级，这种机制我们称之为非线性误差放大，并且由于变分算法无法仅从能量来保证这些属性的正确性，因此能量并不一定能证明可观测值。根据我们的发现，我们研究了三种算法：横向场伊辛链上的变分量子本征解算器、一对弱耦合氢链上的密度矩阵重正化群以及氟化锂上的克雷洛夫量子对角化。在每种情况下，我们都证明，良好收敛的能量可能会使可观测值未经证实。

title: Accelerated search for global extrema in structured quantum signals
abstract: Extreme values of a physical system are rare by definition, yet they can govern some of its most consequential and anomalous behavior. Their sparsity makes them particularly costly to identify in large data sets. Quantum computation offers a potential way to reduce this cost. The challenge is that quantum amplitudes cannot simply be read, copied, compared, or marked using conventional search oracles. Here we introduce an algorithm for searching amplitude-encoded quantum signals that exploits their underlying structure. Through a nonlinear amplitude transformation, the algorithm identifies and certifies a global extremum while exponentially reducing the effective search space for structured signals. We establish a polylogarithmic query complexity in the data size $N$, together with global completeness, efficient classical verification, and a measurable criterion for quantifying exploitable structure. We demonstrate the framework using computational turbulence data. Applied to line cuts of velocity gradients from a $1024^3$ simulation containing more than one billion grid points, the algorithm consistently isolates the extreme tail and reduces the median search space to $O(\log N)$. The clustered structure characteristic of turbulence further accelerates the search. These results establish a direct connection between physical structure and quantum advantage in extreme-value search. For accessibility, the main text emphasizes the central ideas and results, while the theoretical derivations are provided in the Appendices.
summary:
根据定义，物理系统的极值很少见，但它们可以控制其一些最重要和异常的行为。它们的稀疏性使得在大型数据集中识别它们的成本特别高。量子计算提供了一种降低这种成本的潜在方法。挑战在于量子振幅不能简单地使用传统的搜索神谕来读取、复制、比较或标记。在这里，我们介绍一种用于搜索幅度编码量子信号的算法，该算法利用其底层结构。通过非线性幅度变换，该算法识别并验证全局极值，同时以指数方式减少结构化信号的有效搜索空间。我们建立了数据大小 $N$ 的多对数查询复杂性，以及全局完整性、高效的经典验证以及用于量化可利用结构的可测量标准。我们使用计算湍流数据演示了该框架。该算法应用于包含超过 10 亿个网格点的 1024^3$ 模拟的速度梯度线切割，始终隔离极端尾部并将中值搜索空间减少到 $O(\log N)$。

湍流的簇状结构特征进一步加快了搜索速度。这些结果在极值搜索中建立了物理结构和量子优势之间的直接联系。为了便于理解，正文强调中心思想和结果，而理论推导则在附录中提供。

title: Modal input-output theory for quantum nanophotonics from the first-order Maxwell operator
abstract: We develop a quantum input-output theory for open photonic systems based on macroscopic quantum electrodynamics using the first-order electromagnetic Green's function. Quantum fields enter and leave the photonic system through waveguide ports, while the electromagnetic Green's function propagates the fields through the arbitrary interior of the photonic system, which may be dispersive and absorbing. The resulting relation contains a port-to-port scattering matrix and a Langevin-noise contribution from material absorption that together preserve the bosonic output commutation relations. For embedded emitters, the low-saturation and single-excitation scattering response is determined by Green's functions connecting the ports and emitters while retaining the non-Markovianity of the photonic environment. Using finite-difference time-domain simulation, we calculate the emitter-modified transmission for a nanophotonic cavity and inverse-designed coupler, providing a direct route from computed electromagnetic response to a quantum input-output model.
summary: 我们利用一阶电磁格林函数，基于宏观量子电动力学，开发了开放光子系统的量子输入输出理论。量子场通过波导端口进入和离开光子系统，而电磁格林函数将场传播到光子系统的任意内部，这可能是色散和吸收的。所得关系包含端口到端口散射矩阵和材料吸收的朗之万噪声贡献，它们共同保留​​了玻色子输出换向关系。对于嵌入式发射器，低饱和度和单激励散射响应由连接端口和发射器的格林函数决定，同时保留光子环境的非马尔可夫性。使用有限差分时域模拟，我们计算了纳米光子腔和逆向设计耦合器的发射极修改传输，提供了从计算的电磁响应到量子输入输出模型的直接途径。

title: Gate-Based Quantum Simulation of Finite-Temperature Open-System Dynamics: A Post-Processing Reconstruction Approach for Collision Models
abstract: Simulating open-system dynamics on gate-based quantum computers offers a route to exploring dissipative quantum phenomena through programmable quantum processing. Collision models provide a direct and flexible framework by representing the environment through sequential system--ancilla collisions. At finite temperatures, however, they typically require repeated preparation of thermal ancillas, adding circuit overhead and gate errors. Here, we show that, for a broad class of $U(1)$-symmetric system--ancilla interactions, finite-temperature dynamics can instead be reconstructed from simulations with pure ancillas in orthogonal basis states. The target temperature enters only through classical post-processing of the resulting pure-branch data, allowing the same data to be reused for different temperatures without additional quantum processing. Bypassing explicit thermal-state preparation reduces ancilla-preparation overhead and preparation-induced errors.
summary: 在基于门的量子计算机上模拟开放系统动力学提供了通过可编程量子处理探索耗散量子现象的途径。碰撞模型通过顺序系统（辅助碰撞）表示环境，提供了直接且灵活的框架。然而，在有限的温度下，它们通常需要重复准备热辅助装置，从而增加电路开销和门错误。在这里，我们表明，对于一大类 $U(1)$ 对称系统辅助相互作用，有限温度动力学可以通过正交基态下的纯辅助模拟来重建。目标温度仅通过对所得纯分支数据进行经典后处理来输入，允许相同的数据在不同的温度下重复使用，而无需额外的量子处理。绕过显式热状态准备可减少辅助准备开销和准备引起的错误。

title: Exact Finite-Channel Schur Moments of the Wigner-Smith Matrix with a Tunnel Barrier
abstract: We consider the Wigner--Smith time-delay matrix of a chaotic cavity with broken time-reversal symmetry, a finite number $M$ of equivalent open channels, and a uniform tunnel barrier of reflection probability $R$. Exact random-matrix results for nonideal coupling are known at the level of the joint matrix distribution, whereas explicit finite-channel formulas for Schur moments are much less developed. We show that every Schur moment of the nonideal Wigner--Smith matrix factorizes into its ideal-coupling inverse-Laguerre value and a barrier factor given by a circular unitary ensemble (CUE) average of a Schur polynomial. A dual-Cauchy generating function reduces the latter to a Toeplitz determinant with a rational symbol, placing the barrier problem within the classical theory of exact CUE characteristic-polynomial ratios. For one-row partitions, specializing the exact CUE ratio formula gives a closed generating function for all barrier coefficients and therefore all finite delay-time moments in the allowed range $n\le M$. The exact ratio formula decomposes into a sector visible to the semiclassical expansion and an additional contribution proportional to $R^{M+1}$, which is invisible to every algebraic order in $1/M$. For the second moment, this contribution exactly reproduces the exponentially small term in the known random-matrix expression for $\langle\tau_W^2\rangle$ that is absent from the semiclassical expansion. We also derive an exact finite sum for all one-column partitions and an exact complement symmetry for Schur averages inside the $M\times M$ square. The new contribution therefore lies not in the underlying CUE ratio identities, which are classical, but in combining them with the exact nonideal Wigner--Smith mapping and extracting the resulting finite-channel time-delay formulas and corrections to semiclassical Schur-moment conjectures.
summary:
我们考虑具有破缺时间反转对称性的混沌腔的 Wigner--Smith 时滞矩阵、有限数量 $M$ 的等效开放通道以及反射概率 $R$ 的均匀隧道势垒。非理想耦合的精确随机矩阵结果在联合矩阵分布级别上是已知的，而 Schur 矩的显式有限通道公式则很少开发。我们证明非理想维格纳-史密斯矩阵的每个舒尔矩都分解为其理想耦合逆拉盖尔值和由舒尔多项式的循环酉系综 (CUE) 平均值给出的障碍因子。双柯西生成函数将后者简化为具有有理符号的 Toeplitz 行列式，将障碍问题置于精确 CUE 特征多项式比的经典理论中。对于单行分区，专门化精确的 CUE 比率公式可以为所有障碍系数提供一个闭合生成函数，从而为允许范围 $n\le M$ 内的所有有限延迟时间矩提供一个闭合生成函数。

精确比率公式分解为半经典展开式可见的扇区和与 $R^{M+1}$ 成比例的附加贡献，这对于 $1/M$ 中的每个代数阶都是不可见的。对于第二时刻，此贡献精确地再现了半经典展开式中不存在的 $\langle\tau_W^2\rangle$ 的已知随机矩阵表达式中的指数小项。我们还为所有单列分区导出了精确的有限和，并为 $M\times M$ 方阵内的 Schur 平均值导出了精确的补对称性。因此，新的贡献不在于经典的基础 CUE 比率恒等式，而在于将它们与精确的非理想 Wigner-Smith 映射相结合，并提取所得的有限通道时延公式以及对半经典 Schur 矩猜想的修正。

title: How to distinguish chaos from integrability using OTOC
abstract: The decay of out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs) to a small residual value signals the scrambling of quantum information. This behavior is generic: it occurs in both chaotic and interacting integrable many-body systems, and therefore cannot by itself distinguish between them. In this paper we analytically study the late-time saturation value of a closely related observable, operator purity, and show that its scaling with system size robustly distinguishes chaotic from integrable systems. Our approach is based on the Mazur bound, which provides concrete scaling estimates and makes explicit why the locality of integrable charges matters. We support our findings with numerical simulations of one-dimensional spin chains.
summary: 乱序相关器（OTOC）衰减到一个小的残值表明量子信息的扰乱。这种行为是通用的：它发生在混沌和相互作用的可积多体系统中，因此本身无法区分它们。在本文中，我们分析研究了密切相关的可观测值、算子纯度的后期饱和值，并表明其随系统规模的缩放可以稳健地区分混沌系统和可积系统。我们的方法基于马祖尔界限，它提供了具体的标度估计，并明确了为什么可积电荷的局部性很重要。我们通过一维自旋链的数值模拟来支持我们的发现。

title: Generalized Dunkl Quantum Systems with Energy-Dependent Interactions: Exact Solvability and Thermodynamic Properties
abstract: This work investigates a class of exactly solvable quantum systems described by a generalized Dunkl--Schrödinger equation with energy-dependent interactions. A two-parameter extension of the Dunkl differential operator is introduced, incorporating both the conventional reflection contribution and an additional derivative-reflection coupling. The resulting formalism leads to a modified Heisenberg algebra, from which the continuity equation, conserved probability current, and generalized normalization condition are derived for energy-dependent potentials. As an application, an energy-dependent harmonic oscillator is studied in detail. Exact analytical expressions for the eigenfunctions and energy spectrum are obtained in terms of associated Laguerre polynomials. The combined effects of the Wigner parameter, the deformation parameter, and the energy-dependence parameter are shown to produce parity splitting, nonlinear energy spectra, and nonuniform level spacing while preserving exact solvability. The thermodynamic properties of the model are then examined through the canonical partition function using the Euler--Maclaurin summation formula. Analytical expressions for the partition function, internal energy, entropy, and specific heat are derived and analyzed numerically. The results demonstrate that the generalized Dunkl deformation and energy-dependent interaction provide effective control over both the spectral and thermal characteristics of the system, extending the class of exactly solvable quantum models with reflection symmetry.
summary:
这项工作研究了一类精确可解的量子系统，由具有能量相关相互作用的广义 Dunkl-Schrödinger 方程描述。引入了 Dunkl 微分算子的双参数扩展，结合了传统的反射贡献和附加的导数反射耦合。由此产生的形式主义导致了修正的海森堡代数，从中导出了能量相关势的连续性方程、守恒概率流和广义归一化条件。作为一个应用，详细研究了能量相关谐振子。本征函数和能谱的精确解析表达式是根据相关的拉盖尔多项式获得的。维格纳参数、变形参数和能量相关参数的综合效应显示出产生宇称分裂、非线性能谱和不均匀能级间距，同时保持精确的可解性。然后使用欧拉-麦克劳林求和公式通过正则配分函数检查模型的热力学性质。

推导了配分函数、内能、熵和比热的解析表达式并进行了数值分析。结果表明，广义 Dunkl 变形和能量相关相互作用可以有效控制系统的光谱和热特性，扩展了具有反射对称性的精确可解量子模型的类别。

title: Structural Conditions for Distributed Quantum Advantage
abstract: Circuit cutting runs a quantum computation on processors smaller than the circuit, at the price of classical knitting whose cost grows exponentially with the number of cut gates. Keeping this cost affordable is necessary but not sufficient for an advantage, since knitting classically easy subcircuits is itself classically easy. We formulate three requirements for distributed quantum advantage under a stated budget: affordable knitting, classical difficulty that survives the cut, and, for variational circuits, resolvable gradients. We prove that under stated assumptions knitting stays affordable when subcircuits grow behind a bounded interface and becomes exponentially expensive when fixed-width subcircuits multiply. We turn the requirements into screening criteria and apply them to eighteen circuit families. We identify finite local-depth circuits with bounded interfaces as a setting in which the requirements can coexist, with hardness established only in the worst case. As a classically verifiable proof of principle, we knit one gate joining two field-perturbed toric-code patches on an IBM Nighthawk processor for up to 142 spins, and confirm that the reconstruction can at least resolve the contact correlation beyond independent execution for up to 98 qubits.
summary:
电路切割在比电路更小的处理器上运行量子计算，其代价是传统针织的成本随着切割门的数量呈指数增长。保持这种成本可承受是必要的，但不足以获得优势，因为编织经典简单的子电路本身非常简单。我们在规定的预算下制定了分布式量子优势的三个要求：经济实惠的编织、经受住切割的经典难度，以及对于变分电路，可解析的梯度。我们证明，在规定的假设下，当子电路在有界接口后面增长时，编织仍然是可以承受的，而当固定宽度的子电路倍增时，编织会变得指数级昂贵。我们将这些要求转化为筛选标准，并将其应用于 18 个电路系列。我们将具有有界接口的有限局部深度电路确定为一种需求可以共存的设置，仅在最坏的情况下才建立硬度。

作为一种经典的可验证原理证明，我们在 IBM Nighthawk 夜鹰处理器上编织了一个连接两个场扰动环面代码补丁的门，最多旋转 142 次，并确认重建至少可以解决最多 98 个量子位独立执行之外的接触相关性。

title: Imaginarity as a resource in Shor's algorithm
abstract: We investigate the sequential version of Shor's order-finding algorithm from the perspective of the imaginarity of quantum channels. By fixing an eigenbranch of the modular multiplication unitary and a target output path, the process is effectively decomposed into a real diagonal factor and a residual phase channel. We find that for the ideal residual phase channel, the three trace-norm induced imaginarity measures are all equal. On good output paths, a smaller residual imaginarity corresponds to a higher single-block success probability. By combining the branch-wise probabilities, we obtain the exact ideal success probability of the sequential order-finding protocol and derive lower and upper bounds in terms of residual phase-channel imaginarity. We further extend the analysis to noisy residual phase channels, and obtain the lower and upper bounds on the noisy success probability. These results clarify the role of imaginarity of channels in Shor's algorithm and provide a refined perspective on quantum-resource behavior in ideal and noisy sequential quantum algorithms.
summary: 我们从量子通道的虚数的角度研究了 Shor 寻序算法的顺序版本。通过固定模乘酉的特征分支和目标输出路径，该过程被有效地分解为实对角因子和剩余相位通道。我们发现，对于理想的剩余相位通道，三个迹范数引起的虚数测度都是相等的。在良好的输出路径上，较小的残差对应于较高的单块成功概率。通过结合分支概率，我们获得了顺序寻序协议的精确理想成功概率，并推导出剩余相位通道虚数的下限和上限。我们进一步将分析扩展到噪声剩余相位通道，并获得噪声成功概率的下限和上限。这些结果阐明了肖尔算法中通道虚数的作用，并为理想和噪声序列量子算法中的量子资源行为提供了一个精确的视角。

title: Symmetry resolved entanglement in Schwinger pair production
abstract: We study the charge resolved structure of the pairwise mode entanglement produced by the Schwinger effect. Using the $U(1)$ electric charge of quantum electrodynamics, we decompose the entanglement of the reduced density matrices of momentum modes into individual charge sectors, applying the symmetry resolved entanglement entropy to the pure bipartition reductions and the charge imbalance resolved negativity to the mixed particle-antiparticle pair. For a constant electric field we obtain closed form results for every mode pairing, with all field dependence controlled by the single pair production probability $|\beta|^2=e^{-\pi\mu}$. For the particle, particle and antiparticle antiparticle pairs the entanglement entropy within each charge sector is field independent, so that the field acts only by redistributing statistical weight among the sectors; for the mixed particle antiparticle pair the populated sector additionally carries a field dependent entropy. The vacuum created pair is the richest case: its resolved negativity is distributed over three imbalance sectors and is transported from one sector to the next as the field increases, the sectors contributing equally only at the critical field. The entanglement across a fixed momentum bipartition, by contrast, is frozen at its initial value because pair creation conserves the sector charge. Symmetry resolution thus refines the total entanglement measures into a sector resolved picture, exposing where in charge space the entanglement of the Schwinger mechanism resides and how the electric field moves it, information beyond that contained in the total measures or in particle number distributions.
summary:
我们研究了施温格效应产生的成对模式纠缠的电荷解析结构。利用量子电动力学的 $U(1)$ 电荷，我们将动量模式约化密度矩阵的纠缠分解为各个电荷扇区，将对称性解析的纠缠熵应用于纯二分约简，并将电荷不平衡解析负性应用于混合粒子-反粒子对。对于恒定电场，我们为每个模式配对获得闭合形式结果，所有场依赖性均由单对产生概率 $|\beta|^2=e^{-\pi\mu}$ 控制。对于粒子、粒子和反粒子反粒子对，每个电荷扇区内的纠缠熵是场无关的，因此场仅通过在扇区之间重新分配统计权重来起作用；对于混合粒子反粒子对，填充扇区还带有场相关熵。

真空产生的对是最丰​​富的情况：其解决的负性分布在三个不平衡扇区上，并随着场的增加从一个扇区转移到下一个扇区，这些扇区仅在关键场上贡献相等。相比之下，固定动量二分的纠缠被冻结在其初始值，因为货币对的创建节省了扇区费用。因此，对称分辨率将总纠缠测量细化为扇形分辨率图像，揭示了施温格机制的纠缠在电荷空间中的位置以及电场如何移动它，以及总测量或粒子数分布中包含的信息之外的信息。

title: Quantum Submodular Maximization
abstract: We study the quantum query complexity of maximizing a non-negative submodular function, considering both the unconstrained setting and, for monotone functions, a cardinality constraint $k$ on an $n$-element ground set. In the exact reversible digital value-oracle model, our unconstrained algorithm achieves an expected $(1/2-\varepsilon)$-approximation using only $O_\varepsilon(\log n)$ queries. In contrast, any classical randomized algorithm that attains a fixed expected ratio above $1/4$ requires $\Omega(n/\log n)$ queries (Li, Feldman, Kazemi, and Karbasi, 2022), establishing an exponential separation in query complexity. For cardinality-constrained maximization, we give a bounded-error quantum algorithm that achieves a $(1-1/e-\varepsilon)$-approximation using $\widetilde O_\varepsilon(\min\{\sqrt n,n/k\})$ queries. When $k=o(n)$, our algorithm achieves at least a quadratic speedup up to logarithmic factors over classical randomized algorithms (Mirzasoleiman, Badanidiyuru, Karbasi, Vondrák, and Krause, 2015; Peng and Rubinstein, 2025). Moreover, when $k=cn$ for any fixed rational $c<1-1/e-\varepsilon$, the query complexity reduces to $O_{\varepsilon,c}(\log n)$, yielding an exponential separation from the classical $\Omega(n/\log n)$ lower bound (Li, Feldman, Kazemi, and Karbasi, 2022). We further prove quantum lower bounds of $\exp(\Omega(\varepsilon^2n))$ queries for achieving a ratio beyond $1/2+\varepsilon$ without constraints, and $\exp(\Omega(\varepsilon^2k))$ queries for exceeding $1-1/e+\varepsilon$ when $k/n\le\varepsilon$. These barriers demonstrate that quantum computation offers no exponential speedup at these approximation thresholds.
summary:
我们研究了最大化非负子模函数的量子查询复杂性，考虑了无约束设置以及对于单调函数而言，$n$ 元素基础集上的基数约束 $k$。在精确可逆数字价值预言模型中，我们的无约束算法仅使用 $O_\varepsilon(\log n)$ 查询即可实现预期的 $(1/2-\varepsilon)$ 近似值。相比之下，任何达到高于 $1/4$ 的固定预期比率的经典随机算法都需要 $\Omega(n/\log n)$ 查询（Li、Feldman、Kazemi 和 Karbasi，2022），从而在查询复杂性上建立指数分离。对于基数约束最大化，我们给出了一种有界误差量子算法，该算法使用 $\widetilde O_\varepsilon(\min\{\sqrt n,n/k\})$ 查询实现 $(1-1/e-\varepsilon)$ 近似。当 $k=o(n)$ 时，我们的算法比经典随机算法至少实现了对数因子的二次加速（Mirzasoleiman、Badanidiyuru、Karbasi、Vondrák 和 Krause，2015 年；Peng 和 Rubinstein，2025 年）。

此外，当 $k=cn$ 对于任何固定有理数 $c<1-1/e-\varepsilon$ 时，查询复杂度降低至 $O_{\varepsilon,c}(\log n)$，从而与经典的 $\Omega(n/\log n)$ 下界呈指数分离（Li、Feldman、Kazemi 和 Karbasi，2022）。我们进一步证明了 $\exp(\Omega(\varepsilon^2n))$ 查询的量子下界，可以在没有约束的情况下实现超过 $1/2+\varepsilon$ 的比率，并且 $\exp(\Omega(\varepsilon^2k))$ 查询在 $k/n\le\varepsilon$ 时超过 $1-1/e+\varepsilon$。这些障碍表明量子计算在这些近似阈值下没有提供指数加速。

title: Geometry-Controlled Squeezed-Waveguide Enabled Quantum Batteries
abstract: Harnessed nonclassical resources to enhance the performance of quantum batteries is an important goal of quantum technology. In this work, we investigate multi-emitter batteries coupled to a one-dimensional waveguide driven by a broadband squeezed-vacuum reservoir, and determine how the waveguide geometry controls the battery performance and and their thermodynamic features. We show that for a single emitter, the squeezed reservoir deposits finite energy while the state remains passive, yielding zero ergotropy. For two emitters, however, phase-sensitive reservoir correlations generate coherence and can drive the steady state into a fully nonpassive regime. For three emitters, collective thermal dynamics already supports finite ergotropy, while squeezing further increases the extractable component of the stored energy. Crucially, because the collective and phase-sensitive couplings depend on the emitter positions, geometry provides direct control over the nonclassical correlations and, consequently, over the nonpassivity of the steady state. The ergotropy can therefore be strongly modulated while the stored energy changes only weakly, and in the two-emitter configuration geometry alone can switch the battery between a passive steady state and one in which all stored energy is unitarily extractable.
summary:
利用非经典资源来增强量子电池的性能是量子技术的一个重要目标。在这项工作中，我们研究了与宽带压缩真空储存器驱动的一维波导耦合的多发射极电池，并确定波导几何形状如何控制电池性能及其热力学特征。我们表明，对于单个发射器，压缩的储层沉积有限的能量，而状态保持被动，产生零的各向异性。然而，对于两个发射器，相敏储层相关性产生相干性，并且可以将稳态驱动到完全非被动状态。对于三个发射器，集体热动力学已经支持有限的各向异性，而挤压进一步增加了所存储能量的可提取部分。至关重要的是，由于集体耦合和相敏耦合取决于发射器位置，因此几何形状可以直接控制非经典相关性，从而控制稳态的非被动性。

因此，可以强烈调节各向异性，而存储的能量仅发生微弱的变化，并且在双发射器配置中，仅几何形状就可以将电池在被动稳态和所有存储的能量均可统一提取的状态之间切换。

title: Variational Quantum Attention for Molecular Graph Learning
abstract: Molecular property prediction is central to computational drug discovery, where graph neural networks learn to weight neighboring atomic environments during message passing. Yet it remains unclear how variational quantum circuits alter learned attention behavior in molecular graphs. We introduce an edge-aware variational quantum attention mechanism for molecular graph learning, in which the receiving atom, neighboring atom, and connecting bond jointly determine the quantum attention state. Across five molecular property and bioactivity prediction tasks, QGAT achieves competitive performance relative to GATv2, with a consistent improvement on BBBP across all six evaluated circuit ansatzes. We further compare how the quantum and classical attention scores weight molecular structure beyond accuracy. In the Verubecestat BACE1 inhibitor series, QGAT achieves a higher Spearman correlation than GATv2 and assigns positive attributions to several structural changes consistent with reported structure-activity relationships (SARs). This case study shows that the two attention mechanisms can exhibit different prediction and attribution behavior across structurally related BACE1 analogues, while broader validation is required to determine how consistently these differences generalize across chemical series and targets. Circuit ablations further show that performance depends on the circuit design. Together, these results show that variational quantum attention can serve as a viable alternative molecular attention parameterization while inducing circuit- and chemistry-dependent behavior distinct from a matched classical scorer.
summary:
分子特性预测是计算药物发现的核心，其中图神经网络学习在消息传递过程中对相邻原子环境进行加权。然而，目前尚不清楚变分量子电路如何改变分子图中习得的注意力行为。我们引入了一种用于分子图学习的边缘感知变分量子注意机制，其中接收原子、相邻原子和连接键共同决定量子注意状态。在五个分子特性和生物活性预测任务中，QGAT 相对于 GATv2 实现了具有竞争力的性能，并且在所有六个评估的电路分析中 BBBP 都有一致的改进。我们进一步比较了量子注意力和经典注意力如何对重量分子结构进行超出准确性的评分。在 Verubecestat BACE1 抑制剂系列中，QGAT 实现了比 GATv2 更高的 Spearman 相关性，并将积极归因归因于与报道的结构活性关系 (SAR) 一致的几个结构变化。

该案例研究表明，两种注意力机制可以在结构相关的 BACE1 类似物中表现出不同的预测和归因行为，而需要更广泛的验证来确定这些差异在化学系列和靶标中的普遍程度。电路烧蚀进一步表明性能取决于电路设计。总之，这些结果表明，变分量子注意力可以作为一种可行的替代分子注意力参数化，同时诱导与匹配的经典记分器不同的电路和化学依赖性行为。

title: Efficient Quantum State Identity Testing
abstract: We study the following quantum state identity problem: given access to copies of $n$ unknown pure quantum states, the goal is to determine whether every pair has fidelity at least $1-\varepsilon$ or some pair has fidelity at most $\varepsilon$. This problem relaxes the identical-or-orthogonal promise considered in previous work. For any fixed overlap parameter $\varepsilon\in(0,1/4)$, we present two quantum algorithms with complementary guarantees on circuit depth and sample complexity. The first runs in constant depth using parallel swap tests and takes $O(\log(n/\delta)\log(2/\delta))$ copies of each input state to succeed with probability at least $1-\delta$. The second uses the Schur transform to reduce the sample complexity to $O(\log(n/\delta))$, through an analysis relating Jucys--Murphy elements to Schur sampling. We also prove a matching sample complexity lower bound of $\Omega(\log(n/\delta))$ for any quantum algorithm with failure probability at most $\delta\le 1/2-c$, for any constant $c>0$, establishing that the second algorithm achieves the optimal dependence on both $n$ and $\delta$ for fixed $\varepsilon$.
summary: 我们研究以下量子态同一性问题：给定 $n$ 个未知纯量子态的副本，目标是确定是否每对都具有至少 $1-\varepsilon$ 的保真度，或者某些对具有最多 $\varepsilon$ 的保真度。这个问题放宽了先前工作中考虑的相同或正交承诺。对于任何固定的重叠参数$\varepsilon\in(0,1/4)$，我们提出了两种量子算法，在电路深度和样本复杂性上具有互补的保证。第一个使用并行交换测试以恒定深度运行，并获取每个输入状态的 $O(\log(n/\delta)\log(2/\delta))$ 副本，以至少 $1-\delta$ 的概率成功。第二个方法使用 Schur 变换，通过将 Jucys--Murphy 元素与 Schur 采样相关的分析，将样本复杂度降低到 $O(\log(n/\delta))$。我们还证明了对于任何量子算法，对于任何常数 $c>0$，失败概率至多 $\delta\le 1/2-c$ 的匹配样本复杂度下界为 $\Omega(\log(n/\delta))$，对于任何常数 $c>0$，建立了第二个算法对于固定 $\varepsilon$ 实现了对 $n$ 和 $\delta$ 的最佳依赖。

title: Multi-Yoked Surface Codes
abstract: The surface code is the leading candidate for fault-tolerant quantum computation owing to its planar nearest-neighbor connectivity, high threshold, and efficient decoding, but its low encoding rate demands on the order of a thousand physical qubits per logical qubit in the teraquop regime. Yoked surface codes improve the density by a factor of two or three by concatenating a high-density parity check code on top of the surface code while retaining planar nearest-neighbor connectivity. In this work, we generalize this idea to multiple levels of concatenation and introduce multi-yoked surface codes. Our construction rests on two new ingredients. First, we propose a family of outer codes called chain codes, built by chaining copies of a seed code that detects the block errors of the code one level below; the resulting codes use all logical qubits of the lower level and achieve a high encoding rate within a few concatenation levels. Second, we design a patch allocation in which movable workspaces perform the yoking checks by lattice surgery with a hierarchy of yoking intervals, so that lower-level checks are performed frequently while higher-level checks are performed less often, which avoids the long yoking intervals that a single large-distance outer code would require. As a benchmark, we construct a three-yoked surface code with a $[[256,166,8]]$ outer code and evaluate it numerically under the SI1000 noise model using soft information from the surface code decoder. The logical error rate is suppressed exponentially in the inner code distance, and in the teraquop regime the three-yoked surface code is about 4 to 4.5$\times$ denser than the unyoked surface code.
summary:
表面代码由于其平面最近邻连接性、高阈值和高效解码而成为容错量子计算的主要候选者，但其低编码率要求在兆级体系中每个逻辑量子位有一千个物理量子位。轭表面码通过在表面码顶部串联高密度奇偶校验码，同时保留平面最近邻连接性，将密度提高了两到三倍。在这项工作中，我们将这个想法推广到多层串联并引入多轭表面代码。我们的结构基于两种新成分。首先，我们提出了一系列称为链码的外部代码，通过链接种子代码的副本构建，该种子代码检测下一级代码的块错误；生成的代码使用较低级别的所有逻辑量子位，并在几个串联级别内实现高编码率。

其次，我们设计了一种补丁分配，其中可移动工作空间通过具有层次结构的轭间隔的晶格手术来执行轭检查，以便频繁地执行较低级别的检查，而较少执行较高级别的检查，这避免了单个大距离外部代码所需的长轭间隔。作为基准，我们构建了一个带有 $[[256,166,8]]$ 外码的三轭表面码，并使用来自表面码解码器的软信息在 SI1000 噪声模型下对其进行数值评估。逻辑错误率在内码距离内呈指数抑制，并且在 teraquop 状态下，三轭表面码比无轭表面码密度大约为 4 到 4.5$\times$。

title: Bounding Two-Way Average Communication Cost of Simulating Quantum Correlations
abstract: Bell nonlocal correlations cannot be reproduced by local hidden-variable models without communication, making classical communication cost a natural quantitative measure of nonlocality. Although finite communication always suffices to simulate any correlation in a fixed finite Bell scenario, determining the minimum amount needed to (exactly) simulate any given nonlocal correlation remains challenging, especially in the average-cost setting. Here, we derive lower bounds on input-average communication cost from nonlocal games, allowing variable-length, fully interactive two-way protocols. When applied to parallel games, these bounds yield explicit finite quantum correlations for which the exact simulation cost exceeds any prescribed finite input-average communication budget. For $n$ parallel Magic-Square-winning correlations, we prove a lower bound of $n\log_2(3/2)$ bits and give a one-way communication protocol that attains this rate asymptotically. For the quantum correlation maximally winning the $n$-copy of the Clauser--Horne--Shimony--Holt nonlocal game, we obtain an input-average lower bound of approximately $0.04627n$ bits for exact simulation. Finally, we formulate a hierarchy of lower bounds and complementary upper bounds using deterministic correlations up to chosen communication costs. Both recover the exact input-average cost at their final levels, and if the bounds agree at lower levels, their common value yields the exact input-average cost without needing to consider all communication strategies.
summary:
在没有通信的情况下，贝尔非局部相关性无法通过局部隐变量模型来重现，这使得经典通信成本成为非局部性的自然定量度量。尽管有限通信始终足以模拟固定有限贝尔场景中的任何相关性，但确定（精确）模拟任何给定非局部相关性所需的最小量仍然具有挑战性，特别是在平均成本设置中。在这里，我们从非本地游戏中得出输入平均通信成本的下限，允许可变长度、完全交互式的双向协议。当应用于并行游戏时，这些界限会产生显式的有限量子相关性，其精确的模拟成本超过任何规定的有限输入平均通信预算。对于 $n$ 并行魔方获胜相关性，我们证明了 $n\log_2(3/2)$ 位的下界，并给出了一种渐近达到该速率的单向通信协议。对于量子相关性最大程度地赢得 Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt 非局部博弈的 $n$ 副本，我们获得了大约 $0.04627n$ 位的输入平均下界以进行精确模拟。

最后，我们使用与选定的通信成本相关的确定性相关性来制定下限和互补上限的层次结构。两者都在其最终水平上恢复了精确的输入平均成本，并且如果界限在较低水平上一致，则它们的共同值会产生精确的输入平均成本，而无需考虑所有通信策略。

title: Quantum-State Oblivious Transfer over Quantum Erasure Channels
abstract: We study quantum-state oblivious transfer over the quantum erasure channel under information-theoretic security guarantees. Specifically, Alice holds two quantum systems, Bob wishes to recover one of them, and the parties have access to independent channel uses and authenticated public classical communication, with no initial shared entanglement. We consider both honest-but-curious and malicious behavior. We establish finite-blocklength converse and achievability bounds, which match in the honest-but-curious setting. The malicious setting construction combines interactive hashing with tests of whether Bob received selected channel outputs, and distributes each input across several qubits so that erasures conceal an entire input from a dishonest receiver, even when the inputs are entangled with an external reference. We also derive fixed-error asymptotic expansions and show that both malicious and honest-but-curious settings have the same capacity.
summary: 我们研究信息论安全保证下量子擦除通道上的量子态不经意传输。具体来说，爱丽丝拥有两个量子系统，鲍勃希望恢复其中一个，并且双方可以访问独立的通道使用和经过身份验证的公共经典通信，而没有最初的共享纠缠。我们考虑诚实但好奇的行为和恶意行为。我们建立了有限块长度的转换和可实现性界限，这与诚实但好奇的环境相匹配。恶意设置结构将交互式散列与鲍勃是否收到选定通道输出的测试相结合，并将每个输入分布在多个量子位上，以便擦除隐藏来自不诚实接收者的整个输入，即使输入与外部参考纠缠在一起。我们还推导了固定误差渐近展开式，并表明恶意和诚实但好奇的设置具有相同的容量。

title: Stabilizer codes over general phase spaces
abstract: We develop a theory of stabilizer codes whose stabilizer groups consist of commuting qudit Paulis, oscillator displacements, and/or planar-rotor displacements. We consider codes whose stabilizer groups form generalized lattices in quantum phase space, a condition that guarantees a finite logical dimension. We construct oscillator-rotor, rotor-qudit, and oscillator-rotor-qubit codes that cannot be decomposed into separate subsystems by generalized Clifford transformations. We also introduce an oscillator-qubit code arising from a partially lifted Golay code, where Construction A is applied to half of the Golay code coordinates. We derive analytical forms of logical operators from the symplectic dual lattice, determine Clifford-Gaussian gates from lattice symmetries, show that the code dimension equals the covolume of the stabilizer lattice, and organize the syndrome subspaces into a vector bundle. Our technique builds on earlier non-commutative geometric results by Rieffel, but it can often be interpreted simply as concatenating a given stabilizer code with a Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) code, applying conventional lattice-theoretic results, and unconcatenating. We formulate distances, optimal decoding, and quantum weight enumerators, recovering the Pauli, qudit, and GKP versions together with known MacWilliams identities. We construct finite-energy codewords whose encoding is an isometry up to an error exponentially small in the inverse damping parameter.
summary:
我们开发了一种稳定器代码理论，其稳定器组由交换量子保利斯、振荡器位移和/或平面转子位移组成。我们考虑其稳定基团在量子相空间中形成广义晶格的代码，这是保证有限逻辑维度的条件。我们构建了振荡器-转子、转子-qudit 和振荡器-转子-量子位代码，这些代码无法通过广义 Clifford 变换分解为单独的子系统。我们还引入了由部分提升的 Golay 代码产生的振荡器量子位代码，其中结构 A 应用于 Golay 代码坐标的一半。我们从辛对偶格中推导出逻辑算子的解析形式，从格对称性中确定Clifford-Gaussian门，证明代码维数等于稳定点格的余体积，并将校正子空间组织成向量丛。我们的技术建立在 Rieffel 早期的非交换几何结果的基础上，但它通常可以简单地解释为将给定的稳定器代码与 Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) 代码连接起来，应用传统的格理论结果，然后取消连接。

我们制定距离、最佳解码和量子权重枚举器，恢复 Pauli、qudit 和 GKP 版本以及已知的 MacWilliams 恒等式。我们构造有限能量码字，其编码是等距的，误差在逆阻尼参数中呈指数小。

title: Sum-of-squares compilation of matrix-model dynamics for NISQ and fault-tolerant hardware
abstract: The SU$(N)$ matrix-model potential $V=-\tfrac{g^2}{4}\sum_{I,J}Tr[X_I,X_J]^2$, the interaction of the BFSS/BMN family, whose thermal large-$N$ states are dual to black holes, is diagonal in the coordinate basis and is compiled in the literature as a phase polynomial with $O(d^2N^4Q^4)$ rotations per Trotter step. That cost is close to optimal for its gate class: we show that for a generic Trotter step the Walsh support $m_{\min}$ lower-bounds both the rotation count and the two-qubit count of every circuit over $\{CNOT,CZ,CPhase,R_{ZZ},SWAP,X,R_z\}$, ancillas included, and we build a parity network attaining $1.01$--$1.10\,m_{\min}$. Improvement therefore requires a gate outside that class, and the exact factorisation of $V$ into a sum of squared commutator entries supplies one in each era. For NISQ, Hadamard: each squared entry is added into a Fourier register and squared there, $\Theta(d^2N^3Q^3)$ two-qubit gates. For fault tolerance, $T$: reversible arithmetic with one phase-gradient injection per squared entry, $\Theta(d^2N^3Q^2)$ T gates and no arbitrary-angle rotation. Both are built and verified. With a native $R_{ZZ}$ the NISQ circuit uses fewer two-qubit gates than every parity network from $Q=6$ at SU(2) and $Q=2$ at SU(5); the oracle beats a precision-matched Hamming-weight-phasing incumbent at every point built except the smallest, by up to $11.9\times$ in T count and, at equal width, $25.5\times$ in surface-code spacetime. An ablation with the same arithmetic but no factorisation costs up to $21\times$ more and loses to that incumbent at $15$ of $17$ points, so the factorisation, not the arithmetic, produces the win. Both constructions survive the supersymmetric deformation to mini-BMN with fermions, and complete Trotter evolutions on a statevector simulator reproduce the exact product formula to $2\times10^{-12}$.
summary:
SU$(N)$ 矩阵模型势 $V=-\tfrac{g^2}{4}\sum_{I,J}Tr[X_I,X_J]^2$ 是 BFSS/BMN 族的相互作用，其热大 $N$ 状态与黑洞对偶，在坐标基础上是对角的，并在文献中编译为相位多项式，每个 Trotter 步骤具有 $O(d^2N^4Q^4)$ 旋转。该成本对于其门类来说接近最佳：我们表明，对于通用 Trotter 步骤，Walsh 支持 $m_{\min}$ 下限 $\{CNOT,CZ,CPhase,R_{ZZ},SWAP,X,R_z\}$ 上每个电路的旋转计数和两个量子位计数，包括辅助功能，并且我们构建了一个奇偶校验网络$1.01$--$1.10\,m_{\min}$。因此，改进需要该类之外的门，并且将 $V$ 精确分解为换向器条目的平方和，在每个时代都提供一个。对于 NISQ，Hadamard：每个平方条目被添加到傅立叶寄存器中并在那里平方，$\Theta(d^2N^3Q^3)$ 两个量子位门。对于容错，$T$：可逆算术，每个平方条目一次相位梯度注入，$\Theta(d^2N^3Q^2)$T 门，并且没有任意角度旋转。两者均已构建并验证。

对于本机 $R_{ZZ}$，NISQ 电路使用的两量子位门比 SU(2) 处的 $Q=6$ 和 SU(5) 处的 $Q=2$ 的每个奇偶校验网络更少；预言机在除最小点之外的每个点上都击败了精确匹配的汉明权重定相现有者，在 T 计数中高达 $11.9\times$，在相同宽度下，在表面代码时空中高达 $25.5\times$。使用相同算术但不进行分解的消融成本高达 $21\times$，并以 $17$ 点中的 $15$ 输给现任者，因此是分解而不是算术产生了胜利。两种结构都经受住了费米子迷你 BMN 的超对称变形，并且状态向量模拟器上的完整 Trotter 演化将精确的乘积公​​式再现为 $2\times10^{-12}$。

title: Record consistency under repeated readout and apparatus composition
abstract: No-signalling constraints on isolated outcome probabilities do not determine whether an apparatus preserves the joint law of its accessible records under repeated readout, network composition, or reuse. We study these extensions through a conditional-record criterion and four explicit models. For a wrapped-Cauchy retrocausal source, protection under two conditionally independent continuous readouts forces an angle-independent response; three readouts suffice without continuity. A finite angular-bandwidth assumption gives a quantitative leakage bound, whereas continuity alone gives no uniform stability. At a specified two-source Bell junction, the required correction matrix has full nonnegative rank on every even uniform angular grid. A Gaussian controller can cancel branch-mass dependence while leaving a distinguishable joint record, for which we derive exact noise and law-change tradeoffs. Finally, a fixed singlet with shared classical noise reproduces the variable-width isolated outcome family, but retained and refreshed controllers generate different temporal statistics. We prove a finite-resource obstruction and construct positive finite-controller approximations. Numerical studies comprising 8.3 million independent simulated histories support the model-specific predictions. Together, the results identify conditions that must accompany marginal no-signalling when extending an apparatus to richer records and interventions.
summary:
对孤立结果概率的无信号约束并不能确定设备在重复读出、网络组成或重用下是否保留其可访问记录的联合法则。我们通过条件记录标准和四个显式模型来研究这些扩展。对于包裹柯西逆因果源，两个条件独立的连续读数下的保护会强制产生与角度无关的响应；三个读数就足够了，没有连续性。有限角带宽假设给出了定量的泄漏界限，而单独的连续性并不能给出均匀的稳定性。在指定的双源贝尔连接处，所需的校正矩阵在每个偶数均匀角度网格上具有完整的非负秩。高斯控制器可以消除分支质量依赖性，同时留下可区分的联合记录，为此我们得出精确的噪声和规律变化权衡。最后，具有共享经典噪声的固定单重态再现了可变宽度的隔离结果族，但保留和刷新的控制器生成不同的时间统计数据。我们证明了有限资源障碍并构造了正有限控制器近似。

包含 830 万个独立模拟历史的数值研究支持特定模型的预测。总之，这些结果确定了将设备扩展到更丰富的记录和干预时必须伴随边际无信号的条件。

title: Quantum codes in the Lee metric
abstract: We introduce a quantum coding framework for discrete small-shift noise, in which errors on qudits are modeled as low-weight $X$- and $Z$-type Pauli shifts, analogous to small phase-space displacements in continuous-variable systems. This structure is approximately respected by nuclear-spin noise and captured by the Lee metric, motivating a quantum extension of classical Lee-metric coding theory. We develop such a formalism for stabilizer codes over $\mathbb{Z}_q$ for arbitrary $q$, using joint and separate Lee metrics for the $X$- and $Z$-components of errors. For qubits, the joint metric counts $Y$ errors twice and can yield codes that detect and correct $X$ and $Z$ errors with fewer physical qubits than codes designed for the conventional Hamming metric. We discuss Lee-weight spreading under Clifford gates and qubitize codes over $\mathbb{Z}_4$ via the Gray map, finding codes with two-fold transversal non-qubit-Clifford gates. For quantum CSS Lee-LDPC codes on $n$ qudits, we prove that the Lee distance cannot exceed $O(n)$, uniformly in $q$, demonstrating an unexpected obstruction to using the large internal Hilbert space of a large-$q$ qudit to make high-Lee-distance codes. Under local Metropolis dynamics, certain classical $q$-ary ``helical repetition codes'' have exponentially long memory times at fixed temperature for sufficiently large $q$ (that grows with system length), which can be understood as spontaneous symmetry breaking at finite temperature, even in local one-dimensional models. Hypergraph products of these helical repetition codes provide local two-dimensional quantum codes that inherit self-correction for $Z$ errors, but self-correction for $X$ errors remains an open question.
summary:
我们引入了一种用于离散小位移噪声的量子编码框架，其中量子数的错误被建模为低权重 $X$ 和 $Z$ 型泡利位移，类似于连续变量系统中的小相空间位移。这种结构近似地受到核自旋噪声的尊重并被李度量所捕获，从而激发了经典李度量编码理论的量子扩展。我们为任意 $q$ 的 $\mathbb{Z}_q$ 上的稳定器代码开发了这样一种形式主义，对错误的 $X$- 和 $Z$- 分量使用联合和单独的 Lee 度量。对于量子位，联合度量对 $Y$ 错误进行两次计数，并且可以生成检测和纠正 $X$ 和 $Z$ 错误的代码，其物理量子位数量比为传统汉明度量设计的代码少。我们讨论克利福德门下的李权重扩散，并通过格雷图对 $\mathbb{Z}_4$ 上的代码进行量子化，找到具有两倍横向非量子位克利福德门的代码。对于 $n$ qudits 上的量子 CSS Lee-LDPC 码，我们证明 Lee 距离不能超过 $O(n)$，统一在 $q$ 中，这证明了使用大 $q$ qudit 的大内部希尔伯特空间来制作高 Lee 距离码的意外障碍。

在局部 Metropolis 动力学下，某些经典的 $q$ 元“螺旋重复码”在固定温度下对于足够大的 $q$（随系统长度增长）具有指数级长的存储时间，这可以理解为在有限温度下自发对称性破缺，即使在局部一维模型中也是如此。这些螺旋重复码的超图积提供了局部二维量子码，继承了 $Z$ 错误的自校正，但 $X$ 错误的自校正仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

title: Custom Penalty QAOA via Walsh-Hadamard Transform
abstract: Inequality constraints in combinatorial optimization are conventionally handled by introducing slack variables and quadratic penalties, which increase the qubit count and distort the optimization landscape. Slack-free formulations instead apply a nonlinear custom penalty function directly to the constraint, which are difficult to be implemented in quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA). We show that the Walsh--Hadamard transform (WHT) removes this obstruction for any penalty function: a penalty applied to a linear constraint is exactly a weighted sum of Pauli-$Z$ strings. We propose this framework as the Walsh custom penalty QAOA (WCP-QAOA). Truncating the expansion at Walsh degree $k$ costs $\mathcal{O}(n^k)$ Pauli terms and leaves the qubit count untouched. The truncation is the optimal degree-$k$ approximation of the penalty in $L^2$, and we give a condition on the discarded Walsh coefficients under which the truncated Hamiltonian still ranks every feasible solution below every infeasible one. Since evaluating a Walsh coefficient from its definition requires all $2^n$ penalty values, we give an algorithm that returns any coefficient in sub-exponential time, so that the degree-$k$ Hamiltonian is obtained in time polynomial in $n$ for fixed $k$. We show that for the exponential penalty, there exists a closed product form of WHT, and hence a closed form expression to calculate the Walsh coefficients. We identify structural shortcuts that shorten the exact spectrum. We also tested WCP-QAOA in solving a 6-qubit knapsack problem.
summary:
组合优化中的不等式约束通常通过引入松弛变量和二次惩罚来处理，这会增加量子比特数并扭曲优化景观。相反，无松弛公式直接将非线性自定义惩罚函数应用于约束，这很难在量子近似优化算法（QAOA）中实现。我们证明，沃尔什-哈达玛变换 (WHT) 消除了任何惩罚函数的这种障碍：应用于线性约束的惩罚恰好是 Pauli-$Z$ 字符串的加权和。我们建议将此框架称为沃尔什自定义惩罚 QAOA (WCP-QAOA)。截断沃尔什度 $k$ 的展开式会花费 $\mathcal{O}(n^k)$ 泡利项，并且量子比特数保持不变。截断是 $L^2$ 中惩罚的最优 $k$ 近似，并且我们给出了丢弃的沃尔什系数的条件，在该条件下，截断的哈密顿量仍然将每个可行解排在每个不可行解之下。

由于根据定义评估沃尔什系数需要所有 $2^n$ 惩罚值，因此我们给出了一种在次指数时间内返回任何系数的算法，以便在固定 $k$ 的 $n$ 中以时间多项式获得度 $k$ 哈密顿量。我们证明，对于指数惩罚，存在 WHT 的封闭乘积形式，因此存在计算沃尔什系数的封闭形式表达式。我们确定了缩短确切谱的结构捷径。我们还测试了 WCP-QAOA 解决 6 量子位背包问题的能力。

title: Gap Amplification for Local Hamiltonians with Combinatorial Soundness
