abstract: The quantum PCP conjecture is one of the major open problems in quantum complexity theory. It has resisted attack in part because many primitives used in the proof of the classical PCP theorem, such as locality-preserving gap amplification and alphabet reduction, have no obvious quantum analogues due to quantum no-cloning. Locality-preserving gap amplification is a procedure that takes as input a local Hamiltonian problem instance and produces a new instance with a larger promise gap, without increasing the locality of the Hamiltonian, and instead moderately increasing its local qudit dimension. Obtaining this kind of control over the locality during gap amplification is critical to the success of many known strategies for proving the classical PCP theorem. In this work, we put forth the first known viable template for quantum locality-preserving gap amplification, and we prove that our procedure amplifies the combinatorial gap of local Hamiltonians. Our work introduces a new framework for reasoning about quantum gap amplification in terms of fault-tolerant computation, and illuminates a route toward importing one of the central ingredients in classical PCPs into the quantum setting. In particular, we build upon ideas from the recent classical PCP of Bafna--Minzer--Vyas based on high-dimensional expanders, and the circuit-to-Hamiltonian construction of Anshu--Breuckmann--Nguyen, in addition to several recent advances in quantum coding theory.
summary:
量子PCP猜想是量子复杂性理论中的主要开放问题之一。它之所以能够抵御攻击，部分原因在于经典 PCP 定理证明中使用的许多原语，例如保局性间隙放大和字母缩减，由于量子不可克隆而没有明显的量子类似物。保留局部性间隙放大是一个过程，它将局部哈密顿量问题实例作为输入，并生成具有更大承诺间隙的新实例，而不增加哈密顿量的局部性，而是适度增加其局部 qdit 维度。在带隙放大过程中获得这种对局部性的控制对于证明经典 PCP 定理的许多已知策略的成功至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了第一个已知的可行的量子定域性保持间隙放大模板，并且证明我们的程序放大了局部哈密顿量的组合间隙。

我们的工作引入了一种新的框架，用于在容错计算方面推理量子带隙放大，并阐明了将经典 PCP 的核心成分之一导入量子环境的途径。特别是，我们基于 Bafna-Minzer-Vyas 最近基于高维展开器的经典 PCP 和 Anshu-Breuckmann-Nguyen 的电路到哈密尔顿构造的思想，以及量子编码理论的一些最新进展。

title: Improved Upper and Lower Bounds for Quantum Convex-Body Volume Estimation
abstract: Estimating the volume of a high-dimensional convex body is a fundamental problem in theoretical computer science. Given a quantum membership oracle for a convex body $K\subset\mathbb{R}^d$, we show that estimating $\mathrm{vol}(K)$ to relative error $\varepsilon$ takes $\widetilde O(d^{5/2}+d^{3/2}/\varepsilon)$ queries. This improves the previous quantum upper bound $\widetilde O(d^3+d^{9/4}/\varepsilon)$ of Chakrabarti et al. (ACM TQC 2023) and Cornelissen--Hamoudi (SODA 2023), and achieves a larger quantum speedup over the currently best classical upper bound $\widetilde O(d^{7/2}+d^3/\varepsilon^2)$ of Jia et al. (JACM 2026). Our quantum algorithm combines two new ingredients: an input-dependent effective spectral-gap analysis of quantum walks based on uniform classical warm-start mixing bounds, and a single quantum estimator for products of normalizer ratios in simulated annealing based on classical bridge sampling. We also prove an $\Omega(d)$ quantum query lower bound for constant relative error, improving the previous $\Omega(\sqrt d)$ lower bound.
summary: 估计高维凸体的体积是理论计算机科学中的一个基本问题。给定凸体 $K\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ 的量子隶属度预言，我们表明估计 $\mathrm{vol}(K)$ 到相对误差 $\varepsilon$ 需要 $\widetilde O(d^{5/2}+d^{3/2}/\varepsilon)$ 查询。这改进了 Chakrabarti 等人之前的量子上限 $\widetilde O(d^3+d^{9/4}/\varepsilon)$。 (ACM TQC 2023) 和 Cornelissen--Hamoudi (SODA 2023)，并且比 Jia 等人的当前最佳经典上限 $\widetilde O(d^{7/2}+d^3/\varepsilon^2)$ 实现了更大的量子加速。 （JACM 2026）。我们的量子算法结合了两种新成分：基于均匀经典热启动混合界限的量子行走的输入相关有效谱间隙分析，以及基于经典桥采样的模拟退火中归一化比率乘积的单量子估计器。我们还证明了恒定相对误差的 $\Omega(d)$ 量子查询下界，改进了之前的 $\Omega(\sqrt d)$ 下界。

title: Process tensor simulations of non-Markovian open quantum systems with large uncoupled subspaces
abstract: Process tensors in matrix product operator representation (PT-MPOs) are a powerful tool to calculate the temporal evolution and multi-time correlations of open quantum systems. While much progress has been made in making the calculation of process tensors for larger system dimensions possible, the numerical cost of the subsequent propagation of the system typically scales as $\mathcal{O}(d^6)$, which renders PT-MPO methods prohibitively expensive for system dimensions above several dozens. Here, we show how PT-MPO methods can be used efficiently when only some of the system states couple to the environment, and how combination with a Taylor expansion method allows for a reduction of the numerical complexity down to $\mathcal{O}(d^3)$. We show that these methods enable efficient simulations of systems with several hundreds of states. This is particularly relevant for solid-state cavity-QED systems with multiple modes, or when calculating frequency-filtered correlation functions by coupling sensor systems to the system of interest.
summary: 矩阵乘积算子表示中的过程张量（PT-MPO）是计算开放量子系统的时间演化和多次相关性的强大工具。虽然在计算更大系统尺寸的过程张量方面已经取得了很大进展，但系统后续传播的数值成本通常会达到 $\mathcal{O}(d^6)$，这使得 PT-MPO 方法对于系统尺寸超过几十个的情况变得极其昂贵。在这里，我们展示了当只有部分系统状态耦合到环境时如何有效地使用 PT-MPO 方法，以及如何与泰勒展开方法相结合将数值复杂度降低至 $\mathcal{O}(d^3)$。我们证明这些方法可以有效地模拟具有数百种状态的系统。这对于具有多种模式的固态腔 QED 系统，或者通过将传感器系统耦合到感兴趣的系统来计算频率滤波相关函数时尤其相关。

title: Onset of a quantum Fisher-Selke sequence in the transverse-field ANNNI model and its bilayer
abstract: We study the transverse-field axial next-nearest-neighbor Ising (ANNNI) model on the square lattice and on a bilayer. At the classical multiphase point $\kappa=J_2/J_0=1/2$, every configuration of straight domain walls that separates domains of at least two sites is a ground state. The walls are rigid, so perturbation theory in the transverse field $g=\Gamma/J_0$ can be carried out for each configuration separately, and we take it to order $g^8$. Quantum fluctuations select $\langle 3\rangle$ ($\uparrow\uparrow\uparrow\downarrow\downarrow\downarrow$) at order $g^2$, because spins next to a wall gain the most energy from virtual flips. The structures $\langle 23\rangle$, $\langle 223\rangle$ and $\langle 2223\rangle$ then open between $\langle 3\rangle$ and the antiphase $\langle 2\rangle$ at orders $g^4$, $g^6$ and $g^8$, in the order of the Fisher-Selke sequence of the classical three-dimensional model. A second layer suppresses each successive phase more strongly, beyond the stiffening of the local fields. We test the two widest phases with stochastic series expansion quantum Monte Carlo, comparing the free energies of the competing ordered states by thermodynamic integration, since annealing freezes in the modulation that forms at the ordering transition. The simulations reproduce the $\langle 3\rangle$ wedge to about 1%, and in a pre-registered test $\langle 23\rangle$ is stable at six of seven points, with the seventh resolved by post-hoc runs.
summary:
我们研究了方晶格和双层上的横向场轴向次近邻 Ising (ANNNI) 模型。在经典多相点 $\kappa=J_2/J_0=1/2$ 处，分隔至少两个位点的磁域的直磁畴壁的每种配置都是基态。墙体是刚性的，因此可以对每个配置分别进行横向场$g=\Gamma/J_0$的微扰理论，我们将其定为$g^8$。量子涨落选择$\langle 3\rangle$ ($\uparrow\uparrow\uparrow\downarrow\downarrow\downarrow$)，阶数为$g^2$，因为靠近墙壁的自旋从虚拟翻转中获得了最多的能量。然后，结构 $\langle 23\rangle$、$\langle 223\rangle$ 和 $\langle 2223\rangle$ 在 $\langle 3\rangle$ 和反相 $\langle 2\rangle$ 之间按经典三维模型的 Fisher-Selke 序列的阶数 $g^4$、$g^6$ 和 $g^8$ 打开。第二层更强烈地抑制每个连续相，超出了局部场的硬化。

我们使用随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗测试了两个最宽的相，通过热力学积分比较了竞争有序态的自由能，因为退火在有序转变时形成的调制中冻结。模拟将 $\langle 3\rangle$ 楔形再现到大约 1%，并且在预先注册的测试中 $\langle 23\rangle$ 在七个点中的六个点上稳定，第七个点通过事后运行解决。

title: JAQSI: Just Another Quantum Simulator
abstract: Classical simulation supports the development and validation of quantum algorithms through full-state inspection, controlled noise models and backpropagation, albeit for small quantum systems. Existing frameworks offer gate-level execution, differentiable pulse-level dynamics or optimised hardware execution. Just another quantum simulator (JAQSI) combines gate- and pulse-level simulation in one differentiable circuit model built upon JAX. Circuits are represented as pure functions of numerical inputs which support vectorised batches and JIT compilation. Within a single circuit, matrix-defined operations, gates synthesised from Hamiltonian time evolution and noise channels can be composed freely. For a fast simulation, gate and channel fusion reduces passes over the state, while adjoint differentiation computes expectation-value gradients with a constant number of statevectors. At pulse level, JAQSI reduces evolution under single-term Hamiltonians to a scalar pulse-area integral and reuses cached execution plans and compiled solvers. In a benchmark we compare JAQSI with PennyLane, Qiskit, Qibo, Qulacs, QuTiP and dynamiqs. At gate level, we observe performance either on par or an order of magnitude faster across statevector, density, noise and gradient simulation than the compared simulators up to 12 qubits. Beyond 18 qubits, JAQSI is on par with PennyLane Lightning in both statevector and gradient simulation. In the statevector and noisy density-matrix pulse benchmarks, it is at least 5 times faster than the other simulators, even with its closed-form solve disabled. Disabling the latter increases its runtime by at most a factor of 1.5. We provide JAQSI as open-source software on GitHub and PyPI.
summary:
经典模拟通过全状态检查、受控噪声模型和反向传播支持量子算法的开发和验证，尽管是针对小型量子系统。现有框架提供门级执行、可微分脉冲级动态或优化的硬件执行。另一种量子模拟器 (JAQSI) 将门级模拟和脉冲级模拟结合在一个基于 JAX 构建的可微电路模型中。电路表示为数字输入的纯函数，支持矢量化批处理和 JIT 编译。在单个电路内，矩阵定义的运算、哈密顿时间演化合成的门和噪声通道可以自由组合。对于快速仿真，门和通道融合减少了状态传递，而伴随微分则使用恒定数量的状态向量计算期望值梯度。在脉冲级别，JAQSI 将单项哈密顿量下的演化简化为标量脉冲面积积分，并重用缓存的执行计划和编译的求解器。在基准测试中，我们将 JAQSI 与 PennyLane、Qiskit、Qibo、Qulacs、QuTiP 和 dynamqs 进行比较。

在门级，我们观察到在状态向量、密度、噪声和梯度模拟方面的性能与最多 12 个量子位的比较模拟器相比，性能相当或快一个数量级。除了 18 个量子位之外，JAQSI 在状态向量和梯度模拟方面与 PennyLane Lightning 不相上下。在状态向量和噪声密度矩阵脉冲基准测试中，即使禁用封闭式求解，它也至少比其他模拟器快 5 倍。禁用后者最多可将其运行时间增加 1.5 倍。我们在 GitHub 和 PyPI 上提供 JAQSI 作为开源软件。

title: Training Variational Quantum Algorithms Is NP-Hard, Even Locally
abstract: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) generally rely on classical optimization to train parameterized quantum circuits. This training seeks to minimize an objective function, and its efficiency is central to the practical success of these algorithms. However, globally minimizing such training objectives over the circuit parameters is known to be $\mathsf{NP}$-hard, limiting the prospect of general guarantees for efficient training. In this Letter, we prove that even the weaker task of finding a local minimum of such VQA training objectives is strongly $\mathsf{NP}$-hard, including when the objective admits efficient classical evaluation. Moreover, we show that this hardness persists even for the task of finding a parameter vector within $\ell_p$-distance strictly less than $\pi/2$ of some local minimizer, for every $p\geq 1$. Our central technical result is that approximating a local minimizer of a Hermitian trigonometric polynomial is strongly $\mathsf{NP}$-hard. By explicitly constructing quantum circuits whose training objectives reproduce these hard instances, we obtain a polynomial-time reduction to VQA training. Our results establish a fundamental computational barrier to variational quantum training: even reaching the vicinity of a local minimum remains hard in the worst case.
summary:
变分量子算法（VQA）通常依赖经典优化来训练参数化量子电路。这种训练旨在最小化目标函数，其效率对于这些算法的实际成功至关重要。然而，众所周知，全局最小化电路参数上的此类训练目标是 $\mathsf{NP}$ 困难的，限制了有效训练的一般保证的前景。在这封信中，我们证明，即使是寻找此类 VQA 训练目标的局部最小值的较弱任务也非常困难，包括当目标允许有效的经典评估时。此外，我们表明，即使对于寻找 $\ell_p$ 距离内的参数向量严格小于某个局部最小化器的 $\pi/2$ 的任务，这种困难仍然存在，对于每个 $p\geq 1$。我们的核心技术结果是，逼近埃尔米特三角多项式的局部极小值是非常困难的。通过显式构建其训练目标重现这些困难实例的量子电路，我们获得了 VQA 训练的多项式时间缩减。

我们的结果为变分量子训练建立了基本的计算障碍：在最坏的情况下，即使达到局部最小值附近仍然很困难。

title: The diffusive spectral gap of the qubit eSWAP chain
abstract: We prove that the second-moment Hamiltonian of the open qubit eSWAP chain has a diffusive spectral gap, resolving a conjecture of Li, Zheng, Liu, Jiang, and Liu. We also characterise the ground space on every connected interaction graph with at least five vertices and prove a uniform lower bound for the unnormalised complete-graph gap. We apply these results to sequential and brickwork circuits and prove that the periodic chain also has a diffusive spectral gap.
summary: 我们证明了开放量子位 eSWAP 链的二阶矩哈密顿量具有扩散谱间隙，解决了 Li、Zheng、Liu、Jiang 和 Liu 的猜想。我们还描述了每个至少有五个顶点的连接交互图上的地面空间，并证明了非标准化完整图间隙的统一下界。我们将这些结果应用于顺序电路和砖砌电路，并证明周期链也具有扩散光谱间隙。

title: On the Completeness of Quantum Mechanics: Sources, Records and Probabilities
abstract: Can quantum mechanics be complete without being fundamental? Under stated source, detector, and statistical conditions, we reconstruct the quantum representation and Born probabilities and prove complete algebraic closure of the admitted quantum predictions without requiring a collapse postulate. We further show that many familiar quantum paradoxes arise from conflating coherent processes with retained records or probabilities with realized outcomes. We also ask whether mathematics as a whole, or the source architecture itself, emerges from a deeper structure.
summary: 量子力学可以在不具有基础性的情况下是完整的吗？在规定的源、探测器和统计条件下，我们重建了量子表示和玻恩概率，并证明了所承认的量子预测的完全代数闭包，而不需要崩溃假设。我们进一步表明，许多熟悉的量子悖论是由于将连贯过程与保留的记录或概率与已实现的结果混为一谈而产生的。我们还询问数学作为一个整体，或者源架构本身，是否是从更深层次的结构中产生的。

title: Error-Transparent Code Switching Between Permutation-Invariant Codes with Transversal Clifford and Icosahedral Gates
abstract: Code switching moves an encoded qubit between two codes whose transversal gates together are universal, but the switching operation itself is usually not transversal and can spread a single fault into an uncorrectable error. We study switching between two permutation-invariant codes on the same qubits, one with transversal Clifford gates and one with transversal gates from the non-Clifford binary icosahedral group. Both are compatible with transversal $X$, $Z$, and $F = HS^\dagger$, and the encoders with this property form a small linear space. We show that its codes of distance at least three are cut out by at most two quadratic equations, and that all of them have the same error geometry in the sense that their single-qubit error states have the same inner products. It follows that a switching unitary commuting with qubit permutations and with the shared transversal gates at every instant, and tolerating one single-qubit fault at an unknown time, exists if and only if the two codes are joined by a continuous path of distance-three codes. Such a switch can be made error transparent, so that a fault at any moment reaches the target code as the same single-qubit error. For real encoders, the distance-three codes are the solutions of a single quadratic equation, and on thirteen qubits, they form an explicit circle through two Clifford codes and an icosahedral code. We construct the switching unitary along this circle as a collective operator, leaving its synthesis into physical control open, and verify that its recovery infidelity per fault is at machine precision, whereas two natural alternatives leave average infidelities of $0.13$ and $0.85$. A survey over odd qubit numbers up to $29$ lists where such switches exist.
summary:
代码切换在两个代码之间移动编码的量子位，这两个代码的横向门在一起是通用的，但切换操作本身通常不是横向的，并且可以将单个故障传播为不可纠正的错误。我们研究相同量子位上两个排列不变代码之间的切换，一种具有横向克利福德门，另一种具有来自非克利福德二元二十面体群的横向门。两者都兼容横向$X$、$Z$和$F = HS^\dagger$，并且具有此属性的编码器形成一个小的线性空间。我们证明，其至少三个距离的代码被至多两个二次方程切出，并且所有这些代码都具有相同的误差几何形状，因为它们的单量子位误差状态具有相同的内积。由此可见，当且仅当两个代码通过距离为三的代码的连续路径连接时，才存在一种在每一时刻都具有量子位排列和共享横向门的交换酉交换，并且在未知时间容忍一个单量子位故障。这样的开关可以使错误透明，以便任何时刻的错误都像相同的单量子位错误一样到达目标代码。

对于真实编码器，距离三码是单个二次方程的解，并且在十三个量子位上，它们通过两个克利福德码和一个二十面体码形成显式圆。我们沿着这个圆构建切换酉作为一个集体算子，将其合成开放到物理控制中，并验证其每次故障的恢复不忠度达到机器精度，而两种自然替代方案的平均不忠度为 0.13 美元和 0.85 美元。一项针对高达 29 美元的奇数量子位的调查列出了存在此类开关的地方。

title: Universal and rigorous asymptotic convergence of standard macroscopic quantum electrodynamics to the modified Langevin noise formalism
abstract: The standard Langevin noise formalism (LNF) is a well-established approach for macroscopic quantum electrodynamics in unbounded lossy media, and accordingly, its application to finite objects requires endowing the surrounding vacuum with a fictitious absorption that is taken to asymptotically vanish. Existing justifications for such a singular limiting procedure have been mainly restricted to phenomena governed by vacuum fluctuations and medium-induced interactions (Casimir-Polder forces, thermal radiation, quantum emitter dynamics, etc.), thereby strictly excluding scenarios that involve the scattering of external quantum radiation. Conversely, the modified Langevin noise formalism (MLNF) has recently been established as the complete canonical quantum theory for arbitrary macroscopic systems and electromagnetic processes, entirely bypassing the need for limiting procedures, treating incident quantum radiation fields as independent degrees of freedom, and exactly reducing to the LNF for unbounded media. In this work, we demonstrate that the LNF limiting procedure is universally valid by showing that it recovers any physical prediction of the MLNF across all regimes, including arbitrary quantum scattering processes. Specifically, we introduce a suitable mapping associating any MLNF state and observable with a corresponding entity within the LNF augmented by fictitious vacuum absorption. We then rigorously prove that, as the fictitious absorption tends to zero, every LNF matrix element constructed via this mapping exactly converges to its MLNF original, so that the limiting procedure establishes the asymptotic convergence of the LNF to the MLNF.
summary:
标准朗之万噪声形式主义 (LNF) 是无界有损介质中宏观量子电动力学的一种行之有效的方法，因此，将其应用于有限物体需要赋予周围真空以渐近消失的虚拟吸收。这种单一限制程序的现有理由主要限于由真空涨落和介质引起的相互作用（卡西米尔-波尔德力、热辐射、量子发射器动力学等）控制的现象，从而严格排除涉及外部量子辐射散射的情况。相反，修正的朗之万噪声形式主义（MLNF）最近被建立为任意宏观系统和电磁过程的完整规范量子理论，完全绕过了限制程序的需要，将入射量子辐射场视为独立的自由度，并精确地简化为无界介质的LNF。

在这项工作中，我们证明了 LNF 限制过程是普遍有效的，因为它可以恢复所有机制（包括任意量子散射过程）中 MLNF 的任何物理预测。具体来说，我们引入了一种合适的映射，将任何 MLNF 状态和可观察到的 LNF 状态与通过虚拟真空吸收增强的相应实体相关联。然后，我们严格证明，当虚拟吸收趋于零时，通过该映射构造的每个 LNF 矩阵元素都精确地收敛到其 MLNF 原始矩阵，因此极限过程建立了 LNF 到 MLNF 的渐近收敛。

title: Theory of the Edge-of-Chaos Advantage in Quantum Reservoir Computing
abstract: Numerical studies suggest that quantum reservoir computing performs optimally near the edge of chaos, a behavior commonly attributed to a balance between memory retention and nonlinear information processing. Here we develop an explicit quantum reservoir model and rigorously analyze its chaotic regime and integrable point. In the chaotic regime, we show that Gaussian-unitary-ensemble statistics lead to rapid memory loss: learning performance decays exponentially with the storage time required by a temporal task. This decay limits the ability of chaotic reservoirs to learn long-range temporal dependencies. At the integrable point, described by a free-fermion model, we prove that amplitude encoding and a linear readout of fermionic two-point correlations cannot learn a representative class of nonlinear tasks coupling present and past inputs. Introducing interactions alleviates this obstruction. By identifying distinct limitations on memory retention in the chaotic regime and nonlinear processing at the integrable point, our analysis provides a theoretical basis for the observed edge-of-chaos advantage and guides the design of quantum reservoirs for temporal learning.
summary: 数值研究表明，量子存储计算在混沌边缘附近表现最佳，这种行为通常归因于记忆保留和非线性信息处理之间的平衡。在这里，我们开发了一个显式量子储层模型，并严格分析了其混沌状态和可积点。在混沌状态下，我们表明高斯酉系综统计会导致记忆快速丢失：学习性能随着时间任务所需的存储时间呈指数衰减。这种衰减限制了混沌储存库学习长期时间依赖性的能力。在自由费米子模型描述的可积点，我们证明幅度编码和费米子两点相关性的线性读出无法学习耦合当前和过去输入的非线性任务的代表性类别。引入交互可以缓解这种障碍。通过识别混沌状态中记忆保留的明显限制和可积点处的非线性处理，我们的分析为观察到的混沌边缘优势提供了理论基础，并指导了用于时间学习的量子存储库的设计。

title: Cups and Gates II: Operads, twists, and addressable intra-code gates
abstract: In Part I, we introduced a general framework for constructing logical gates in quantum CSS codes from cohomology invariants, focusing on cup products and their generalizations from topological to qLDPC codes. In particular, we produced a family of $C^{k-1}Z$ logical gates that we called copy-cup on $k$ copies of the same quantum code implemented by finite-depth circuits. Here, we vastly extend this framework by introducing twists incorporating code automorphisms, higher twisted cohomology operations, and folding operations in relative cohomology. The framework includes operations lifting coefficients from $\mathbb{Z}/2$ to $\mathbb{Z}/2^k$, enabling all diagonal logical gates such as single-qubit rotations $\operatorname{R}(2\pi/2^k)$. Composing these operations with maps that select cohomology classes yields addressable logical gates. Examples include addressable $T$ gates on three- and four-tori and gates in qLDPC codes beyond topological ones. We introduce cohomology operations, such as the higher twisted Pontryagin powers, that to our knowledge have not previously appeared in the mathematics literature. These operations arise from $E_\infty$-structures on cochains, with explicit constructions using cyclic resolutions and the surjection operad. We expect these results to be of independent interest in homotopy theory. Our formalism applies much more broadly to chain complexes carrying suitable operadic structures, and we expect this operadic perspective to uncover further connections between homotopy theory and fault-tolerant quantum gates.
summary:
在第一部分中，我们介绍了从上同调不变量在量子 CSS 代码中构造逻辑门的通用框架，重点关注杯积及其从拓扑到 qLDPC 代码的推广。特别是，我们在由有限深度电路实现的相同量子代码的 $k$ 副本上生成了一系列 $C^{k-1}Z$ 逻辑门，我们将其称为 copy-cup。在这里，我们通过引入结合代码自同构的扭曲、更高扭曲上同调运算以及相对上同调中的折叠运算来极大地扩展该框架。该框架包括将系数从 $\mathbb{Z}/2$ 提升到 $\mathbb{Z}/2^k$ 的操作，从而启用所有对角线逻辑门，例如单量子位旋转 $\operatorname{R}(2\pi/2^k)$。将这些运算与选择上同调类的映射组合起来会产生可寻址的逻辑门。示例包括三环和四环上的可寻址 $T$ 门以及拓扑之外的 qLDPC 代码中的门。我们引入了上同调运算，例如更高扭曲的庞特里亚金幂，据我们所知，这些运算以前从未出现在数学文献中。

这些操作源自 cochains 上的 $E_\infty$-结构，具有使用循环解析和满射操作的显式构造。我们期望这些结果对同伦理论具有独立的意义。我们的形式主义更广泛地适用于携带合适歌剧结构的链复合体，我们期望这种歌剧视角能够揭示同伦理论和容错量子门之间的进一步联系。

title: Origin and classification of fractional dynamical topology in non-Hermitian quantum systems
abstract: Dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPT) provide a fundamental framework for characterizing nonequilibrium critical phenomena, and have recently been extended to non-Hermitian systems. Half-integer jumps of the dynamical topological order parameter can arise in both Hermitian and non-Hermitian systems, yet their origin in non-Hermitian settings remains unclear. Here, we investigate DQPTs in a two-band non-Hermitian model and show that these fractional jumps originate from the discontinuity in the complex energy spectrum. We demonstrate that this behavior is intrinsically linked to the steady-state phase diagram of the quench Hamiltonian, and also classify the occurrence of DQPT. We further extend our analysis to the multiband Hamiltonian and the two-dimensional model, providing a unified understanding of fractional dynamical topological signatures.
summary: 动态量子相变（DQPT）为表征非平衡临界现象提供了一个基本框架，并且最近已扩展到非厄米系统。动态拓扑序参数的半整数跳跃在厄米和非厄米系统中都可能出现，但它们在非厄米设置中的起源仍不清楚。在这里，我们研究了双带非厄米特模型中的 DQPT，并表明这些分数跳跃源于复杂能谱的不连续性。我们证明了这种行为与失超哈密顿量的稳态相图有内在联系，并对 DQPT 的出现进行了分类。我们进一步将分析扩展到多带哈密顿量和二维模型，提供对分数动态拓扑特征的统一理解。

title: Quantum n-coloring is undecidable for every n $\ge$ 3
abstract: The quantum $n$-coloring problem, given graph $G$, asks whether there exists a perfect quantum strategy for the $n$-coloring game of $G$. Previously it was known that quantum $n$-coloring is undecidable only for $n=3$. We extend this to all $n\geq 3$ with one elementary reduction. Letting $G'=(G\square K_3)\lor K_{n-3}$, we show that $G$ is quantum $3$-colorable if and only if $G'$ is quantum $n$-colorable.
summary: 量子 $n$ 着色问题，给定图 $G$，询问 $G$ 的 $n$ 着色游戏是否存在完美的量子策略。此前已知量子 $n$ 着色仅在 $n=3$ 时不可判定。我们通过一次基本约简将其扩展到所有 $n\geq 3$。令$G'=(G\square K_3)\lor K_{n-3}$，我们证明$G$是量子$3$可着色的当且仅当$G'$是量子$n$可着色的。

title: Fast Random Compilers for Time-Dependent and Time-Independent Lindbladian Simulation
abstract: Randomized product formulas provide simple and flexible methods for quantum simulation. While qDRIFT-type randomized simulation has been extended to Lindbladian dynamics, higher-order randomized compilers have primarily been developed for Hamiltonian simulation. In this work, we develop first- and second-order randomized sampling algorithms for Lindbladian simulation in both the time-independent and time-dependent settings. Building on first-order qDRIFT-type Lindbladian simulation, we introduce a qSWIFT-type second-order correction for time-independent Lindbladians with a finite local decomposition. For $\lambda t \geq 1$, where $\lambda$ is the sum of the Hamiltonian coefficients and dissipative rates, the resulting approximation achieves normalized diamond-norm error at most $\varepsilon$ using $r=O(\lambda^2 t^2/\sqrt{\varepsilon})$ time slices, improving the $\varepsilon^{-1}$ precision dependence of the first-order qDRIFT-type approximation. We then develop first- and second-order continuous-time sampling algorithms for general time-dependent Lindbladians, with the second-order construction likewise achieving an $\varepsilon^{-1/2}$ dependence on the target precision in the number of time slices. We further extend the time-dependent construction to a linear-combination input model over local Hamiltonian and dissipative generators, allowing the randomized sampler to be formulated in terms of local evolutions rather than the full time-dependent Lindbladian. Because the second-order corrected maps need not be CPTP, we use them to estimate observable expectation values rather than to deterministically prepare output states.
summary:
随机乘积公式为量子模拟提供了简单灵活的方法。虽然 qDRIFT 型随机模拟已扩展到 Lindbladian 动力学，但高阶随机编译器主要是为哈密顿模拟而开发的。在这项工作中，我们为与时间无关和与时间相关的设置中的 Lindbladian 模拟开发一阶和二阶随机采样算法。基于一阶 qDRIFT 型 Lindbladian 模拟，我们引入了一种 qSWIFT 型二阶修正，用于具有有限局部分解的时间无关的 Lindbladians。对于 $\lambda t \geq 1$，其中 $\lambda$ 是哈密顿系数和耗散率之和，得到的近似值使用 $r=O(\lambda^2 t^2/\sqrt{\varepsilon})$ 时间片最多实现归一化钻石范数误差 $\varepsilon$，从而改善一阶 qDRIFT 类型的 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 精度依赖性近似值。

然后，我们为一般时间相关的 Lindbladians 开发一阶和二阶连续时间采样算法，二阶结构同样实现了对时间片数量的目标精度的 $\varepsilon^{-1/2}$ 依赖性。我们进一步将时间相关的构造扩展到局部哈密顿量和耗散生成器上的线性组合输入模型，允许根据局部演化而不是完全时间相关的 Lindbladian 来制定随机采样器。因为二阶校正图不需要是 CPTP，所以我们使用它们来估计可观察的期望值，而不是确定性地准备输出状态。

title: Lifted surgery for non-Abelian two-block group-algebra codes
abstract: Code surgery measures a logical operator of a quantum LDPC code with $O(d)$ rounds of syndrome extraction. Lifted surgery amortises this cost on Abelian group-algebra codes by measuring an orbit of logical operators under a translation symmetry in one merged code. We extend it to two-block group-algebra codes over non-Abelian groups and ask whether non-commutativity lets one merged code measure more operators than any Abelian group of its symmetries. We classify the block-affine automorphisms of these codes and find that, measured against this full group, most apparent non-Abelian gains disappear. We prove that the gain is at most the index of a largest Abelian subgroup. We find codes with exact distance up to $13$ where the gain is two, including codes in which one merged code reads out every logical qubit, and codes over products of $A_4$, $S_4$ and SL(2,3) with gain three for a best logical, up to $[[336,26,12]]$. A merged-distance lemma gives a simple condition for the gadget to preserve the code distance. In circuit-level simulations with Relay-BP decoding, at the error rates we can resolve, the non-Abelian gadget is as reliable as, or more reliable than, the Abelian gadgets it replaces within statistical error, while using two to three times fewer rounds.
summary:
代码手术通过 $O(d)$ 轮校正子提取来测量量子 LDPC 码的逻辑运算符。提升手术通过测量一个合并代码中平移对称性下逻辑运算符的轨道来摊销阿贝尔群代数代码的成本。我们将其扩展到非阿贝尔群上的两块群代数代码，并询问非交换性是否允许一个合并代码比其对称性的任何阿贝尔群测量更多的运算符。我们对这些代码的块仿射自同构进行分类，并发现，针对整个组进行测量，最明显的非阿贝尔增益消失了。我们证明增益至多是最大阿贝尔子群的指数。我们发现精确距离高达 $13$ 的代码，其中增益为 2，包括其中一个合并代码读出每个逻辑量子位的代码，以及对 $A_4$、$S_4$ 和 SL(2,3) 的乘积进行编码，增益为 3，以获得最佳逻辑，最高可达 $[[336,26,12]]$。合并距离引理为小工具提供了保持代码距离的简单条件。

在使用 Relay-BP 解码的电路级模拟中，在我们可以解决的错误率下，非阿贝尔小工具在统计误差范围内与它所取代的阿贝尔小工具一样可靠，甚至更可靠，同时使用的轮数少了两到三倍。

title: Shallow Quantum Circuits for Geometrically Local Lindblad Dynamics
abstract: Open-system dynamics govern decoherence, transport, and engineered dissipation in quantum many-body systems. We propose a quantum algorithm for simulating time-independent, finite-range Lindblad dynamics with bounded local strength on a constant-dimensional lattice of $n$ sites, allowing noncommuting jump operators. For time $T\ge1$ and diamond-norm error at most $\epsilon$, it has depth $O(T\operatorname{polylog}(nT/\epsilon))$ and gate count $O(nT\operatorname{polylog}(nT/\epsilon))$. These results extend the HHKL spatial decomposition to open systems. The main obstacle is that the reversible overlap corrections used for unitary dynamics have no direct analogue for dissipative channels. We overcome this by retaining the environment in a shared unitary dilation, keeping information lost from the system coherently available and making the spatial corrections reversible. We prove exponential occupation bounds for the environmental states generated by the decomposition, allowing compact representation and coherent simulation of local factors on the inputs that arise. The construction reduces each short-time evolution to a constant number of parallel layers on regions of logarithmic diameter, using nearest-neighbour gates and polylogarithmic auxiliary density. We also prove unconditional worst-case lower bounds using time-independent, purely dissipative processes that transport quantum information. For circuits with local quantum and classical communication, the lower bounds are $\Omega(nT)$ for the expected gate count and $\Omega(T)$ for depth on time scales up to the lattice diameter. They match the upper bounds' leading time and volume dependence up to polylogarithmic factors. At fixed time and sufficiently small fixed error, we further prove a depth lower bound of $\Omega(\log n/\log\log n)$, showing that global accuracy can require increasing depth as the lattice grows.
summary:
开放系统动力学控制量子多体系统中的退相干、传输和工程耗散。我们提出了一种量子算法，用于在 $n$ 站点的常维晶格上模拟具有有限局部强度的时间无关、有限范围 Lindblad 动力学，允许非交换跳跃算子。对于时间 $T\ge1$ 和最多 $\epsilon$ 的钻石范数误差，它的深度为 $O(T\operatorname{polylog}(nT/\epsilon))$ 和门数 $O(nT\operatorname{polylog}(nT/\epsilon))$。这些结果将 HHKL 空间分解扩展到开放系统。主要障碍是用于单一动力学的可逆重叠校正对于耗散通道没有直接的模拟。我们通过将环境保留在共享的单一膨胀中、保持系统丢失的信息一致可用并使空间校正可逆来克服这个问题。我们证明了分解生成的环境状态的指数占据界限，从而允许对所出现的输入进行局部因素的紧凑表示和连贯模拟。

该结构使用最近邻门和多对数辅助密度，将每个短时演化减少到对数直径区域上的恒定数量的平行层。我们还使用传输量子信息的与时间无关的纯耗散过程证明了无条件最坏情况下界。对于具有局域量子和经典通信的电路，预期门数的下限为 $\Omega(nT)$，时间尺度上至晶格直径的深度下限为 $\Omega(T)$。它们将上限的领先时间和体积依赖性与多对数因子相匹配。在固定时间和足够小的固定误差下，我们进一步证明了 $\Omega(\log n/\log\log n)$ 的深度下界，表明随着晶格的增长，全局精度可能需要增加深度。

title: On State Distinguishing Without Inverse Queries
abstract: In the quantum state distinguishing problem, an algorithm is given copies of a state $|\psi\rangle$ or $|\phi\rangle$ separated by trace distance $\varepsilon$, and tasked with deciding which is the case. It is a standard result that $\Theta(\varepsilon^{-2})$ copies are required, while having access to a unitary state preparation oracle and its inverse improves this to $\Theta(\varepsilon^{-1})$ queries. We study the intermediate case with forward-only access, capturing scenarios where the oracle is a physical process that cannot be reversed. Tang and Wright recently showed that distinguishing a known state from an \emph{unknown} close state requires $\Omega(\varepsilon^{-2})$ forward queries in high dimension; we strengthen this result by proving the same bound even when both states are known, as in the state distinguishing setting. Moreover, our lower bound uses a direct hybrid argument, avoiding advanced compressed oracle techniques used in the prior work. In contrast, we give a dimension-independent algorithm solving a continuous-time variant of state distinguishing with only $O(\varepsilon^{-1})$ total forward evolution time. The algorithm uses quantum Zeno dynamics to confine evolution to a known two-dimensional subspace. Thus, a quadratic advantage survives without inverse access for a natural continuous-time analogue of state distinguishing.
summary:
在量子态区分问题中，算法会得到由迹线距离 $\varepsilon$ 分隔的状态 $|\psi\rangle$ 或 $|\phi\rangle$ 的副本，并负责确定是哪种情况。标准结果是需要 $\Theta(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 副本，同时可以访问统一状态准备预言机及其逆向改进为 $\Theta(\varepsilon^{-1})$ 查询。我们研究仅前向访问的中间情况，捕获预言机是无法逆转的物理过程的场景。 Tang 和 Wright 最近表明，区分已知状态和 \emph{unknown} 关闭状态需要 $\Omega(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 在高维中进行前向查询；我们通过证明相同的界限来加强这一结果，即使两个状态都是已知的，就像在状态区分环境中一样。此外，我们的下界使用直接混合参数，避免了先前工作中使用的高级压缩预言技术。相比之下，我们给出了一种与维度无关的算法，求解状态的连续时间变体，其总前向演化时间仅为 $O(\varepsilon^{-1})$。

该算法使用量子芝诺动力学将演化限制在已知的二维子空间内。因此，二次优势在没有状态区分的自然连续时间模拟的逆访问的情况下仍然存在。

title: Game of Nons: Non-Gaussian Nonunitary Environments with Nonlinear Coupling
abstract: We develop a perturbative framework for systems coupled quadratically to bosonic environments with quadratic Hamiltonians and linear Lindblad operators. The method applies to both single-mode and multimode environments whose initial states may be non-Gaussian and nonstationary. By combining linear evolution in a doubled operator space with a characteristic-function representation, we express ordered multitime environmental correlation functions in terms of derivatives of the initial characteristic function. These correlation functions enter a recursive construction of the time-convolutionless generator at arbitrary finite order. We illustrate the method with a qubit coupled to a damped mode via a two-photon interaction. Initial Fock and thermal states with identical first and second field moments produce different second-order generators through their fourth moments.
summary: 我们为具有二次哈密顿量和线性 Lindblad 算子的二次耦合到玻色环境的系统开发了一个微扰框架。该方法适用于初始状态可能是非高斯和非平稳的单模和多模环境。通过将双算子空间中的线性演化与特征函数表示相结合，我们用初始特征函数的导数来表达有序的多时间环境相关函数。这些相关函数以任意有限阶进入无时间卷积生成器的递归构造。我们通过双光子相互作用将量子位耦合到阻尼模式来说明该方法。具有相同第一和第二场矩的初始福克和热状态通过其第四矩产生不同的二阶发生器。

title: Nonlinear quantum multi-spin dynamics without entanglement
abstract: We introduce a distinct route for extending classical atomistic spin dynamics into the quantum regime for arbitrary spin $s$, based on a variational product-state \textit{ansatz} that includes both pure and mixed local states. By construction, intersite entanglement -- expected to remain negligible even on very short time scales in many real materials -- is excluded, while local quantum effects are retained through the nonclassical structure of $s\geq 1$ density operators, and nonlinear dynamics arise from both the mean-field interdependence of the local states and the state-dependent dissipative terms. This framework clarifies the variational and geometric origin of the inequivalence between quantum Landau-Lifshitz and Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics, provides a criterion for their equivalence under a common time rescaling, establishes connections with the classical theory through two qualitatively distinct limits ($s\to\infty$ and a large number of quantum spins $N$), and allows realistic $\mathcal{O}(N)$ simulations of quantum spin dynamics in materials.
summary: 我们引入了一种独特的路线，将经典原子自旋动力学扩展到任意自旋 $s$ 的量子体系中，基于变分乘积状态 \textit{ansatz} ，其中包括纯局域态和混合局域态。通过构造，位点间的纠缠（预计在许多实际材料中即使在非常短的时间尺度上也可以忽略不计）被排除在外，同时通过 $s\geq 1$ 密度算子的非经典结构保留局域量子效应，并且非线性动力学由局域态的平均场相互依赖性和状态相关耗散项产生。该框架阐明了量子Landau-Lifshitz和Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert动力学之间不等价性的变分和几何起源，为它们在共同时间重新缩放下的等价性提供了标准，通过两个定性不同的限制（$s\to\infty$和大量量子自旋$N$）与经典理论建立了联系，并允许对材料中的量子动力学自旋进行现实的$\mathcal{O}(N)$模拟。

title: Optimization Geometry of QAOA and Variational Quantum Algorithms
abstract: Variational quantum algorithms turn choices of Hamiltonian, ansatz, and parameterization into a classical nonconvex optimization problem. We study how this objective function can be visualized and characterized in ways that help explain optimizer behavior. We distinguish two properties of the objective: the number of local minima encountered along sampled directions and the differences in quality among local-search endpoints. We then ask how a local optimizer, represented by BFGS, compares with adaptive differential evolution, represented by jSO. Rather than comparing jSO with a single local run, we allow BFGS multiple starts within the same function-evaluation budget. This gives local search repeated opportunities to explore different basins and provides a stronger baseline for asking when a global evolutionary solver is useful. We study these questions using VQE and QAOA, focusing on how frustra- tion, circuit depth, parameter tying, mixed locality, and nonlinear repa- rameterization change the Hamiltonian expectation-value objective seen by the classical optimizer. Increasing independent circuit depth raises the sampled local-minimum count without making global search more effective. Parameter tying, by contrast, produces both more repeated local structure and much larger differences in quality among local-search endpoints, and in this regime adaptive differential evolution outperforms function-evaluation-matched multistart BFGS. The comparison shows that the number of local minima alone does not determine whether global search is advantageous: the important distinction is whether different basins lead to similarly good solutions or to substantially different objective values. These results provide a practical workflow for connecting model construction, objective- function geometry, empirical diagnostics, and optimizer choice.
summary:
变分量子算法将哈密顿量、拟参和参数化的选择转变为经典的非凸优化问题。我们研究如何以有助于解释优化器行为的方式可视化和表征该目标函数。我们区分了目标的两个属性：沿采样方向遇到的局部最小值的数量以及局部搜索端点之间的质量差异。然后我们询问以 BFGS 为代表的局部优化器与以 jSO 为代表的自适应差分进化相比如何。我们允许 BFGS 在同一功能评估预算内多次启动，而不是将 jSO 与单个本地运行进行比较。这为局部搜索提供了重复探索不同盆地的机会，并为询问全局进化求解器何时有用提供了更强的基线。我们使用 VQE 和 QAOA 研究这些问题，重点关注挫败感、电路深度、参数绑定、混合局部性和非线性重新参数化如何改变经典优化器所看到的哈密顿期望值目标。

增加独立电路深度会增加采样的局部最小计数，但不会使全局搜索更加有效。相比之下，参数绑定会产生更多重复的局部结构和局部搜索端点之间更大的质量差异，并且在这种情况下，自适应差分进化优于函数评估匹配的多起点 BFGS。比较表明，仅局部最小值的数量并不能确定全局搜索是否有利：重要的区别是不同的盆地是否会导致类似的良好解决方案或显着不同的目标值。这些结果为连接模型构建、目标函数几何、经验诊断和优化器选择提供了实用的工作流程。

title: A solvable quantum many-body problem
abstract: A many-body wavefunction exponential in R, where the square of R is the sum of the squares of the interparticle distances, is shown to be the solution of Schrodingers equation for a potential proportional to the reciprocal of R, for N particles. A set of translationally invariant rotational eigenstates of angular momentum is found.
summary: R 中的多体波函数指数（其中 R 的平方是粒子间距离的平方和）是薛定谔方程的解，对于 N 个粒子，势能与 R 的倒数成正比。找到了一组平移不变的角动量旋转本征态。

title: Frame-dependent coherence of Gaussian quantum states
abstract: A Hilbert space is usually described using an orthonormal basis, but a more general description can be defined using a tight frame. In the case of continuous-variable Gaussian states, the coherence is usually described using the Hermite-Gauss basis. We present an alternative description using the tight frame of all canonical coherent states. The description of Gaussian states in terms of coherent states is simpler than in terms of Hermite-Gauss basis, and this allows us to obtain an explicit formula describing the frame-dependent coherence of a mixed Gaussian state as a function of the determinant and the trace of covariance matrix. For each mixed Gaussian state, we construct a sequence of discrete-variable quantum states rapidly convergent to it (as concern the purity and coherence) when the dimension of Hilbert space becomes large enough (15 or more). In the discrete case, the coherence is measured with respect to the tight frame of all discrete coherent states.
summary: 希尔伯特空间通常使用正交基来描述，但可以使用紧框架来定义更一般的描述。在连续变量高斯态的情况下，相干性通常使用埃尔米特-高斯基来描述。我们使用所有规范相干态的严格框架提出了另一种描述。用相干态描述高斯态比用 Hermite-Gauss 基描述更简单，这使我们能够获得一个明确的公式，将混合高斯态的帧相关相干性描述为协方差矩阵的行列式和迹的函数。对于每个混合高斯态，当希尔伯特空间的维数变得足够大（15 或更大）时，我们构造一系列快速收敛到它的离散变量量子态（考虑到纯度和相干性）。在离散情况下，相干性是相对于所有离散相干态的紧框架来测量的。

title: Ground state energy estimation and preparation by the truncated power method
abstract: The Guided Local Hamiltonian Problem (GLHP) is the problem of ground state energy estimation and preparation given a guiding state having good overlap with the true ground state. The problem is known to be BQP-complete for small error but is classically tractable for larger error. In this work, we identify an orthogonal regime in which the problem is classically tractable, namely when the true ground state $\psi$ has polynomially bounded $\ell_1$-norm. In particular, we show that the Truncated Power Method (TPM), a classical algorithm introduced by Kirby et al. in the quantum context, has a runtime that is polynomially comparable to quantum algorithms for GLHP in all relevant parameters, except for an extra factor of $\|\psi\|_1^2$. In other words, if $\|\psi\|_1^2$ is polynomially bounded, then TPM dequantizes quantum algorithms for GLHP.
summary: 引导局部哈密顿问题（GLHP）是给定与真实基态具有良好重叠的引导态的基态能量估计和准备问题。对于小误差，该问题是 BQP 完全问题，但对于较大误差，该问题通常是可处理的。在这项工作中，我们确定了一个正交机制，其中问题在经典上是可处理的，即当真正的基态 $\psi$ 具有多项式有界 $\ell_1$-norm 时。特别是，我们展示了 Kirby 等人提出的经典算法截断功率法（TPM）。在量子上下文中，除了 $\|\psi\|_1^2$ 的额外因子外，在所有相关参数中，其运行时间与 GLHP 的量子算法在多项式上相当。换句话说，如果 $\|\psi\|_1^2$ 是多项式有界的，则 TPM 会反量化 GLHP 的量子算法。

title: Universal Improvement of Channel Fidelity via Entanglement Assistance
abstract: Communication using quantum channels generally requires encoding and decoding on many identical uses of a quantum channel. In practical settings, decoherence may severely limit our ability to do so, potentially rendering each channel use nonidentical. Given $n$ nonidentical channels, we present an entanglement-assisted encoding and decoding strategy that yields a channel with higher worst-case fidelity than all of the $n$ given channels. The strategy is universal, in the sense that the improvement holds regardless of what channels are given, as long as they satisfy mild assumptions on their initial entanglement fidelities. Our protocol is optimal when the given channels are depolarizing channels, and is essentially the unique one that is universal. This idea can also be extended to classical channels, where shared randomness between the sender and the receiver allows universal enhancement of the probability of correct transmission. We then consider general quantum resource theories, providing a necessary condition and a sufficient condition for the possibility of such universal improvement of quantum resources.
summary: 使用量子信道的通信通常需要对量子信道的许多相同用途进行编码和解码。在实际设置中，退相干可能会严重限制我们这样做的能力，可能会导致每个通道使用不相同。给定 $n$ 个不相同的通道，我们提出了一种纠缠辅助编码和解码策略，该策略产生的通道比所有 $n$ 个给定通道具有更高的最坏情况保真度。该策略是通用的，从某种意义上说，无论给定什么通道，只要它们满足对其初始纠缠保真度的温和假设，改进就会成立。当给定通道是去极化通道时，我们的协议是最佳的，并且本质上是唯一通用的协议。这个想法也可以扩展到经典信道，其中发送者和接收者之间共享的随机性允许普遍增强正确传输的概率。然后我们考虑广义量子资源理论，为量子资源的这种普遍改进的可能性提供必要条件和充分条件。

title: Momentum-Space Path Integral Approach to Non-Hermitian Symmetry Breaking
abstract: A quantum-classical correspondence for non-Hermitian symmetry breaking has recently been established using coordinate-space path integrals, providing a semiclassical understanding of spectral transitions at the level of individual eigenstates. Here we develop its dual formulation in momentum space by constructing the corresponding trace formula and quantization condition. We show that the real or complex nature of individual eigenvalues is determined by the symmetry properties of the associated semiclassical orbits, as in the coordinate-space path-integral approach. Moreover, we demonstrate that the topology of semiclassical orbits determines the natural formulation of the quantization condition: the coordinate- and momentum-space formulations are equivalent for contractible periodic orbits in phase space, whereas for noncontractible orbits, the quantization condition along the winding direction remains valid, but its dual form must be corrected by a boundary term. In particular, real-space-winding and Brillouin-zone-winding orbits naturally select coordinate- and momentum-space quantization, respectively. As a nontrivial application, we investigate the boundary-induced spectral transition of Bloch oscillations in a finite non-Hermitian lattice, where Bloch-oscillation orbits winding across the Brillouin zone preserve the relevant symmetry and yield real energy levels, whereas boundary-reflected orbits form symmetry-related pairs and give rise to complex-conjugate eigenvalues. Our work completes the quantum-classical correspondence framework for non-Hermitian symmetry breaking, extending its applicability to a broader class of non-Hermitian problems.
summary:
最近使用坐标空间路径积分建立了非厄米对称破缺的量子经典对应关系，提供了对单个本征态水平上光谱跃迁的半经典理解。在这里，我们通过构造相应的迹公式和量化条件，在动量空间中发展了它的对偶公式。我们证明，单个特征值的实数或复数性质是由相关半经典轨道的对称性决定的，就像坐标空间路径积分方法一样。此外，我们证明了半经典轨道的拓扑结构决定了量子化条件的自然公式：坐标空间公式和动量空间公式对于相空间中的可收缩周期轨道是等效的，而对于不可收缩轨道，沿缠绕方向的量子化条件仍然有效，但其对偶形式必须通过边界项进行校正。特别是，实空间缠绕和布里渊区缠绕轨道自然地分别选择坐标和动量空间量子化。

作为一个重要的应用，我们研究了有限非厄米晶格中布洛赫振荡的边界引起的谱跃迁，其中蜿蜒穿过布里渊区的布洛赫振荡轨道保留了相关的对称性并产生真实的能级，而边界反射轨道形成对称相关对并产生复共轭特征值。我们的工作完成了非厄米对称破缺的量子经典对应框架，将其适用性扩展到更广泛的非厄米问题。

title: An efficient Hamiltonian-based quantum algorithm for characters of the symmetric group
abstract: Consider a quantum state vector proportional to any given column of the character table of the symmetric group ($S_n$), corresponding to a superposition over the irreps weighted by the character values. It was recently argued that sampling from this state is classically hard under reasonable complexity-theoretic assumptions, while there exists an efficient quantum algorithm for preparing this character state using the quantum Fourier transform (QFT) over $S_n$ [ arXiv:2501.12579 ]. We give an alternative, simpler algorithm to prepare this character state with a sequence of Hamiltonian evolutions, as well as an efficient implementation with reconfigurable qubits that uses only nearest-neighbor gates in 1D. The gate complexity, accounting for Hamiltonian simulation errors, depends on the choice of the column: For fixed target state error, the estimated sufficient total gate count ranges from as few as $O(n)$ gates for the $n$-cycle column, to $\widetilde O(n^{1.75})$ gates near the conjecturally classically hard parameter regime, to provably $\widetilde O(n^{2.5})$ gates in the worst case. In contrast, the QFT subroutine in the prior approach uses $\widetilde O(n^3)$ gates. Our gate count estimates come from leading-order state-dependent Trotter error analysis, and the proven worst-case bound relies on a QSVT-based Hamiltonian simulation method; numerical benchmarks of the Trotter-based protocol suggest that the estimates are conservative. Furthermore, we generalize our protocol to give an explicit algorithm for the quantum character transform (QCT) over $S_n$ using $\widetilde O(n^{2.5})$ gates and $O(n)$ qubits. An application to entanglement entropy of symmetric orbifold conformal field theories is also discussed.
summary:
考虑与对称群 ($S_n$) 的字符表的任何给定列成比例的量子状态向量，对应于由字符值加权的不可表示的叠加。最近有人认为，在合理的复杂性理论假设下，从这种状态进行采样通常是困难的，而存在一种有效的量子算法，可以使用 $S_n$ 上的量子傅里叶变换 (QFT) 来准备这种特征状态 [ arXiv:2501.12579 ]。我们提供了一种替代的、更简单的算法来通过一系列哈密顿演化来准备这个字符状态，以及一种仅使用一维最近邻门的可重构量子位的有效实现。考虑到哈密顿模拟误差的门复杂性取决于列的选择：对于固定的目标状态误差，估计的足够总门数范围从 $n$ 周期列的 $O(n)$ 个门，到推测的经典硬参数体系附近的 $\widetilde O(n^{1.75})$ 个门，到最坏情况下可证明的 $\widetilde O(n^{2.5})$ 个门。相反，先前方法中的 QFT 子例程使用 $\widetilde O(n^3)$ 门。

我们的门数估计来自于前序状态相关的 Trotter 误差分析，并且经过验证的最坏情况边界依赖于基于 QSVT 的哈密顿模拟方法；基于 Trotter 的协议的数值基准表明该估计是保守的。此外，我们将我们的协议推广为使用 $\widetilde O(n^{2.5})$ 门和 $O(n)$ 量子位在 $S_n$ 上进行量子字符变换 (QCT) 的显式算法。还讨论了对称轨道共形场论在纠缠熵中的应用。

title: Quantum Complexity of Solving Linear Equations on Higher-Order Networks
abstract: Higher-order networks (HONs) represent interactions among groups of objects, supporting the study of collective behaviour that pairwise models can miss. In simplicial models of these networks, Hodge Laplacian linear systems provide a common mathematical framework for analysis, for example, for solving statistical ranking problems and investigating long-term stability in coupled oscillator systems. The large number of variables associated with edges, triangles, and higher-dimensional simplices can make these systems costly to solve. Recent quantum algorithms address this bottleneck. However, comparisons with particular classical algorithms do not decision output whether solving these linear system problems establishes a quantum complexity foundation for provable quantum advantage. We prove that preparing a quantum state encoding the normalized minimum-norm solution of Hodge Laplacian linear systems is $\mathsf{BQP}$-hard under the specified sparse oracle model and parameter promises. Our sequence of reductions maps an arbitrary polynomial-time bounded-error quantum computation to such linear systems. Each reduction allows efficient recovery of the normalized minimum-norm solution of the preceding linear system. Together with an efficient quantum algorithm for the associated decision problem from the approximate solution state, we show that this problem is $\mathsf{BQP}$-complete. These results provide a worst-case complexity foundation for evaluating quantum advantage in HON analysis and show that the $\mathsf{BQP}$-hardness of the quantum linear system problem (QLSP) persists even when the matrices are restricted to Hodge Laplacians.
summary:
高阶网络 (HON) 代表对象组之间的交互，支持对成对模型可能遗漏的集体行为的研究。在这些网络的单纯模型中，霍奇拉普拉斯线性系统提供了一个通用的分析数学框架，例如，用于解决统计排序问题和研究耦合振荡器系统的长期稳定性。与边、三角形和高维单纯形相关的大量变量可能会使解决这些系统的成本高昂。最近的量子算法解决了这个瓶颈。然而，与特定经典算法的比较并不能决定输出是否解决这些线性系统问题为可证明的量子优势奠定了量子复杂性基础。我们证明，在指定的稀疏预言模型和参数承诺下，准备编码霍奇拉普拉斯线性系统归一化最小范数解的量子态是 $\mathsf{BQP}$-hard 的。我们的归约序列将任意多项式时间有界误差量子计算映射到此类线性系统。

每次归约都允许有效恢复先前线性系统的归一化最小范数解。结合近似解状态相关决策问题的有效量子算法，我们证明该问题是 $\mathsf{BQP}$ 完整的。这些结果为评估 HON 分析中的量子优势提供了最坏情况的复杂性基础，并表明即使矩阵仅限于霍奇拉普拉斯，量子线性系统问题 (QLSP) 的 $\mathsf{BQP}$ 硬度仍然存在。

title: Spectral Analysis Beyond the Spectral Gap: Rapid Mixing of Quantum Gibbs Samplers in One Dimension
abstract: We prove rapid mixing of a quantum Gibbs sampler for general one-dimensional non-commuting local spin systems at every fixed positive temperature. In particular, for a system of $n$ sites, we show that the Kubo--Martin--Schwinger (KMS) detailed-balanced Gibbs sampler of~\cite{CKG2023} converges from any initial state to trace-norm error $\epsilon$ in time $O(\log^4(n)+\log(1/\epsilon))$. This improves the previous $O(n+\log(1/\epsilon))$ bound and establishes rapid mixing beyond high-temperature and weak-interaction regimes. Our proof explains why the slowest decay rate, captured by the spectral gap, can substantially underestimate the speed of equilibration. The key insight is that a state far from equilibrium must have a substantial component outside the span of low-weight Pauli operators, where stronger dissipation estimates apply. This yields two stages of relaxation: a double-exponential convergence from a bad initial state, followed by exponential convergence near equilibrium. We turn this mechanism into a framework for proving rapid mixing through spectral analysis beyond the gap. Our decay estimate is equivalent to exponential convergence in sandwiched Rényi-2 divergence. Together with the spectral gap, it also implies a modified logarithmic Sobolev inequality with rate $\Omega(\log^{-4}(n))$.
summary:
我们证明了量子吉布斯采样器在每个固定正温度下对于一般一维非交换局部自旋系统的快速混合。特别是，对于 $n$ 个站点的系统，我们表明 ~\cite{CKG2023} 的 Kubo--Martin--Schwinger (KMS) 详细平衡吉布斯采样器在 $O(\log^4(n)+\log(1/\epsilon))$ 时间内从任何初始状态收敛到跟踪范数误差 $\epsilon$。这改善了之前的 $O(n+\log(1/\epsilon))$ 界限，并建立了超越高温和弱相互作用机制的快速混合。我们的证明解释了为什么光谱间隙捕获的最慢衰减率会大大低估平衡速度。关键的见解是，远离平衡的状态必须有一个在低权重泡利算子范围之外的重要组成部分，其中适用更强的耗散估计。这会产生两个松弛阶段：从不良初始状态开始的双指数收敛，然后是接近平衡的指数收敛。我们将此机制转变为一个框架，用于通过间隙之外的光谱分析来证明快速混合。我们的衰减估计相当于夹层 Rényi-2 散度的指数收敛。

与谱间隙一起，它还意味着修改后的对数 Sobolev 不等式，其速率为 $\Omega(\log^{-4}(n))$。

title: Robust Diamond Quantum Sensing in Double-Quantum 4-Ramsey Interferometry by Dual-Feedback Scheme
abstract: We developed a highly sensitive and long-term stable diamond quantum magnetometer by integrating a dual-feedback system that compensates for common- and differential-mode frequency shifts in double-quantum (DQ) 4-Ramsey interferometry. Detecting extremely weak magnetic-field signals requires extensive signal accumulation to enhance the signal-to-noise ratio. However, deviations from the optimal operating frequencies caused by thermal drift or environmental magnetic noise severely hinder the long-term stability of such a sensing system. To overcome the limitation, we first derived analytical solutions for the signal response to common- and differential-mode detunings based on a detuning-inclusive Hamiltonian to theoretically clarify the robustness limit in DQ 4-Ramsey sensing. Guided by this theoretical model, we introduced synchronized frequency modulation and a dual-feedback scheme to independently track and compensate for these frequency shifts while maintaining an optimal magnetic-field response. The proposed method enabled stable continuous operation against temperature variations of 2.8 K. By maintaining a magnetic field sensitivity of 7.0 pT/Hz^1/2 in the frequency range of 5-100 Hz for a prolonged duration of 4 hours, we achieved an extremely low noise floor of 64 fT/Hz^1/2. During prolonged continuous sensing, the system exhibited the expected 1/T^1/2 scaling with integration time T, and prevented both the underestimation of amplitude and waveform distortion. These results establish a robust approach for long-term DQ 4-Ramsey diamond magnetometry and demonstrate its potential for detecting weak biomagnetic signals.
summary:
我们通过集成双反馈系统开发了一种高灵敏度且长期稳定的金刚石量子磁力计，该系统可补偿双量子 (DQ) 4-Ramsey 干涉测量中的共模和差模频移。检测极弱的磁场信号需要大量的信号积累以提高信噪比。然而，热漂移或环境磁噪声引起的最佳工作频率的偏差严重阻碍了此类传感系统的长期稳定性。为了克服这一限制，我们首先基于包含失谐的哈密顿量导出了对共模和差模失谐的信号响应的解析解，以从理论上阐明 DQ 4-Ramsey 传感中的鲁棒性极限。在此理论模型的指导下，我们引入了同步频率调制和双反馈方案，以独立跟踪和补偿这些频移，同时保持最佳磁场响应。所提出的方法能够在 2.8 K 的温度变化下稳定连续运行。

通过在 5-100 Hz 频率范围内长时间保持 7.0 pT/Hz^1/2 的磁场灵敏度 4 小时，我们实现了 64 fT/Hz^1/2 的极低本底噪声。在长时间连续感测期间，系统表现出预期的 1/T^1/2 与积分时间 T 的缩放比例，并防止了幅度和波形失真的低估。这些结果为长期 DQ 4-Ramsey 金刚石磁力测量建立了一种可靠的方法，并证明了其检测微弱生物磁信号的潜力。

title: Fast mixing of the SYK model at high temperatures
abstract: The Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model is a strongly interacting fermionic system. Its dynamics are difficult to analyze with Lieb-Robinson bounds and cluster expansions due to its all-to-all disordered interactions. We prove that, with high probability over the disorder, the SYK model admits a quantum Gibbs sampler with a system-size-independent spectral gap at sufficiently high constant temperatures. This yields polynomial-time preparation of SYK Gibbs states on a quantum computer. While prior non-rigorous computations that suggested SYK thermalization were limited to studying local correlators, we emphasize that our result holds up to arbitrary inverse polynomial trace distance. Our proof introduces the pseudo-Lindbladian approach to fermions and uses an especially simple SYK analysis based on a comparison to classical dynamics.
summary: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型是一个强相互作用的费米子系统。由于其全部无序的相互作用，其动力学很难用李布-罗宾逊界限和簇扩展进行分析。我们证明，在无序的情况下，SYK 模型允许量子吉布斯采样器在足够高的恒定温度下具有与系统尺寸无关的光谱间隙。这在量子计算机上产生了 SYK 吉布斯态的多项式时间准备。虽然先前表明 SYK 热化的非严格计算仅限于研究局部相关器，但我们强调我们的结果适用于任意逆多项式迹线距离。我们的证明引入了费米子的伪 Lindbladian 方法，并使用基于与经典动力学比较的特别简单的 SYK 分析。

title: Joint GKP Encoding for GHZ States Transmission over Bosonic Quantum MIMO Channels
abstract: We study transmission of a Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) state over nonunitary quantum multiple-input multiple-output (QuMIMO) channels using finite-energy Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) encoding. A coupled-mode model describes coherent mixing, mode-dependent attenuation, and Gaussian noise. The transceiver combines programmable passive meshes, quantum-limited MMSE gain, local GKP recovery, and joint classical syndrome decoding. We optimize complex-Givens lattices using instantaneous channel-state information (CSI), current singular values with channel statistics, or statistics alone. Simulations show that joint lattice shaping outperforms product GKP processing. Under coherent-basis drift, full instantaneous CSI improves GHZ-state preservation, whereas singular-value conditioned and fully statistical designs perform similarly because neither resolves the current singular frames. These findings identify singular-frame geometry as a critical resource beyond attenuation knowledge where joint GKP processing adapts the logical lattice and receiver to anisotropic bosonic noise rather than merely inverting multimode mixing.
summary: 我们使用有限能量 Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) 编码研究 Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) 状态在非酉量子多输入多输出 (QuMIMO) 通道上的传输。耦合模式模型描述相干混合、模式相关衰减和高斯噪声。该收发器结合了可编程无源网格、量子限制 MMSE 增益、本地 GKP 恢复和联合经典综合症解码。我们使用瞬时通道状态信息（CSI）、带有通道统计的当前奇异值或单独的统计来优化复吉文斯格。模拟表明，联合晶格成形优于产品 GKP 处理。在相干基础漂移下，完全瞬时 CSI 改善了 GHZ 状态保留，而奇异值条件设计和完全统计设计的性能类似，因为两者都无法解析当前的奇异帧。这些发现将奇异帧几何确定为超越衰减知识的关键资源，其中联合 GKP 处理使逻辑晶格和接收器适应各向异性玻色噪声，而不仅仅是反转多模混合。

title: Free fermion models with an operator entanglement growing as $O(\sqrt{t})$
abstract: We study the time evolution of the Operator Space Entanglement Entropy (OSEE) of one-dimensional number-conserving free fermions subject to a random space- and time-dependent evolution. It is known that, in free-fermion systems without randomness, the OSEE of \emph{local} operators grows at most \emph{logarithmically} in time. Here we show that, in the presence of randomness, the OSEE of local spin operators involving a Jordan-Wigner string grows as $\mathcal O(\sqrt t)$, for all values of the Rényi index. We establish this in two models: a Brownian Hamiltonian and a brick-wall matchgate circuit. We also consider the OSEE of the evolution operator, and we show that it also grows as $\mathcal O(\sqrt{t})$, in contrast with the linear growth generically expected without randomness. We analytically compute the average entropies of the two operators by mapping the quantum models to the symmetric simple exclusion process, relying on an assumption of self-averaging which we support numerically. We also consider two other types of randomness: random evolution in time that keeps spatial translation invariance, and quenched disorder. In the former case, we find that the OSEE also grows as $\sqrt{t}$. In the latter case, we find that the entropy grows as $\mathcal O( \log \log t)$ for Hamiltonian evolution both for local operators with a Jordan-Wigner string and for the evolution operator, whereas it remains bounded at all times in the brick-wall matchgate circuit.
summary:
我们研究一维数守恒自由费米子的算子空间纠缠熵 (OSEE) 的时间演化，该演化受空间和时间相关随机演化的影响。众所周知，在没有随机性的自由费米子系统中，\emph{local}算子的OSEE随时间最多以\emph{对数}增长。在这里，我们表明，在存在随机性的情况下，对于 Rényi 索引的所有值，涉及 Jordan-Wigner 字符串的局部自旋算子的 OSEE 增长为 $\mathcal O(\sqrt t)$。我们通过两个模型建立这一点：布朗哈密顿量和砖墙匹配门电路。我们还考虑了演化算子的​​ OSEE，并且我们证明它也以 $\mathcal O(\sqrt{t})$ 的形式增长，这与通常预期的没有随机性的线性增长形成鲜明对比。我们依靠我们在数值上支持的自平均假设，通过将量子模型映射到对称简单排除过程来分析计算两个算子的平均熵。我们还考虑其他两种类型的随机性：保持空间平移不变性的时间随机演化和消除无序性。

在前一种情况下，我们发现 OSEE 也以 $\sqrt{t}$ 的形式增长。在后一种情况下，我们发现对于具有 Jordan-Wigner 字符串的局部算子和演化算子，哈密顿演化的熵随着 $\mathcal O( \log \log t)$ 增长，而在砖墙匹配门电路中它始终保持有界。

title: Materialised symmetries of 2D translationally invariant codes
abstract: There has been significant recent interest in near-term qLDPC codes as high-performance alternatives to surface and color codes. One such class of codes is 2-dimensional translationally invariant (TI) codes, such as bivariate bicycle codes, which share similar properties to topological codes. Fundamental objects in the study of such codes are the materialised symmetries, which can be used for the construction of matching-based decoders. These decoders generalise the minimum-weight perfect matching decoder for toric codes and provide similar asymptotic performance guarantees that heuristic decoders such as BP and its variants lack. Despite this, the mathematical structure of symmetries along with their properties under translation and restriction to finite-sized lattices has not been well-studied. We describe a decomposition of symmetry spaces of 2D CSS TI codes on infinite lattices into translation-invariant subspaces which allow us to write an explicit basis of symmetries in a plane-wave-like form. We then describe how to adapt this infinite lattice basis so that any corresponding rectangular periodic lattice basis can be obtained by restriction to basis elements compatible with the periodic boundaries. This allows us to describe how the symmetry space varies with different rectangular dimensions. We illustrate via examples that it is often straightforward in practice to determine a basis of symmetries on twisted boundaries as well, without needing to recompute the decomposition. We comment on the applications of this framework to matching-based decoders and provide examples of symmetries of such codes as the gross code.
summary:
最近人们对近期 qLDPC 码作为表面码和颜色码的高性能替代品产生了浓厚的兴趣。 One such class of codes is 2-dimensional translationally invariant (TI) codes, such as bivariate bicycle codes, which share similar properties to topological codes. Fundamental objects in the study of such codes are the materialised symmetries, which can be used for the construction of matching-based decoders. These decoders generalise the minimum-weight perfect matching decoder for toric codes and provide similar asymptotic performance guarantees that heuristic decoders such as BP and its variants lack. Despite this, the mathematical structure of symmetries along with their properties under translation and restriction to finite-sized lattices has not been well-studied. We describe a decomposition of symmetry spaces of 2D CSS TI codes on infinite lattices into translation-invariant subspaces which allow us to write an explicit basis of symmetries in a plane-wave-like form.

We then describe how to adapt this infinite lattice basis so that any corresponding rectangular periodic lattice basis can be obtained by restriction to basis elements compatible with the periodic boundaries.这使我们能够描述对称空间如何随不同矩形尺寸而变化。 We illustrate via examples that it is often straightforward in practice to determine a basis of symmetries on twisted boundaries as well, without needing to recompute the decomposition.我们评论了该框架在基于匹配的解码器中的应用，并提供了此类代码（如总代码）的对称性示例。

title: Comparing thresholds of XZZX and rotated surface codes under spatio-temporal correlated noise
abstract: While independent and identically distributed noise is typically assumed in quantum computing research, complex error models such as correlated and spatio-temporal errors remain underexplored. In this paper, the performance of $\mathrm{XZZX}$ and rotated surface codes is evaluated under these complex noise models. Standard graph-based decoders struggle with the hyperedges generated by correlated errors on bias-tailored codes. To address this, we employ the Minimum Weight Parity Factor (MWPF) decoder, which natively processes syndrome hypergraphs without artificial edge decomposition. Our simulations show that under strong Z-biased circuit-level correlated noise ($\eta=100$), the threshold of the rotated code degrades to $\approx 0.36\%$, while the $\mathrm{XZZX}$ code drops to $\approx 0.70\%$. Furthermore, a distinct non-monotonic threshold dependence is observed for the $\mathrm{XZZX}$ code across different bias ratios. While the $\mathrm{XZZX}$ code effectively absorbs high-density Z-type hyperedges at extreme biases, it exhibits a threshold minimum at moderate biases ($\eta \approx 10$) because transverse X and Y errors actively bridge the diagonal strings, breaking the code's one-dimensional decoupling symmetry. These findings demonstrate that utilizing hypergraph-aware decoders is critical, as the performance of bias-tailored codes is highly sensitive to the geometric structure of spatio-temporal correlated noise.
summary:
虽然在量子计算研究中通常假设独立且同分布的噪声，但复杂的误差模型（例如相关误差和时空误差）仍未得到充分探索。在本文中，在这些复杂噪声模型下评估了 $\mathrm{XZZX}$ 和旋转表面代码的性能。标准的基于图的解码器与偏差定制代码上的相关错误生成的超边缘作斗争。为了解决这个问题，我们采用了最小权重奇偶因子（MWPF）解码器，它可以本地处理综合症超图，而无需人工边缘分解。我们的模拟表明，在强 Z 偏置电路级相关噪声 ($\eta=100$) 下，旋转代码的阈值下降到 $\approx 0.36\%$，而 $\mathrm{XZZX}$ 代码下降到 $\approx 0.70\%$。此外，在不同偏差比下，$\mathrm{XZZX}$ 代码观察到明显的非单调阈值依赖性。

虽然 $\mathrm{XZZX}$ 代码在极端偏差下有效吸收高密度 Z 型超边，但它在中等偏差（$\eta \约 10$）下表现出阈值最小值，因为横向 X 和 Y 误差主动桥接对角线串，打破了代码的一维解耦对称性。这些发现表明，利用超图感知解码器至关重要，因为偏差定制代码的性能对时空相关噪声的几何结构高度敏感。

title: Quantum data loading from the learned shared structure of real signals
abstract: Preparing quantum states from classical data can cost more than the computation they serve; most loaders tailor a circuit to each input. Here we show that the signals of a real dataset share structure that can be learned once and reused. Our quantum-native loader learns a low-dimensional description of a dataset and prepares every signal with one fixed circuit set by a few numbers. Across seven views of five public datasets it meets the targets of the strongest structured loader at equal gate cost with several times fewer numbers per signal. These numbers can be inferred from a random subset: in a preregistered blind replication the subset needed to come within ten per cent of full-signal accuracy stayed constant within a prespecified margin as signals grew sixteenfold, whereas the structured loader needed ever more. It declines what it cannot represent, covering fewer cases than that baseline and no electrocardiogram.
summary: 从经典数据中准备量子态的成本可能超过它们所提供的计算成本；大多数加载器都会为每个输入定制一个电路。在这里，我们展示了真实数据集的信号共享可以学习一次并重复使用的结构。我们的量子原生加载器学习数据集的低维描述，并使用由几个数字组成的一个固定电路来准备每个信号。在五个公共数据集的七个视图中，它以相同的门成本满足了最强的结构化加载器的目标，每个信号的数量少了几倍。这些数字可以从随机子集推断出来：在预先注册的盲复制中，当信号增长十六倍时，子集需要达到全信号精度的百分之十以内，并在预先指定的裕度内保持恒定，而结构化加载程序则需要更多。它拒绝了它不能代表的内容，覆盖的病例比基线少，并且没有心电图。

title: Gaussian Universality and Its Breakdown in Tensor-Network Machine Learning
abstract: Gaussian-process limits are powerful in describing overparameterized machine learning models, yet their validity in structured tensor-network architectures remains unclear. Here we analytically present a moment-based approach that identifies precise conditions for the emergence and breakdown of Gaussian universality in tensor-network learning models, with a focus on matrix product states. We prove that in the large bond dimension limit, the learning models with both local and global observables converge to Gaussian processes, with explicit finite-size bounds on higher-order moment deviations. Whereas in the large physical dimension limit, the Gaussian universality no longer persists: while the models with local observables retain Gaussian-process behavior, those global cases exhibit persistent non-Gaussian corrections. Our results reveal that Gaussian-process behavior in tensor-network learning is controlled not only by parameter number, but also by architectural scaling, observable locality, and the spectral properties.
summary: 高斯过程限制在描述过度参数化机器学习模型方面非常强大，但它们在结构化张量网络架构中的有效性仍不清楚。在这里，我们分析性地提出了一种基于矩的方法，该方法可以识别张量网络学习模型中高斯普适性出现和崩溃的精确条件，重点关注矩阵乘积状态。我们证明，在大键维数限制下，具有局部和全局可观测量的学习模型收敛于高斯过程，并且在高阶矩偏差上具有明确的有限大小界限。然而在大的物理维度限制中，高斯普适性不再持续：虽然具有局部可观测量的模型保留高斯过程行为，但那些全局情况表现出持续的非高斯校正。我们的结果表明，张量网络学习中的高斯过程行为不仅受参数数量控制，还受架构缩放、可观察局部性和谱特性的控制。

title: Collective Quantum State Preparation Is Nonadditive
abstract: Quantum state preparation is a basic primitive of quantum computation and control, but its resource cost is usually analyzed for one target state or under an independent-copy construction. Here we study the many-copy problem under weighted Pauli control, where a Pauli-product rotation $e^{i\phi P}$ is charged by its rotation angle $|\phi|$, independently of the weight of $P$. We derive the exact single-qubit preparation cost and show that it is strictly nonadditive: a four-pulse collective protocol prepares two $T$ states at lower cost than two optimal one-copy protocols. We further identify finite regions of the Bloch sphere with collective saving, including trajectories that remain product throughout, showing that transient entanglement is not the only mechanism behind the advantage. Complementarily, a dimension-independent Rényi-entropy speed limit gives an extensive lower bound for every coherent target and an exponential fidelity penalty below a finite preparation rate. These results establish a many-copy geometry of state synthesis in which uncorrelated outputs can nevertheless benefit from collective control.
summary: 量子状态准备是量子计算和控制的基本原语，但其资源成本通常针对一个目标状态或在独立副本构造下进行分析。在这里，我们研究加权泡利控制下的多副本问题，其中泡利积旋转 $e^{i\phi P}$ 由其旋转角度 $|\phi|$ 负责，与 $P$ 的权重无关。我们得出了精确的单量子位准备成本，并证明它是严格非相加的：四脉冲集体协议以比两个最佳单拷贝协议更低的成本准备两个 $T$ 状态。我们进一步确定了具有集体储蓄的布洛赫球体的有限区域，包括始终保持乘积的轨迹，这表明瞬态纠缠并不是优势背后的唯一机制。作为补充，与维度无关的 Rényi 熵速度限制为每个相干目标提供了广泛的下限，并提供了低于有限准备率的指数保真度惩罚。这些结果建立了状态综合的多副本几何结构，其中不相关的输出仍然可以从集体控制中受益。

title: Improved Adaptive Estimation of Quantum Partition Functions with Heisenberg Scaling
abstract: We give quantum algorithms that estimate the log partition function of an $n$-qubit quantum Hamiltonian to additive error $\epsilon$ with Heisenberg scaling, while minimizing calls to thermal-state purification preparation. The input is a block encoding of $H$, unitaries preparing thermofield-double states at chosen inverse temperatures, with their inverses and controlled versions, and an adaptive slowly-varying cooling schedule. The system-size bounds below assume $0\preceq H\preceq hI$ with $h=O(n)$ and block-encoding normalization $\alpha=\Theta(h)$. For constant inverse temperature, we show that such a schedule of length $O(\sqrt n)$ always exists and can be generated from overlap estimates with $\widetilde O(\sqrt n)$ further preparations. Given such a schedule and classically chosen temperatures, we estimate the log partition function with $\widetilde O(n^{5/4}/\epsilon)$ expected calls to state preparation and to the block encoding, improving by $n^{1/4}$ on non-adaptive strategies. To achieve our result, we use a recursive-doubling identity that expresses each schedule increment as a weighted sum of logarithms of thermofield-double overlaps and of short imaginary-time steps implemented by quantum singular value transformation combined with previously developed variance reduction techniques. If thermofield doubles can be prepared controlled on a temperature register, a quantum inverse-binomial log estimator combined with quantum mean estimation reduces both query counts to $\widetilde O(n/\epsilon)$. We show that the latter scaling is optimal in block-encoding queries up to polylogarithmic factors and discuss end-to-end complexities for one-dimensional partition-function estimation.
summary:
我们给出的量子算法可以通过海森堡缩放来估计 $n$ 量子位量子哈密顿量的对数配分函数到加性误差 $\epsilon$，同时最大限度地减少对热态纯化准备的调用。输入是 $H$ 的块编码，在选定的逆温度下准备热场双态的酉，及其逆和受控版本，以及自适应缓慢变化的冷却时间表。下面的系统大小边界假设 $0\preceq H\preceq hI$ 和 $h=O(n)$ 以及块编码归一化 $\alpha=\Theta(h)$。对于恒定的逆温度，我们表明这样一个长度为 $O(\sqrt n)$ 的计划始终存在，并且可以通过重叠估计生成 $\widetilde O(\sqrt n)$ 进一步的准备。给定这样的时间表和经典选择的温度，我们用 $\widetilde O(n^{5/4}/\epsilon)$ 预期调用状态准备和块编码来估计对数分区函数，在非自适应策略上提高了 $n^{1/4}$。

为了实现我们的结果，我们使用递归加倍恒等式，将每个计划增量表示为热场双重叠和短虚时间步长的对数的加权和，这些对数是通过量子奇异值变换与先前开发的方差减少技术相结合实现的。如果可以在温度寄存器上控制热场双值，则量子逆二项式对数估计器与量子均值估计相结合可将两个查询计数减少到 $\widetilde O(n/\epsilon)$。我们表明，后一种缩放在高达多对数因子的块编码查询中是最佳的，并讨论了一维分区函数估计的端到端复杂性。

title: Casimir force screening by a quantum Boltzmann plasma
abstract: We develop a finite-temperature field-theoretical description of the Casimir interaction between two perfectly conducting boundaries with the intervening gap filled by a two-component quantum Boltzmann plasma embedded in a homogeneous dielectric background. The quantum motion of the charged particles is represented by imaginary-time worldlines, while the electromagnetic field is treated in the Gaussian approximation. The resulting partition function contains distinct longitudinal and transverse response contributions and an additional quantum-induced source term with no classical counterpart. In the classical limit the theory reduces to the usual Casimir-screening picture: the static longitudinal mode is Debye screened, whereas the transverse electromagnetic sector is unaffected by classical mobile charges. Finite thermal de Broglie wavelengths modify the nonzero Matsubara response and produce the leading quantum correction to the force. In the static long-wavelength limit, the longitudinal dielectric function has, through the leading quantum correction, the same expansion structure as the Lindhard response of a degenerate electron gas under the correspondence $k_{TF}\leftrightarrow\kappa_D$ and $k_F\leftrightarrow\lambda_{dB}^{-1}$, while the static transverse response reproduces the leading high-temperature Landau orbital diamagnetic susceptibility.
summary:
我们对两个完美导电边界之间的卡西米尔相互作用进行了有限温度场理论描述，其间的间隙由嵌入均匀介电背景中的双组分量子玻尔兹曼等离子体填充。带电粒子的量子运动用虚时间世界线表示，而电磁场则用高斯近似来处理。所得配分函数包含不同的纵向和横向响应贡献以及一个没有经典对应项的附加量子诱导源项。在经典极限下，该理论简化为通常的卡西米尔屏蔽图：静态纵向模式是德拜屏蔽的，而横向电磁扇区不受经典移动电荷的影响。有限热德布罗意波长修改非零松原响应并对力产生领先的量子校正。

在静态长波长极限下，纵向介电函数通过领先的量子校正，在对应关系$k_{TF}\leftrightarrow\kappa_D$和$k_F\leftrightarrow\lambda_{dB}^{-1}$下具有与简并电子气的Lindhard响应相同的展开结构，而静态横向响应再现了领先的高温Landau轨道抗磁化率。

title: Suppressing Frequency Collisions in a Quantum Processor
abstract: Frequency crowding, the close spacing of qubit transitions, limits superconducting quantum processors through crosstalk, leakage, and spectator dependent errors. We introduce a Hamiltonian based framework that maps two- and three-body collision mechanisms onto a Max-k-Cut problem on qubit frequency allocation. In order to make larger lattices tractable, we introduce a cluster-stitching protocol that decomposes larger lattices into overlapping subgraphs and reconciles their local frequency assignments into globally consistent configurations. We tested our proposed framework across multiple qubit architectures to suppress dominant collision penalties by revealing a hardware residual crosstalk. We benchmark digitized counterdiabatic QAOA (DC-QAOA), standard QAOA, and simulated annealing. Counterdiabatic terms improve QAOA optimization near steep collision penalties, while simulated annealing achieves the lowest costs on the tested instances. These results indicate that our hardware-aware optimization connects microscopic interaction physics to processor-level frequency planning. These results enable a systematic solver for benchmarking of scalable software hardware co design.
summary: 频率拥挤，即量子位跃迁的紧密间隔，通过串扰、泄漏和观众相关错误来限制超导量子处理器。我们引入了一个基于哈密顿量的框架，该框架将二体和三体碰撞机制映射到量子位频率分配的 Max-k-Cut 问题上。为了使更大的晶格易于处理，我们引入了一种簇缝合协议，该协议将更大的晶格分解为重叠的子图，并将其局部频率分配协调为全局一致的配置。我们在多个量子位架构上测试了我们提出的框架，通过揭示硬件残余串扰来抑制主要的碰撞惩罚。我们对数字化反绝热 QAOA (DC-QAOA)、标准 QAOA 和模拟退火进行基准测试。 Counterdiabatic 项改进了接近陡峭碰撞惩罚的 QAOA 优化，而模拟退火在测试实例上实现了最低成本。这些结果表明我们的硬件感知优化将微观交互物理与处理器级频率规划联系起来。这些结果使得系统求解器能够用于可扩展软件硬件协同设计的基准测试。

title: Adiabatic tracking and optimal schedules for classical and quantum Gibbs-state preparation
abstract: We develop a discrete adiabatic framework for Gibbs-state preparation in classical and quantum optimisation algorithms. For finite time-inhomogeneous reversible Markov chains, we derive a tracking theorem that bounds the distance from the evolving distribution to the instantaneous stationary state by combining two effects: contraction of previously accumulated error by the Markov dynamics and the new error generated as the stationary distribution changes from one step to the next. For Gibbs paths, this leads to explicit step-complexity bounds and to gap- and fluctuation-adapted schedules controlled by the Markov-chain spectral gap and the energy-fluctuation scale $V(\beta)=\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}_{\pi_\beta}(E)}$. In the weak-damping regime, the resulting schedule takes the form $\dot{\beta}\propto\delta(\beta)/V(\beta)$. We then apply the discrete quantum adiabatic theorem to temperature-dependent Szegedy quantum walks. The quantum-walk eigenphase gap satisfies $\Delta_w=\Theta(\sqrt{\delta})$, where $\delta$ is the spectral gap of the underlying Markov chain. By analysing the finite-difference terms entering the theorem, we show that this square-root spectral amplification translates into a quadratic improvement in the gap dependence only for suitably gap-adapted schedules. Under the corresponding regularity conditions, the quantum adiabatic cost scales as $O(\delta_{\min}^{-1/2})$, compared with the classical $O(\delta_{\min}^{-1})$ relaxation scale.
summary:
我们开发了一个离散绝热框架，用于经典和量子优化算法中的吉布斯态准备。对于有限时间非齐次可逆马尔可夫链，我们推导出一个跟踪定理，该定理通过结合两种效应来限制从演化分布到瞬时稳态的距离：马尔可夫动力学先前累积的误差的收缩以及稳态分布从一步到下一步变化时生成的新误差。对于吉布斯路径，这会导致显式的步骤复杂度界限以及由马尔可夫链谱间隙和能量波动尺度 $V(\beta)=\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}_{\pi_\beta}(E)}$ 控制的间隙和波动适应计划。在弱阻尼状态下，生成的时间表采用 $\dot{\beta}\propto\delta(\beta)/V(\beta)$ 的形式。然后，我们将离散量子绝热定理应用于温度相关的 Szegedy 量子行走。量子行走本征相间隙满足 $\Delta_w=\Theta(\sqrt{\delta})$，其中 $\delta$ 是基础马尔可夫链的谱间隙。

通过分析进入定理的有限差分项，我们表明，仅对于适当的间隙适应计划，这种平方根谱放大才会转化为间隙依赖性的二次改进。在相应的规律性条件下，与经典的$O(\delta_{\min}^{-1})$松弛尺度相比，量子绝热成本尺度为$O(\delta_{\min}^{-1/2})$。

title: Two-Sided Bounds on Ground State Properties in Lattice Gauge Theories
abstract: Gauge theories describe fundamental interactions in the standard model of particle physics and build effective theories in condensed matter physics. Being notoriously hard to simulate, these theories are commonly regularized as lattice gauge theories which can be evaluated with high precision through Monte Carlo algorithms or variational methods. However, Monte Carlo algorithms are not applicable in all regimes due to the sign problem; while variational methods, quantum and classical alike, only give upper-bounds on the ground-state energy. Their precision crucially depends on the chosen ansatz. Here, we present a framework based on a hierarchy of semidefinite programs to yield increasingly good lower-bounds on the ground-state energy and propagate these bounds to extended observables like Wilson loops and mesonic strings. We demonstrate the numerical capabilities by applying the algorithm to a (1+1)-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ theory with dynamic fermionic matter and its pure-gauge version in (2+1)-dimensions. In both cases, we obtain certified intervals for the ground-state energy. For a one-dimensional system with 129 sites, the certified interval has a relative spread of $0.04\%$. For a two-dimensional system with 97 sites (corresponding to a $7 \times 8$ lattice), the relative spread is $2.08\%$. Beyond energy estimates, the proposed method provides rigorous bounds on both short- and long-range observables such as Wilson loops over multiple plaquettes and the magnitude of the mesonic string. The method can be both used as a computational microscope into many-body physics and a way to certify results of quantum simulators.
summary:
规范理论描述了粒子物理标准模型中的基本相互作用，并在凝聚态物理中建立了有效的理论。由于难以模拟，这些理论通常被正规化为晶格规范理论，可以通过蒙特卡罗算法或变分方法进行高精度评估。然而，由于符号问题，蒙特卡罗算法并不适用于所有情况；而变分方法，无论是量子方法还是经典方法，都只给出基态能量的上限。他们的精确度很大程度上取决于所选择的安萨兹。在这里，我们提出了一个基于半定程序层次结构的框架，以产生越来越好的基态能量下界，并将这些界限传播到威尔逊环和介子弦等扩展可观测量。我们通过将该算法应用于具有动态费米子物质的 (1+1) 维 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 理论及其在 (2+1) 维中的纯规范版本来演示数值功能。在这两种情况下，我们都获得了基态能量的认证区间。

对于具有 129 个站点的一维系统，认证间隔的相对价差为 $0.04\%$。对于具有 97 个位点的二维系统（对应于 $7 \times 8$ 晶格），相对价差为 $2.08\%$。除了能量估计之外，所提出的方法还提供了短程和长程可观测值的严格界限，例如多个斑块上的威尔逊环和介音弦的幅度。该方法既可以用作多体物理学的计算显微镜，也可以用作验证量子模拟器结果的方法。

title: Robust subspace designs and the power of a unique small quantum witness
abstract: The concept of subspace designs was introduced by Guruswami and Xing (STOC'13), and explicit constructions were given by Guruswami and Kopparty (FOCS'13). These are families of subspaces that have small intersection with any given subspace of a fixed dimension. We introduce \emph{robust subspace designs}. Informally, these are a quantitative extension in which we demand that not too many subspaces of the family contain directions that lie close to any given subspace of a fixed dimension. We give a probabilistic construction of such a robust subspace design of polynomial size, as well as a non-trivial explicit construction of superpolynomial size. Our main application of this new concept is a quantum space-bounded variant of the Valiant-Vazirani theorem ( this http URL .'86), which shows that restricting $\mathsf{NP}$-complete problems to instances with at most one accepting witness preserves hardness under randomized reductions. For quantum witnesses, the analogous quantity is the dimension of an accepting witness subspace. We use our probabilistic construction of robust subspace designs to isolate a unique witness for space-bounded quantum Merlin-Arthur protocols with perfect completeness and an acceptance gap outside their perfectly accepting subspace. As further applications, we give a randomized reduction of well-conditioned nullity testing to space-bounded quantum Merlin-Arthur protocols with perfect completeness. Using a similar idea, we find that ordinary subspace designs allow us to recover the classical $\mathsf{C_= L}$ containment of Allender, Beals, and Ogihara (STOC'96) for general nullity testing through a simpler proof.
summary:
