子空间设计的概念由 Guruswami 和 Xing (STOC'13) 引入，并由 Guruswami 和 Kopparty (FOCS'13) 给出了明确的构造。这些子空间族与任何给定的固定维度子空间有较小的交集。我们引入\emph{鲁棒子空间设计}。非正式地说，这些是一种定量扩展，其中我们要求族的子空间中不要包含太多与固定维度的任何给定子空间接近的方向。我们给出了这种多项式大小的稳健子空间设计的概率构造，以及超多项式大小的非平凡显式构造。我们对这一新概念的主要应用是 Valiant-Vazirani 定理的量子空间有界变体（此 http URL .'86），它表明将 $\mathsf{NP}$ 完全问题限制在最多有一个接受证人的实例上可以在随机约简下保持硬度。对于量子见证人来说，类似量是接受见证人子空间的维度。

我们使用鲁棒子空间设计的概率构造来隔离空间有限的量子 Merlin-Arthur 协议的独特见证，该协议具有完美的完整性和完美接受子空间之外的接受间隙。作为进一步的应用，我们将条件良好的无效性测试随机减少到空间有限的量子 Merlin-Arthur 协议，并且具有完美的完整性。使用类似的想法，我们发现普通的子空间设计允许我们通过更简单的证明来恢复 Allender、Beals 和 Ogihara (STOC'96) 的经典 $\mathsf{C_= L}$ 包含，以进行一般无效测试。

title: Adaptive complete quantum search with unknown number of solutions
abstract: Unstructured database search is a fundamental problem that requires finding one or more elements satisfying a specific property within a set of candidates. While Grover's algorithm provides a quadratic speedup for finding a marked element when the number of solutions is known, finding all solutions when their number is unknown presents additional challenges. In this paper, we thoroughly analyze this problem by considering all the different regimes of combinations of classical, Grover and generalized fixed-point quantum search instances. We unify these into an adaptive Bayesian approach that maximizes the expected success probability per unit execution time at each searching instance. For a problem with a known number of solutions, much lower than the database size, we prove that our proposed approach is asymptotically optimal within the considered search model. Furthermore, we prove that for any probability distribution characterizing the likely number of solutions, in regimes where the classical verification time is at most 25% of the quantum amplitude amplification time, hybrid classical and Grover approaches are preferred to generalized fixed-point. Outside of this regime, we derive an upper bound on the maximal improvement achievable by fixed-point search compared to the best Grover-based score. Additionally, we determine the optimal transition point between classical sampling and quantum searching using an integral approximation of the probability distribution of the number of solutions. The analytical results are also supported by numerical simulations of the proposed algorithm and by comparisons between the generalized fixed-point and Grover-based search policies.
summary:
非结构化数据库搜索是一个基本问题，需要在一组候选者中找到满足特定属性的一个或多个元素。虽然 Grover 的算法在解数已知时为查找标记元素提供了二次加速，但在解数未知时查找所有解却带来了额外的挑战。在本文中，我们通过考虑经典、格罗弗和广义定点量子搜索实例的所有不同组合方式来彻底分析这个问题。我们将这些统一为自适应贝叶斯方法，该方法最大化每个搜索实例每单位执行时间的预期成功概率。对于具有已知数量的解决方案（远小于数据库大小）的问题，我们证明我们提出的方法在所考虑的搜索模型内是渐近最优的。此外，我们证明，对于表征可能的解数量的任何概率分布，在经典验证时间最多为量子幅度放大时间的 25% 的情况下，混合经典和 Grover 方法优于广义定点方法。

在这个制度之外，我们得出了与基于 Grover 的最佳分数相比，定点搜索可实现的最大改进的上限。此外，我们使用解数量概率分布的积分近似来确定经典采样和量子搜索之间的最佳过渡点。所提出算法的数值模拟以及广义定点和基于 Grover 的搜索策略之间的比较也支持了分析结果。

title: Lindblad equation for the quantum Rabi model in the deep strong coupling regime
abstract: We derive a quantum master equation in Lindblad form for the open quantum Rabi model in the perturbative deep strong coupling regime, where the spectrum is close to degenerate and harmonic. The Lindblad form is obtained by combining secular and singular-coupling approximations, working in a Schrieffer-Wolff transformed frame. We benchmark our equation against a Bloch-Redfield one, analyzing the time-evolution and steady state properties of several observables and find excellent agreement. Analytical results are obtained in limiting cases.
summary: 我们推导了微扰深强耦合状态下开放量子拉比模型的 Lindblad 形式的量子主方程，其中光谱接近简并和谐波。 Lindblad 形式是通过在 Schrieffer-Wolff 变换框架中结合长期近似和奇异耦合近似而获得的。我们将我们的方程与 Bloch-Redfield 方程进行基准比较，分析几个可观测值的时间演化和稳态特性，并发现了极好的一致性。分析结果是在有限情况下获得的。

title: Causal memory and structural complexity of a quantum space series
abstract: What makes one quantum process more complex than another? We adopt an operational approach inspired by classical complexity science, which characterises structure through the memory required for causal generation. We develop a fully-quantum extension of computational mechanics for quantum space series: Sequences of quantum outputs that do not return to interact with their generator. For stationary, memoryful quantum space series admitting finite-dimensional, primitive causal models, we show that a memory-minimal model can be chosen to generate the outputs isometrically, without a discarded environment. The resulting canonical matrix product state representation determines both the minimum memory dimension and the minimum memory entropy. The latter is precisely the entanglement entropy across the past-future bipartition, giving entanglement an operational interpretation as irreducible memory for causal generation. Within this class, we further establish a vanishing fundamental entropy rate, the absence of causal asymmetry, and infinite quantum Markov order. These results establish an operational framework for quantifying intrinsic quantum structure, revealing deep connections between causal generation, complexity, memory, entropy, and entanglement.
summary:
是什么使得一个量子过程比另一个量子过程更复杂？我们采用受经典复杂性科学启发的操作方法，该方法通过因果生成所需的记忆来表征结构。我们为量子空间序列开发了计算力学的全量子扩展：不返回与生成器交互的量子输出序列。对于允许有限维、原始因果模型的平稳、记忆量子空间序列，我们表明可以选择记忆最小模型来等距生成输出，而无需丢弃环境。所得的规范矩阵乘积状态表示确定了最小存储器维度和最小存储器熵。后者正是跨越过去与未来二分的纠缠熵，赋予纠缠作为因果生成的不可约记忆的操作解释。在此类中，我们进一步建立了消失的基本熵率、因果不对称性的缺失和无限量子马尔可夫阶。

这些结果建立了一个量化内在量子结构的操作框架，揭示了因果生成、复杂性、记忆、熵和纠缠之间的深层联系。

title: Classical Simulation of Lossy Gaussian Boson Sampling beyond Square-Root Regime
abstract: Photon loss makes Gaussian boson sampling easier to simulate classically. A standard approach replaces the lossy input by classical light, and it stays accurate while the mean number of surviving photons grows no faster than the square root of the number $N$ of squeezed inputs at fixed squeezing and accuracy. We prove that this scale is a limit of replacement by classical light. For explicit interferometers, no state with a nonnegative Glauber--Sudarshan $P$ representation, Gaussian or not and however correlated, keeps the error in the photon count distribution small beyond this scale. We then surpass this limit by approximating the detection instead of the input. The sampler evolves the state exactly between detections and, after each detection, replaces the conditional state by a Gaussian with the same covariance. For every interferometer its total variation error is $O(N\eta^3)$ at polynomial expected cost, where $\eta$ is the photon survival probability. The mean surviving photon number can therefore grow as $N^{2/3}$ at fixed accuracy. A separate pair construction reaches $N^{3/4}$ when every input mode is equally squeezed.
summary: 光子损失使得高斯玻色子采样更容易进行经典模拟。标准方法用经典光代替有损输入，并且它保持准确，而幸存光子的平均数量的增长不超过固定压缩和精度下压缩输入数量 $N$ 的平方根。我们证明这个尺度是经典光替代的极限。对于显式干涉仪，任何具有非负 Glauber-Sudarshan $P$ 表示的状态，无论是否为高斯分布，无论如何相关，都不会使光子计数分布中的误差保持在超出此范围的范围内。然后，我们通过近似检测而不是输入来超越这个限制。采样器在检测之间精确地演化状态，并且在每次检测之后，用具有相同协方差的高斯函数替换条件状态。对于每个干涉仪，在多项式预期成本下，其总变化误差为 $O(N\eta^3)$，其中 $\eta$ 是光子生存概率。因此，平均存活光子数可以以固定精度增长 $N^{2/3}$。当每个输入模式均等压缩时，单独的对结构达到 $N^{3/4}$。

title: Closed-Form Arbitrary-Gap Rényi Nonadditivity Above Any Positive Order via Direct Products of Free Groups and High-Girth Graphs
abstract: We give a closed-form finite-dimensional construction of quantum channels with real algebraic entries exhibiting arbitrarily large violations of minimum-output Rényi entropy additivity uniformly above any prescribed positive Rényi order, using a different finite realization based on direct products of free groups and fixed-field high-girth graphs. More precisely, for every $p_0>0$ and $g>0$, we construct one channel and one Bell input for which the additivity gap is greater than $g$ simultaneously for all $p\in[p_0,\infty]$. With $r=\lceil2g\rceil$, the construction uses $15r$ output qubits and $O(r2^{30r}+r^2(1+p_0^{-1}))$ input qubits. Compared with the stated parameters of Shou and Gorshkov \cite{ShouGorshkov2026}, our construction uses fewer output qubits for every target gap and has a smaller asymptotic input-qubit bound as the gap grows with the positive cutoff fixed. At the von Neumann order, a separate specialization gives an explicit channel with gap greater than $1/1024$ using $37608898$ input qubits and $8$ output qubits.
summary: 我们使用基于自由群和固定场高周长图的直接乘积的不同有限实现，给出了量子通道的封闭形式有限维构造，其中实代数项表现出任意大的对最小输出 Rényi 熵可加性的违反，均匀地高于任何规定的正 Rényi 阶。更准确地说，对于每个 $p_0>0$ 和 $g>0$，我们构造一个通道和一个 Bell 输入，对于所有 $p\in[p_0,\infty]$，其可加性间隙同时大于 $g$。对于 $r=\lceil2g\rceil$，该构造使用 $15r$ 输出量子位和 $O(r2^{30r}+r^2(1+p_0^{-1}))$ 输入量子位。与 Shou 和 Gorshkov \cite{ShouGorshkov2026} 规定的参数相比，我们的构造对于每个目标间隙使用更少的输出量子位，并且随着间隙随着固定的正截止值而增长，具有更小的渐近输入量子位界限。在冯·诺依曼阶下，单独的专门化使用 $37608898$ 输入量子位和 $8$ 输出量子位提供间隙大于 $1/1024$ 的显式通道。

title: The Mermin-Peres Magic Square Game With Three or More Players
abstract: We present a generalization of the Mermin-Peres magic square game to $N$ players, in which the square is replaced by an $N$-dimensional hypercube. We show that the winning probability of the optimal classical strategy remains $8/9$ for all $N$, while for $N \ge 3$, a generalization of the quantum strategy for $N = 2$ achieves a winning probability between $1/3$ and $3/4$. This loss of quantum advantage for $N \ge 3$ is a consequence of monogamy.
summary: 我们向 $N$ 玩家展示了 Mermin-Peres 魔方游戏的推广，其中正方形被 $N$ 维超立方体取代。我们表明，对于所有 $N$，最优经典策略的获胜概率仍然是 $8/9$，而对于 $N \ge 3$，$N = 2$ 的量子策略的推广实现了 $1/3$ 和 $3/4$ 之间的获胜概率。 $N \ge 3$ 量子优势的丧失是一夫一妻制的结果。

title: Symmetry and AI-assisted discovery of magic-state factories
abstract: Magic-state distillation is a major resource cost in fault-tolerant quantum computing. The cost of a magic-state factory depends strongly on its failure rate, which grows with the number of input magic states. Although symmetry-restricted methods have recently made distance two searches tractable, distance three and above have remained elusive at moderate input counts. We develop symmetry- and AI-assisted methods to search this regime. We present a unified binary-matrix formulation encompassing both triorthogonal-code and direct circuit searches. We show that distance at least three is equivalent to nonzero, pairwise distinct syndromes, separating the choice of syndromes from the search for compatible output gates. We restrict the syndrome search using group symmetry and language-model agents, followed by deterministic solving and independent verification. Our searches yield 699 factory classes, including 564 new ones. These include factories for pure-T states and factories with entangled outputs comprising combinations of T, CS, and CCZ magic states. The pure-T factories [[63, 11, 3]] and [[850, 128, 6]] achieve the lowest overhead exponents we know among protocols with at most 100 and 1000 inputs, respectively, with $\gamma = 1.589$ and $\gamma = 1.057$. Our [[1715, 287, 6]] factory, with $\gamma = 0.998$, is the smallest known pure-T factory with $\gamma < 1$. We also provide a context directory of search briefs and campaign notes with which readers can train their own agents and tailor the search to their requirements. With these results, we begin constructing an active, open-source repository of magic-state distillation protocols for the quantum community, supplemented by our methods and data, for the practical fault-tolerant quantum computing regime.
summary:
魔态蒸馏是容错量子计算中的主要资源成本。魔法状态工厂的成本很大程度上取决于其故障率，故障率随着输入魔法状态的数量而增加。尽管对称限制方法最近使得距离二搜索变得容易处理，但在中等输入计数下，距离三及以上仍然难以捉摸。我们开发了对称和人工智能辅助方法来搜索这种状态。我们提出了一个统一的二进制矩阵公式，包括三正交码和直接电路搜索。我们证明，距离至少为三相当于非零、成对不同的综合症，将综合症的选择与兼容输出门的搜索分开。我们使用群对称性和语言模型代理来限制综合症搜索，然后进行确定性求解和独立验证。我们的搜索产生了 699 个工厂类，其中包括 564 个新类。其中包括纯 T 状态的工厂和包含 T、CS 和 CCZ 魔法状态组合的纠缠输出的工厂。

纯 T 工厂 [[63, 11, 3]] 和 [[850, 128, 6]] 分别在最多 100 和 1000 个输入的协议中实现了我们所知的最低开销指数，其中 $\gamma = 1.589$ 和 $\gamma = 1.057$。我们的 [[1715, 287, 6]] 工厂，$\gamma = 0.998$，是已知最小的纯 T 工厂，$\gamma < 1$。我们还提供了搜索摘要和活动说明的上下文目录，读者可以使用它们来培训自己的代理并根据自己的要求定制搜索。有了这些结果，我们开始为量子社区构建一个活跃的、开源的魔态蒸馏协议存储库，并辅以我们的方法和数据，以实现实际的容错量子计算机制。

title: Products of unitaries as continuous evolutions at finite precision
abstract: I present a short approach to discretizing continuous unitary evolution. It gives a correspondence in both directions between continuous unitary evolutions and products of unitaries in finite dimensions, and I use it to reduce discrete adiabatic theorems to continuous ones. At fine steps, holding truncated samples of a regulated Hamiltonian on a suitable finite partition gives an approximating product. Conversely, rounding the clock identifies a product of $T$ unit-step samples with a continuous evolution, up to two half-step phases. I bound its operator-norm distance from the original evolution by $O(1/T)$ through cancellation within each time step. This assumes bounded first and second derivatives, bounded spectral width, and eigenvalue differences bounded away from nonzero multiples of $2\pi$, uniformly in $T$. For a unitary walk with these derivative bounds, a fixed common free spectral arc supplies a Hermitian logarithm path satisfying the comparison hypotheses. Continuous simulation guarantees then transfer to the phase-corrected product, and continuous adiabatic bounds to the product itself, with an explicit additive $O(1/T)$ error and each adiabatic theorem's hypotheses retained. For positive definite quantum linear systems of condition number $\kappa$, this comparison and continuous adiabatic theory give a rescaled qubitized walk with $O(\kappa/\delta)$ steps for leakage $\delta$, matching the scaling previously obtained through a discrete adiabatic theorem. These products need no discrete adiabatic theorem.
summary:
我提出了一种离散化连续酉演化的简短方法。它给出了连续酉演化和有限维酉乘积之间的两个方向的对应关系，我用它来将离散绝热定理简化为连续定理。在精细步骤中，将调节哈密顿量的截断样本保留在合适的有限分区上会给出近似乘积。相反，四舍五入可识别具有连续演化（最多两个半步阶段）的 $T$ 单位步样本的乘积。我通过在每个时间步内取消将其与原始演化的算子规范距离限制为 $O(1/T)$。这假设有界一阶导数和二阶导数、有界谱宽和特征值差远离 $2\pi$ 的非零倍数，统一在 $T$ 中。对于具有这些导数界限的酉游走，固定的公共自由谱弧提供满足比较假设的埃尔米特对数路径。

连续模拟保证随后转移到相位校正的乘积，以及乘积本身的连续绝热界限，并具有显式加性 $O(1/T)$ 误差，并保留每个绝热定理的假设。对于条件数 $\kappa$ 的正定量子线性系统，这种比较和连续绝热理论给出了泄漏 $\delta$ 的重新缩放的量子化行走 $O(\kappa/\delta)$ 步，与之前通过离散绝热定理获得的缩放相匹配。这些产品不需要离散绝热定理。

title: CT-bMPS: Approximate Tensor Network Contraction with Boundary MPS on Contraction Trees
abstract: We introduce contraction tree boundary matrix product states (CT-bMPS), a scalable approximate contraction method for general closed tensor networks. CT-bMPS represents the boundary tensor and its complementary environment at each edge of a contraction tree as matrix product states. This representation allows local compression based on a reduced transition matrix to incorporate environment information along arbitrary contraction trees, while keeping the time and memory costs polynomial in the network size and bond dimension. We benchmark the method on a variety of models and applications, including Ising partition functions, random tensor networks, kicked Ising dynamics, and quantum error correction decoding. These benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy and computational efficiency over existing general-purpose approximate contraction methods, together with the ability to handle larger and more complex networks. Optimized contraction trees and environment updates substantially improve accuracy without increasing the bond dimension. These results establish CT-bMPS as a general and scalable approximation framework with flexible contraction orders and environment-based compression for a wide range of applications.
summary:
我们引入收缩树边界矩阵乘积状态（CT-bMPS），这是一种适用于一般闭合张量网络的可扩展近似收缩方法。 CT-bMPS 将收缩树每条边的边界张量及其互补环境表示为矩阵乘积状态。这种表示允许基于简化的转换矩阵的局部压缩，以沿着任意收缩树合并环境信息，同时在网络大小和键维度上保持时间和内存成本多项式。我们在各种模型和应用上对该方法进行了基准测试，包括伊辛配分函数、随机张量网络、踢伊辛动力学和量子纠错解码。这些基准测试表明，与现有的通用近似收缩方法相比，准确性和计算效率有所提高，并且能够处理更大、更复杂的网络。优化的收缩树和环境更新在不增加键维数的情况下显着提高了准确性。

这些结果将 CT-bMPS 确立为通用且可扩展的近似框架，具有灵活的收缩阶数和基于环境的压缩，适用于广泛的应用。

title: Information causality does not single out the set of quantum correlations
abstract: Information causality (IC) was introduced as a physical principle that imposes constraints on the non-local correlations between two parties (Alice and Bob) in a Bell scenario. Specifically, it states that the information that Bob can gain about an $n$-bit database held by Alice is bounded by the information she communicates to him. To date, the question whether IC for any $n \in \mathbb{N}$ singles out the set of quantum correlations remains open, meaning that it is unknown whether for any number of inputs $m$ and outputs $d$ of the two parties the set of correlations that satisfy IC exactly coincides with the quantum correlations. In this work, we answer this question in the negative. Firstly, we show that for any finite database length $n \geq 2$, there is a bipartite set of correlations that satisfies IC for all compatible protocols and that exhibits post-quantum correlations in the Bell scenario with $n+1$ inputs and $2$ outcomes per party. This result relies on constructing an entropic proof of IC for GPTs that may be of independent interest. We further show that in the Bell scenario with $n+1$ inputs and $2$ outcomes per party, our constructed sets of correlations lead to neither a superset nor a subset of the quantum correlations. Secondly, we construct a set of correlations in the Bell scenario with $3$ inputs and $2$ outputs per party that satisfies IC (for all database sizes $n \in \mathbb{N}$) and that includes post-quantum points. Consequently, all known formulations of information causality fail to fully characterize the bipartite set of quantum correlations, already in the $3$-input, $2$-outcome Bell scenario.
summary:
信息因果关系（IC）作为一种物理原理被引入，它对贝尔场景中两方（爱丽丝和鲍勃）之间的非局部相关性施加约束。具体来说，它指出鲍勃可以获得的有关爱丽丝持有的 $n$ 位数据库的信息受到她传达给他的信息的限制。迄今为止，对于任何 $n \in \mathbb{N}$ 的 IC 是否能够挑出量子相关性集合的问题仍然悬而未决，这意味着对于双方的任意数量的输入 $m$ 和输出 $d$，满足 IC 的相关性集合是否与量子相关性完全一致尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们对这个问题给出了否定的回答。首先，我们证明，对于任何有限的数据库长度 $n \geq 2$，存在一组二分相关性，满足所有兼容协议的 IC，并且在 Bell 场景中表现出后量子相关性，每方具有 $n+1$ 输入和 $2$ 结果。这一结果依赖于为可能具有独立利益的 GPT 构建 IC 的熵证明。

我们进一步证明，在贝尔场景中，每方都有 $n+1$ 输入和 $2$ 结果，我们构建的相关性集既不会导致量子相关性的超集也不会产生子集。其次，我们在贝尔场景中构造一组相关性，每方输入 3 美元，输出 2 美元，满足 IC（对于所有数据库大小 $n \in \mathbb{N}$），并且包括后量子点。因此，所有已知的信息因果关系公式都无法充分描述量子相关性的二分集，而这已经是在 3 美元输入、2 美元结果贝尔场景中了。

title: Staying Sober: A Shot-Free Predictor of Logical Error Rates for Concatenated Quantum Error Correcting Codes
abstract: Estimating the logical error rate (LER) of a quantum error-correcting (QEC) code by Monte Carlo sampling takes $O(p^{-\lceil d/2 \rceil}/\varepsilon^2)$ samples at physical error rate $p$, code distance $d$ and relative error $\varepsilon$, which becomes intractable at large distances and low error rates, and especially for concatenated codes, whose distance grows as $d^{\ell}$ with the number of levels $\ell$. The fail fast method reduces this cost by sampling the failures of each weight separately, but it only works for unconcatenated codes, and does not model the soft information that the levels of a concatenated code pass to each other. We propose a predictor that takes the stabilizers, the minimum-weight logical operators and, for odd $d$, the logical operators of weight $d + 1$ of a code, and computes, without sampling, the leading monomial $c\,p^{o}$ of the LER when expressed as a polynomial in $p$, at every level of concatenation, in time polynomial in the code parameters and linear in $\ell$ for fixed budgets. We prove that our prediction is exact for any unconcatenated stabilizer code, for every logical observable and arbitrary per-qubit error rates, whenever no budget is exhausted. Furthermore, for concatenated codes, we construct a recursive approach that computes the leading monomial exactly in exponential time, and our predictor approximates this approach. Our predictions match exact enumeration at level 1 on every code we evaluate, and up to three levels for the iceberg code. Using our predictor, we evaluate and compare $37$ code configurations under four noise biases in $48$ core-hours, where Monte Carlo sampling would need more than $10^{12}$ shots at $p = 10^{-3}$ for $113$ of these $148$ cases.
summary:
通过蒙特卡罗采样估计量子纠错 (QEC) 代码的逻辑错误率 (LER) 需要 $O(p^{-\lceil d/2 \rceil}/\varepsilon^2)$ 个样本，物理错误率 $p$、代码距离 $d$ 和相对错误 $\varepsilon$，这在长距离和低错误率下变得棘手，特别是对于级联代码，其距离增长为$d^{\ell}$ 与级别数 $\ell$。快速失败方法通过分别对每个权重的失败进行采样来降低此成本，但它仅适用于未串联的代码，并且不会对串联代码的级别相互传递的软信息进行建模。我们提出了一个预测器，它采用稳定器、最小权重逻辑运算符，以及代码的奇数 $d$ 的权重 $d + 1$ 的逻辑运算符，并且在不采样的情况下计算 LER 的主要单项式 $c\,p^{o}$（当表示为 $p$ 中的多项式时），在每个串联级别，代码参数中的时间多项式以及固定预算的 $\ell$ 中的线性。

我们证明，只要没有耗尽预算，我们的预测对于任何未级联的稳定器代码、每个逻辑可观察的和任意的每量子位错误率都是准确的。此外，对于级联代码，我们构建了一种递归方法，可以在指数时间内精确计算领先单项式，并且我们的预测器近似于这种方法。我们的预测与我们评估的每个代码的第 1 级的精确枚举相匹配，对于冰山代码，最多与第 3 级的枚举相匹配。使用我们的预测器，我们在 48 美元的核心小时内评估和比较四种噪声偏差下的 37 美元代码配置，其中蒙特卡罗采样需要在 $p = 10^{-3}$ 下进行超过 10^{12}$ 次测试，才能获得这些 148$ 案例中的 113$ 美元。

title: Quantum codes are quantized codes: Stabilizer codes from quantization over finite fields
abstract: We present a discrete analogue of geometric quantization over finite fields which, when applied to certain classical error-correcting codes, yields quantum error-correcting codes. This provides a physical interpretation for a previously known quantum-classical correspondence in coding theory.
summary: 我们提出了有限域上几何量化的离散模拟，当应用于某些经典纠错码时，会产生量子纠错码。这为编码理论中先前已知的量子经典对应关系提供了物理解释。

title: Quantum Krylov Linear Solving Beyond Global Conditioning via Spectral Compression and Directional Stability
abstract: Global condition-number dependence can substantially overestimate the difficulty of preparing normalized quantum linear-system solutions. Many existing beyond-conditioning approaches are favorable when globally ill-conditioned directions have limited relevance to the target solution. Here we study a harder regime for time-evolution quantum Krylov linear solving (QKS), where a vanishing eigenvalue remains solution-relevant and must be retained. We identify a QKS regime in which the solution-relevant spectrum is compressed into a compact reduced space where the ill-conditioning is concentrated along a soft direction aligned with the solution, so that normalization removes the divergent amplification along that direction and leaves only a bounded transverse response. Consequently, the normalized-state complexity need not inherit the divergence of the global condition number. Our contributions are threefold: (1) We show that the solution-relevant information admits a compact and stable QKS representation, with bounded subspace dimension, evolution time, and reconstruction overhead as the relevant eigenvalue vanishes. (2) We show that normalized-state difficulty is governed by whether inverse amplification changes the solution direction, rather than by the small eigenvalue alone; even an arbitrarily ill-conditioned reduced system can remain directionally stable when the amplification is solution-aligned. (3) We prove that this stability persists under finite projected-system errors and transfers to the actual QKS output, yielding an end-to-end complexity bound without inverse dependence on the retained small eigenvalue. An explicit separation family further shows that a full inverse-amplification criterion can diverge while the corresponding QKS quantities remain bounded.
summary:
Global condition-number dependence can substantially overestimate the difficulty of preparing normalized quantum linear-system solutions.当全局病态方向与目标解决方案的相关性有限时，许多现有的超条件方法是有利的。在这里，我们研究了时间演化量子克雷洛夫线性求解（QKS）的更难机制，其中消失的特征值仍然与解相关并且必须保留。我们确定了一种 QKS 机制，其中与解相关的频谱被压缩到一个紧凑的缩减空间中，其中病态条件沿着与解对齐的软方向集中，因此归一化消除了沿该方向的发散放大，只留下有界横向响应。 Consequently, the normalized-state complexity need not inherit the divergence of the global condition number.我们的贡

（2）我们证明归一化状态难度取决于逆放大是否改变解的方向，而不是仅仅取决于小特征值；当放大与解对齐时，即使是任意病态的简化系统也可以保持方向稳定。 (3) 我们证明这种稳定性在有限投影系统误差下持续存在，并转移到实际的 QKS 输出，产生端到端的复杂性界限，而不与保留的小特征值成反向依赖。显式分离族进一步表明，当相应的 QKS 数量保持有界时，完整的逆放大标准可能会发散。

title: Large Language Model-Guided Discovery of Weight-Five Bivariate Bicycle Codes
abstract: Building on our earlier program-evolution workflow guided by large language models (LLMs), we study weight-five bivariate bicycle (BB) and perturbed bivariate bicycle (PBB) codes. The resulting catalogue contains 1,142 distinct code proposals, including 1,081 nonbaseline proposals attributable to LLM-generated programs. Across the catalogue, we certify connected Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) realizations [[96,4,10]], [[140,6,10]], and [[180,4,14]]. A post-search comparison certifies seven imported Lin--Pryadko archive constructions. For leading parameter triples also represented in that archive, we provide exact distance evidence, explicit bivariate presentations, and verified component reductions. A basis-independent connectivity analysis identifies 409 of the 1,142 catalogue entries as disconnected and shows that 73.1\% of the classes with exact distance certificates contain repeated connected components. Algebraic analysis organizes the connected CSS classes into order-3, order-7, and order-15 cyclotomic-kernel strata. The strongest exact connected PBB parameter point is [[216,4,10]], attained by two distinct component classes. Among the 936 distinct CSS proposals from the LLM-guided campaign with a recorded positive distance, 816 (87.18\%) are certified at $d\geq5$. For comparison, three random-search controls each sample 6,444 CSS code proposals uniformly without replacement, using the same per-lattice and encoded-dimension sample counts as the LLM-guided campaign. In these controls, 4,672--4,785 proposals (72.50--74.26\%) meet the same criterion. The LLM-guided campaign has the higher certified yield, while the random controls cover more connected classes. Together, these results extend LLM-guided discovery to a more constrained code family and provide a reproducible structural and exact-distance account of its strongest candidates.
summary:
基于我们早期由大语言模型 (LLM) 指导的程序演化工作流程，我们研究了权重五双变量自行车 (BB) 和扰动双变量自行车 (PBB) 代码。生成的目录包含 1,142 个不同的代码提案，其中包括 1,081 个可归因于 LLM 生成的程序的非基线提案。在整个目录中，我们认证连接的 Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) 实现 [[96,4,10]]、[[140,6,10]] 和 [[180,4,14]]。搜索后比较证明了七个导入的 Lin-Pryadko 档案结构。对于该档案中也表示的主要参数三元组，我们提供精确的距离证据、明确的双变量表示和经过验证的分量缩减。独立于基础的连接分析将 1,142 个目录条目中的 409 个识别为断开连接，并显示 73.1% 具有精确距离证书的类包含重复的连接组件。代数分析将连接的 CSS 类组织为 3 阶、7 阶和 15 阶分圆内核层。最强的精确连接 PBB 参数点是 [[216,4,10]]，通过两个不同的组件类获得。

在 LLM 指导的活动中，有 936 份具有正距离记录的不同 CSS 提案，其中 816 份 (87.18%) 获得了 $d\geq5$ 的认证。为了进行比较，三个随机搜索统一控制每个样本 6,444 个 CSS 代码提案，无需替换，使用与 LLM 指导的活动相同的每格和编码维度样本计数。在这些控制中，4,672--4,785 个提案 (72.50--74.26\%) 满足相同的标准。法学硕士指导的活动具有更高的认证产量，而随机控制则涵盖更多相关类别。总之，这些结果将法学硕士引导的发现扩展到更受约束的代码族，并为其最强候选者提供了可重复的结构和精确距离说明。

title: Kramers' Theorem Leaves a Topological Footprint in Classical Records
abstract: Time reversal $\Theta$ squares to $-1$ on a half-integer spin, so every state is orthogonal to its time reverse. This sign has been read only from quantum objects. The equilibrium state loses it, but the classical record keeps it. For a detector that resolves handedness, the probabilities that one stretch of record is followed by the time reverse of another measure the cohomology class of time reversal, $\Theta^2=\pm1$. Their matrix carries this sign in its signature, a topological integer that survives equal emission and absorption losses. A programmed emitter on quantum processors reads it in about $10^3$ shots.
summary: 时间反转 $\Theta$ 在半整数自旋上平方为 $-1$，因此每个状态都与其时间反转正交。该符号只能从量子对象中读取。平衡状态失去了它，但经典记录保留了它。对于解决旋手性的检测器，一段记录后面跟着另一条记录的时间反转的概率衡量时间反转的上同调类，$\Theta^2=\pm1$。他们的矩阵在其签名中带有这个符号，这是一个能够承受相同发射和吸收损失的拓扑整数。量子处理器上的编程发射器在大约 10^3 美元的时间内读取它。

title: Quantum Gibbs State Preparation via Relative Decoding: From Fast-Mixing Sources to Broader Target Classes
abstract: Provable guarantees for preparing quantum Gibbs states, such as rapid mixing or gapped coherent preparation paths, are known only for restricted Hamiltonian families and usually must be re-derived for each new family. Building on homomorphic polynomial transduction, a generalization of decoded quantum interferometry (DQI) and Hamiltonian DQI (HDQI), we show how relative decoding transfers such a guarantee from a source Hamiltonian $H_A$ to a target $H_B$. Writing each Hamiltonian as a sum of $m$ Pauli terms, the subsets of terms whose product is proportional to the identity, its relations, form a binary linear code, $K_A$ for the source and $K_B$ for the target, with the Pauli-label matrix as parity-check matrix as in DQI. Starting from the canonical thermofield double (TFD) of $H_A$, a Bell transform, a reversible label map, and a coherent decoder for the quotient code $K_B/K_A$ prepare an approximate TFD of $H_B$, and hence its Gibbs state. Because this decoder only resolves target relations absent from the source, the reachable inverse temperature is set by the relative distance $d_{\rm rel}$, the fewest terms in any such relation. It can far exceed the ordinary distance $d_{\rm ord}$, the fewest terms in any target relation, which bounds the uniform exact decoding radius of DQI and HDQI. We show that linear $d_{\rm rel}$ with efficient decoding at linear radius certifies a constant inverse temperature. As an example, starting from a nearest-neighbor spin chain whose TFD is known to be preparable at every finite temperature, a sparse classical parity-check matrix yields bounded-degree, geometrically nonlocal, noncommuting targets with $d_{\rm ord}=3$ and $d_{\rm rel}=\Theta(m)$. To our knowledge, this gives a new class of efficiently preparable TFDs.
summary:
制备量子吉布斯态的可证明保证，例如快速混合或有间隙的相干制备路径，仅对于受限的哈密顿族是已知的，并且通常必须为每个新族重新推导。基于同态多项式转导、解码量子干涉测量 (DQI) 和哈密顿量 DQI (HDQI) 的推广，我们展示了相对解码如何将这种保证从源哈密顿量 $H_A$ 转移到目标 $H_B$。将每个哈密顿量写为 $m$ 泡利项的总和，项的子集其乘积与身份及其关系成正比，形成二进制线性代码，$K_A$ 为源，$K_B$ 为目标，保利标签矩阵作为 DQI 中的奇偶校验矩阵。从 $H_A$ 的规范热场双精度 (TFD) 开始，贝尔变换、可逆标签图和商代码 $K_B/K_A$ 的相干解码器准备 $H_B$ 的近似 TFD，从而准备其吉布斯状态。因为该解码器仅解析源中不存在的目标关系，所以可达到的逆温度由相对距离 $d_{\rm rel}$ 设置，这是任何此类关系中最少的项。

它可以远远超过普通距离 $d_{\rm ord}$，这是任何目标关系中最少的项，它限制了 DQI 和 HDQI 的统一精确解码半径。我们证明，在线性半径处具有有效解码的线性 $d_{\rm rel}$ 证明了恒定的逆温度。举个例子，从已知在每个有限温度下可制备的 TFD 的最近邻自旋链开始，稀疏经典奇偶校验矩阵产生有界度、几何非局部、非交换目标，其中 $d_{\rm ord}=3$ 和 $d_{\rm rel}=\Theta(m)$。据我们所知，这提供了一类新的可高效准备的 TFD。

title: Climbing the Fusion Tree: Center Ordering and Decoding Hierarchy in Non-Abelian Mixed States
abstract: We develop an operational approach to strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (sw-SSB) of a non-Abelian symmetry group G. We formulate it as the decoding task of distinguishing two strongly symmetric states that differ by a pair of inserted irreps, after both are corrupted by strongly symmetric decoherence. For finite G, this task is dual to distinguishing logical states of the quantum double D(G) under pure-charge noise. We derive a hierarchy of statistical mechanics models describing optimal decoding from the fusion outcomes measured on successively larger nested regions. As for maximum-likelihood decoders of Abelian codes the measured irreps act as quenched disorder obeying a Nishimori-like condition. Strikingly, because local irreps do not determine how they fuse globally, the strong $G\times G$ symmetry is realized only nonlocally, and irreps trivially charged under Z(G) (the center of G) can hide inside noise-generated ones. As a result, the strong symmetry spontaneously breaks down to Z(G), times the weak symmetry. The only transition at nonzero error rate is then an ordering of the center, whose threshold cannot decrease as the hierarchy is ascended. This conclusion holds at any finite level of the hierarchy for non-nilpotent groups. We confirm these predictions with tensor-network calculations for $S_3$ and SU(2). At the first level, the $S_3$ model, whose center is trivial, shows no transition, and the fidelity correlations of all irreps provably decay to non-zero values. The SU(2) model exhibits a $Z_2$ transition consistent with the Nishimori-Ising universality class, where the fidelity correlations of spin-$1/2$ irreps become long-range. The threshold rises from the first to the second level of the hierarchy by $16\%$. Our results provide a systematic framework for studying non-Abelian sw-SSB and for constructing decoders for non Abelian topological codes.
summary:
我们开发了一种非阿贝尔对称群 G 的强到弱自发对称破缺 (sw-SSB) 的操作方法。我们将其表述为区分两个强对称状态的解码任务，这两个状态因一对插入的不可重复而不同，而这两个状态都被强对称退相干破坏了。对于有限 G，此任务是区分纯电荷噪声下量子双 D(G) 的逻辑状态的双重任务。我们推导出统计力学模型的层次结构，该模型描述了从连续较大的嵌套区域上测量的融合结果中的最佳解码。对于阿贝尔码的最大似然解码器，测量的不可重复充当服从类西森条件的淬灭无序。引人注目的是，因为局部不可表示不能决定它们如何全局融合，所以强 $G\times G$ 对称性只能在非局部实现，并且在 Z(G) （G 的中心）下平凡充电的不可表示可以隐藏在噪声生成的内部。结果，强对称性自发分解为 Z(G) 乘以弱对称性。非零错误率下的唯一转变是中心的排序，其阈值不能随着层次结构的上升而降低。

对于非幂零群，这个结论在层次结构的任何有限层上都成立。我们通过 $S_3$ 和 SU(2) 的张量网络计算来确认这些预测。在第一级，$S_3$ 模型的中心是平凡的，没有显示任何转变，并且所有不可表示的保真度相关性可证明衰减到非零值。 SU(2) 模型表现出与 Nishimori-Ising 普适性类一致的 $Z_2$ 转变，其中自旋 $1/2$ irrep 的保真度相关性变为长程。阈值从层次结构的第一级到第二级增加$16\%$。我们的结果为研究非阿贝尔 sw-SSB 和构建非阿贝尔拓扑码解码器提供了一个系统框架。

title: Measurement-free Preparation of Surface-Code States with Digital-Analog Counterdiabatic Drivings
abstract: Preparing stabilizer-code states with shallow circuits is an important primitive for near-term quantum error correction in superconducting circuits, where logical-state initialization requires four-body stabilizer correlations from native one- and two-body controls. We introduce a digital-analog method for the preparation of surface-code ground-state manifolds. The method exploits a structural property of the adiabatic gauge potential, mapping stabilizer-local counterdiabatic terms to digital-analog blocks on the superconducting layout using fixed-angle two-qubit \(XY\) gates, single-qubit rotations, and analog exchange-interaction evolutions. The dressed blocks generate higher-order operators used as the variational ansatz to determine the counterdiabatic terms within the Sels-Polkovnikov adiabatic-gauge-potential framework. We benchmark checkerboard plaquette-stabilizer grids up to \(4\times4\), the square-grid instances correspond to rotated surface codes, while the rectangular cases probe the scaling of the method. For all grids, the proposed method generates the dominant four-body counterdiabatic basis and, at short evolution times substantially improves the ground-state preparation as compared with bare adiabatic evolution. We further generalize the construction to \(n\times m\) stabilizer lattices and show that digital-analog synthesis can reduce the entangling depth by an order of magnitude. Together, these results establish a direct connection between stabilizer geometry, the structure of the counterdiabatic gauge potential, and digital-analog control for measurement-free preparation of stabilizer-code states on near-term superconducting architecture.
summary:
用浅层电路准备稳定器代码状态是超导电路中近期量子纠错的重要原语，其中逻辑状态初始化需要来自本机一体和二体控制的四体稳定器相关性。我们介绍了一种用于制备表面代码基态流形的数模方法。该方法利用绝热规范势的结构特性，使用固定角度双量子位 \(XY\) 门、单量子位旋转和模拟交换相互作用演化将稳定器局域反绝热项映射到超导布局上的数字模拟模块。修饰后的块生成用作变分拟似的高阶算子，以确定 Sels-Polkovnikov 绝热规范势框架内的反绝热项。我们对棋盘斑块稳定器网格进行基准测试，最高可达 \(4\times4\)，方形网格实例对应于旋转的表面代码，而矩形案例则探测该方法的缩放。

对于所有网格，所提出的方法生成了占主导地位的四体反绝热基础，并且与裸绝热演化相比，在较短的演化时间内显着改善了基态准备。我们进一步将结构推广到\(n\times m\)稳定晶格，并表明数模合成可以将纠缠深度减少一个数量级。总之，这些结果在稳定器几何结构、反绝热规范电位结构和数字模拟控制之间建立了直接联系，以在近期超导架构上实现稳定器代码状态的免测量准备。

title: Random-Oracle Unitary Synthesis is Impossible
abstract: A major open problem in quantum complexity is the question of unitary synthesis---namely, is it possible to efficiently implement any unitary, given the ability to evaluate any classical function in superposition? Inspired by a recent work by Brakerski and Yuen (CRYPTO 2026), we propose an ``average-case'' unitary synthesis problem, which asks whether it is possible to efficiently implement a Haar random unitary given access to a random Boolean function. We then demonstrate a superpolynomial query lower bound, establishing that unitary synthesis in this model is impossible. Along with our main result, we settle in the negative a question Brakerski and Yuen pose, of whether scalable pseudorandom unitaries (PRUs) can be implemented in the ROM-PRU model. In particular, we show that in the ROM-PRU model, no $\Omega(N^{1+\gamma})$ unitary design on $n$ qubits, where $N=2^n$, can be efficiently achieved for any $\gamma > 0$. On the other hand, we construct an $O(N)$-design in $\text{poly}(n)$ queries in the same model, surpassing the previously best known results which constructed $O(\sqrt{N})$-designs.
summary: 量子复杂性中的一个主要开放问题是酉综合问题——即，如果能够评估任何叠加的经典函数，是否可以有效地实现任何酉？受 Brakerski 和 Yuen 最近的工作（CRYPTO 2026）的启发，我们提出了一个“平均情况”酉合成问题，该问题询问是否可以在给定访问随机布尔函数的情况下有效地实现 Haar 随机酉函数。然后，我们演示了超多项式查询下界，在该模型中建立单一综合是不可能的。除了我们的主要结果之外，我们还解决了 Brakerski 和 Yuen 提出的否定问题：可扩展伪随机酉 (PRU) 是否可以在 ROM-PRU 模型中实现。特别是，我们表明，在 ROM-PRU 模型中，对于任何 $\gamma > 0$，无法有效地实现 $n$ 量子位（其中 $N=2^n$）上的 $\Omega(N^{1+\gamma})$ 统一设计。另一方面，我们在同一模型中的 $\text{poly}(n)$ 查询中构建了一个 $O(N)$ 设计，超越了之前构造 $O(\sqrt{N})$ 设计的最著名结果。

title: Optimal compression with quantum retrieval
abstract: We consider the following data compression problem. Given a string $x \in \{0,1\}^m$ of Hamming weight at most $n$, compress it into a shorter string $y \in \{0,1\}^s$ so that any bit $x_i$ of $x$ can be retrieved without any error using at most $t$ quantum queries to the standard oracle encoding of $y$. If queries are allowed to be adaptive we show how optimal compression up to a logarithmic factor can be achieved. If the queries are required to be made non-adaptively, we show schemes whose space is optimal in its dependence on $m$ except for a logarithmic factor, and is at most quadratically worse when compared to the optimum in its dependence on $n$.
summary: 我们考虑以下数据压缩问题。给定一个汉明权重最多为 $n$ 的字符串 $x \in \{0,1\}^m$，将其压缩为较短的字符串 $y \in \{0,1\}^s$，以便使用对 $y$ 的标准 oracle 编码进行最多 $t$ 量子查询来检索 $x$ 的任何位 $x_i$，不会出现任何错误。如果允许查询自适应，我们将展示如何实现对数因子的最佳压缩。如果要求非自适应地进行查询，我们将展示其空间在对 $m$ 的依赖性方面是最优的方案（除了对数因子之外），并且与在其对 $n$ 的依赖性方面的最佳值相比，其空间至多差二次方。

title: Approximate cloning of structured pure states
abstract: The no-cloning theorem is a cornerstone result in quantum mechanics that forbids copying of general quantum information. More quantitatively, even given $N$ copies of an unknown state, any channel producing an $(N+1)$-copy state incurs a nonzero trace-distance error on some inputs. Turning this around, one can ask about the sample complexity of approximate $N\rightarrow N+1$ cloning: for a desired small error $\epsilon$, what $N$ suffices? For arbitrary pure states on a Hilbert space $H$, the answer is $N\simeq \dim H/\epsilon$ - astronomically large for most $H$ of interest. What if the input is promised to lie in a structured family? We examine a range of families fundamental to many-body physics and quantum information: $n$-mode fermionic Gaussian and Slater states, $n$-mode bosonic Gaussian states, and qudit phase states. For fermions, we construct optimal cloning channels, reducing the complexity from exponential to polynomial in $n$. For bosonic Gaussian states, we construct an explicit cloner that certifies polynomial complexity, without any constraint on the energy of the state; this channel, however, is not optimal in general. The fermionic and bosonic results follow from a single representation-theoretic framework, which generalizes previous work by Werner and by Chiribella and Yang; it also yields the cloners' unitary implementation. Furthermore, we explain why for many families the cloning complexity is linear in the dimension of the family manifold, via a controlled saddle-point evaluation of the frame potential at high $N$. The same calculation accounts for the analogous scaling of tomography complexity. The above framework does not cover phase states; for these we give an independent construction of a channel with optimal cloning fidelity. Our work complements recent results on cloning stabilizer states.
summary:
不可克隆定理是量子力学的一个基石结果，禁止复制一般量子信息。更定量地说，即使给定未知状态的 $N$ 个副本，任何产生 $(N+1)$ 副本状态的通道也会在某些输入上产生非零跟踪距离误差。反过来，我们可以询问近似 $N\rightarrow N+1$ 克隆的样本复杂性：对于所需的小误差 $\epsilon$，$N$ 足够吗？对于希尔伯特空间 $H$ 上的任意纯态，答案是 $N\simeq \dim H/\epsilon$ - 对于大多数感兴趣的 $H$ 来说是天文数字。如果承诺投入来自一个结构化的家庭怎么办？我们研究了一系列对多体物理和量子信息至关重要的族：n$模费米子高斯态和斯莱特态、n$模玻色高斯态和qudit相态。对于费米子，我们构建了最佳克隆通道，将 $n$ 的复杂度从指数降低到多项式。对于玻色高斯态，我们构建了一个显式克隆器来证明多项式复杂性，而对状态能量没有任何限制；然而，该渠道总体上并不是最佳的。

费米子和玻色子的结果遵循单一的表示理论框架，该框架概括了维尔纳以及奇里贝拉和杨先前的工作；它还产生了克隆者的统一实现。此外，我们通过对高 $N$ 下的框架势进行受控鞍点评估，解释了为什么对于许多族来说，克隆复杂性在族流形的维度上是线性的。相同的计算说明了断层扫描复杂性的类似缩放。上述框架不涵盖相态；对于这些，我们给出了具有最佳克隆保真度的独立通道构建。我们的工作补充了克隆稳定剂状态的最新结果。

title: Random Order in Quantum Streaming: Replenishment and Robust Lower Bounds
abstract: How can random order change the role of quantum memory in streaming? Later classical input can restore the usefulness of a quantum state consumed by earlier queries. We call this replenishment. We construct an artificial problem based on Hidden Matching, with repeated coordinate data and online matching requests. It admits a one-pass quantum algorithm using polylogarithmic space in uniformly random order, but unconditionally requires polynomial space both classically in random order and quantumly when all updates precede the requests. To prove the quantum lower bound, we strengthen the consumability bounds of Gilboa, Jain, and McClean for Multiple Hidden Matching. Without prior entanglement, any quantum encoding supporting $r$ independent matching requests requires $\Omega(r)$ qubits for $r\le N^{1/2-\delta}$ and every fixed $\delta\in(0,1/2)$, even with simultaneous revelation and arbitrary joint decoding. For sequential requests, the linear bound extends through $r=\Theta(\sqrt N)$. We also adapt Kallaugher's triangle-counting algorithm to uniformly random streams in which every edge is repeated equally often. Rebuilding the quantum sketch and resampling the classical estimator improve its expected-space bound in suitable parameter regimes. Finally, we extend the robust Noisy Gap Cycle framework of Assadi and Sundaresan to quantum streaming. A quantum communication lower bound for Block Hidden XOR yields an $\Omega(n)$ space lower bound in random edge order for large enough cycles, with consequences for several graph problems. Thus random order can enable replenishment of small quantum representations, while substantial space requirements persist for other tasks.
summary:
随机顺序如何改变量子存储器在流媒体中的作用？稍后的经典输入可以恢复早期查询所消耗的量子状态的有用性。我们称之为补货。我们构建了一个基于隐藏匹配的人工问题，具有重复的坐标数据和在线匹配请求。它允许使用均匀随机顺序的多对数空间的一次性量子算法，但无条件地要求多项式空间，无论是经典的随机顺序还是当所有更新都先于请求时的量子。为了证明量子下界，我们加强了 Gilboa、Jain 和 McClean 的多重隐藏匹配的可消耗性界限。如果没有事先纠缠，任何支持 $r$ 独立匹配请求的量子编码都需要 $\Omega(r)$ 量子位用于 $r\le N^{1/2-\delta}$ 和每个固定的 $\delta\in(0,1/2)$，即使同时揭示和任意联合解码也是如此。对于顺序请求，线性界限延伸至 $r=\Theta(\sqrt N)$。我们还将 Kallaugher 的三角形计数算法应用于均匀随机流，其中每条边重复的频率相同。

重建量子草图并重新采样经典估计器可以改善其在合适的参数范围内的预期空间界限。最后，我们将 Assadi 和 Sundaresan 的稳健的 Noisy Gap Cycle 框架扩展到量子流。块隐藏 XOR 的量子通信下界在足够大的周期内以随机边缘顺序产生 $\Omega(n)$ 空间下界，从而产生几个图形问题。因此，随机顺序可以补充小量子表示，而其他任务仍然需要大量空间。

title: Qubit CSS codes with Universal Transversal Gates
abstract: The Eastin-Knill theorem rules out a universal set of transversal logical gates on any code that detects single-qubit errors. The theorem constrains one partition of the qubits at a time. We show that depth-one layers of few-qubit gates, each respecting its own partition, can together generate a universal logical gate set on an error-correcting code. Each logical gate generator is then a single depth-one layer followed by error correction of the same stabilizer code, with no magic-state distillation, code switching, gauge fixing, lattice surgery, or other gadgets. We show that such codes can be found by applying an entangling circuit to a lower-distance "seed" code admitting a depth-one non-Clifford gate and an appropriate "kernel" code. We construct 47 codes with depth-one generating sets that tolerate at least one faulty gate per layer, including a [[37,1,7]] and a [[59,1,9]] code, both of check weight at most eight.
summary: Eastin-Knill 定理排除了检测单量子位错误的任何代码上的通用横向逻辑门集。该定理一次约束量子位的一个分区。我们证明，深度一层的几个量子位门，每个门都尊重自己的分区，可以一起在纠错码上生成通用逻辑门集。每个逻辑门生成器都是单个深度一层，然后对相同的稳定器代码进行纠错，没有魔态蒸馏、代码切换、规范固定、晶格手术或其他小工具。我们证明，可以通过将纠缠电路应用于允许深度一非克利福德门和适当的“内核”代码的较低距离“种子”代码来找到此类代码。我们构建了 47 个具有深度一生成集的代码，每层至少容忍一个错误门，包括 [[37,1,7]] 和 [[59,1,9]] 代码，两者的检查权重都最多为 8。

title: Anti-symmetrization is cheap and useful
abstract: We consider the computational task of anti-symmetrization of an unknown mixed quantum state: Given iid copies of a rank-$r$ qudit state $\rho=\sum_{i=1}^r \lambda_i |\varphi_i\rangle\!\langle\varphi_i|$, prepare a copy of the state proportional to $\Pi_{\mathrm{anti}}^r (|\varphi_1\rangle\otimes \ldots\otimes|\varphi_r\rangle)$, with $\Pi_{\mathrm{anti}}^r$ the anti-symmetric subspace projector. We first give a simple algorithm for anti-symmetrization that uses $\widetilde{O}(r / \lambda_{\min})$ copies of $\rho$, where $\lambda_{\min}$ is the minimum non-zero eigenvalue of $\rho$. This algorithm works even in the streaming setting with small working memory, and it uses only simple quantum operations like controlled-SWAPs and constantly many layers of single-qubit gates. As an application of this streaming anti-symmetrization procedure, we give a reduction from gapped mixed-state one-way state generators to pure-state one-way state generators. Then, using tools from Schur-Weyl duality, we give and analyze a second (non-streaming) anti-symmetrization procedure that uses $O(r / \lambda_{\min})$ copies of $\rho$, which then serves as a building block in new algorithms for weak Schur sampling and unitary Schur sampling, outperforming existing approaches in some regimes of number of copies $n$ and local dimension $d$, as well as in an algorithm for optimal purity amplification for qudit states.
summary:
我们考虑未知混合量子态反对称化的计算任务：给定rank-$r$ qdit状态$\rho=\sum_{i=1}^r \lambda_i |\varphi_i\rangle\!\langle\varphi_i|$的iid副本，准备与$\Pi_{\mathrm{anti}}^r (|\varphi_1\rangle\otimes)成正比的状态副本\ldots\otimes|\varphi_r\rangle)$，其中 $\Pi_{\mathrm{anti}}^r$ 是反对称子空间投影仪。我们首先给出一个简单的反对称化算法，该算法使用 $\rho$ 的 $\widetilde{O}(r / \lambda_{\min})$ 副本，其中 $\lambda_{\min}$ 是 $\rho$ 的最小非零特征值。该算法甚至可以在工作内存较小的流设置中工作，并且仅使用简单的量子操作，例如受控交换和不断的多层单量子位门。作为这种流式反对称化过程的一种应用，我们给出了从带隙混合态单向状态生成器到纯态单向状态生成器的简化。

然后，使用 Schur-Weyl 对偶性的工具，我们给出并分析了第二个（非流式）反对称化过程，该过程使用 $O(r / \lambda_{\min})$ 个 $\rho$ 副本，然后作为弱 Schur 采样和酉 Schur 采样新算法的构建块，在副本数 $n$ 和局部维度 $d$ 的某些机制以及 qudit 的最佳纯度放大算法中优于现有方法。州。

title: Free entropy and quantum minimum description length
abstract: In free probability, Voiculescu's free entropy counts matrix microstates that approximate an operator. It is a non-commutative analog of the Shannon entropy, distinct from any quantum entropy of a density operator, but it has had no physical meaning in quantum theory. We define a finite-dimensional physical free entropy at finite resolution and show that it directly characterizes, up to an explicit constant, the minimal quantum memory needed to program many copies of a state with known eigenvalues and unknown eigenbasis. This task is a variant of Schumacher compression, and we call its optimal cost the quantum minimum description length. We briefly discuss how free entropy differs from quantum entropies and its potential applications in quantum physics.
summary: 在自由概率中，沃伊库列斯库的自由熵对近似算子的矩阵微观状态进行计数。它是香农熵的非交换模拟，与密度算子的任何量子熵不同，但它在量子理论中没有物理意义。我们在有限分辨率下定义了有限维物理自由熵，并表明它直接表征了在显式常数范围内对具有已知特征值和未知特征基的状态的许多副本进行编程所需的最小量子存储器。该任务是舒马赫压缩的一个变体，我们将其最优成本称为量子最小描述长度。我们简要讨论自由熵与量子熵的不同之处及其在量子物理学中的潜在应用。

title: Quantum minimum description of density matrices
abstract: We study a variant of Schumacher compression. The task asks for the minimal memory cost for compressing many copies of a density matrix with known spectrum and unknown eigenbasis, without preserving its purification. For fixed dimension and distinct positive eigenvalues, we obtain the cost through its additive constant. Achievability uses a generalization of Werner's cloning map to $\mathrm{GL}(d,\mathbb C)$ irreducible representations, with finite trace-distance bounds controlled by highest-weight differences and row gaps. The matching converse follows from a quantitative form of Koashi--Imoto incompressibility for irreducible group orbits under a spectral-gap assumption. We also identify the relation between this quantum minimum description length and universal lossless coding overhead, and its connection to free entropy is explained in a companion letter. We provide a Lean certificate for our proofs.
summary: 我们研究了舒马赫压缩的一种变体。该任务要求以最小的内存成本来压缩具有已知频谱和未知特征基的密度矩阵的许多副本，而不保留其纯化。对于固定维度和不同的正特征值，我们通过其加性常数获得成本。可实现性使用 Werner 的克隆映射到 $\mathrm{GL}(d,\mathbb C)$ 不可约表示的推广，其中有限迹线距离界限由最高权重差异和行间隙控制。匹配逆从谱间隙假设下不可约群轨道的 Koashi-Imoto 不可压缩性的定量形式得出。我们还确定了这个量子最小描述长度和通用无损编码开销之间的关系，并且它与自由熵的联系在一封伴随信中得到了解释。我们为我们的证明提供精益证书。

title: Discovering New Problems for Decoded Quantum Interferometry
abstract: Decoded quantum interferometry (DQI) uses classical error correction to solve optimization problems, but it is hard to tell which problems could give it a quantum advantage. We develop soundness rules that screen candidate problems by their code parameters, decoding guarantees and classical baselines. For the standard objective of counting satisfied constraints, we prove that under worst-case Hamming decoding DQI's guarantee can exceed Prange completion by at most $(\sqrt{2}-1)/2$. Optimal polynomial intersection (OPI) attains this margin cap asymptotically, so no candidate in this setting can exceed OPI's margin. We also derive a performance law for real-valued objectives: the objective fixes both the solution quality and which errors the decoder must correct. An AI-agent search guided by these rules found two candidate applications. Alternant max-agreement on McEliece-type public keys tests what a secret decoder is worth to DQI against classical solvers that see only the public instance. Multiplicative polynomial intersection, a knapsack-type problem built from discrete logarithms, pairs a cosine objective with a public decoder for signed errors. For both we prove decoding guarantees and finite-length comparisons with Prange restarts, and on the larger instances we tested, DQI's expected quality exceeds what our classical solvers reach within fixed budgets.
summary:
解码量子干涉测量（DQI）使用经典纠错来解决优化问题，但很难判断哪些问题可以为其带来量子优势。我们开发健全性规则，通过代码参数、解码保证和经典基线来筛选候选问题。对于计算满足约束的标准目标，我们证明在最坏情况下汉明解码 DQI 的保证最多可以超过 Prange 完成 $(\sqrt{2}-1)/2$。最优多项式交集 (OPI) 渐进地达到此边际上限，因此此设置中的任何候选项都不能超过 OPI 的边际。我们还推导了实值目标的性能定律：目标既确定了解决方案的质量，也确定了解码器必须纠正的错误。根据这些规则进行的人工智能代理搜索发现了两个候选应用程序。 McEliece 类型公钥的交替最大协议测试秘密解码器对于 DQI 的价值，以对抗仅看到公共实例的经典求解器。乘法多项式交集是一种由离散对数构建的背包型问题，它将余弦目标与用于有符号错误的公共解码器配对。

对于我们证明的解码保证和与 Prange 重新启动的有限长度比较，并且在我们测试的较大实例上，DQI 的预期质量超出了我们的经典求解器在固定预算内达到的质量。

title: A classical oracle separation between QMA and QMA(2)
abstract: We exhibit a classical oracle relative to which QMA \neq QMA(2). The separation is based on a separable Hamiltonian problem defined by signed edge constraints on a graph. The YES instances have zero-energy product states, while the NO instances, constructed using the antisymmetric subspace, have entangled zero-energy states but no low-energy product states. For the QMA lower bound, we use compressed-oracle techniques to track the information learned by a quantum computation making few queries to a YES instance. The key step is to map the resulting superpositions of partial oracle records to the NO family without significantly changing the verifier's behavior.
summary: 我们展示了一个相对于 QMA \neq QMA(2) 的经典预言。该分离基于由图上的有符号边约束定义的可分离哈密顿问题。 YES 实例具有零能积态，而使用反对称子空间构造的 NO 实例具有纠缠零能态，但没有低能积态。对于 QMA 下限，我们使用压缩预言技术来跟踪通过量子计算学到的信息，对 YES 实例进行很少的查询。关键步骤是将部分预言记录的叠加结果映射到 NO 系列，而不显着改变验证者的行为。

title: Hypercontractivity and entropy decay for infinite-dimensional quantum Gibbs samplers
abstract: We derive rates of exponential relative-entropy decay for a broad class of infinite-dimensional quantum Gibbs samplers. A key technical ingredient is a perturbative stability theory for hypercontractive estimates and logarithmic Sobolev inequalities. For suitably chosen dissipative couplings, we obtain exponential entropy decay for full multimode Bose-Hubbard samplers with arbitrary hopping and repulsive density interactions. For harmonically confined quantum Coulomb gases and molecular systems, we prove exponential entropy decay for every fixed finite-rank low-energy truncation of the interaction. Finally, we exhibit a periodic charging model with a positive spectral gap but no finite-time $L^2$-to-$L^p$ bound for any $p>2$.
summary: 我们推导出一大类无限维量子吉布斯采样器的指数相对熵衰减率。一个关键的技术要素是超收缩估计和对数索博列夫不等式的微扰稳定性理论。对于适当选择的耗散耦合，我们获得了具有任意跳跃和排斥密度相互作用的全多模 Bose-Hubbard 采样器的指数熵衰减。对于调和限制的量子库仑气体和分子系统，我们证明了相互作用的每个固定有限秩低能截断的指数熵衰减。最后，我们展示了一个具有正谱间隙的周期性充电模型，但对于任何 $p>2$ 没有有限时间 $L^2$-to-$L^p$ 限制。

title: Complexity separations for optimal matchgate-Clifford synthesis
abstract: Clifford and matchgate circuits are canonical families of classically simulable quantum circuits. Their intersection, the matchgate-Clifford group, plays an important role in randomized fermionic protocols and in matchgate synthesis. Its adjoint action is isomorphic to the group of unit-determinant signed permutations of $2n$ Majorana modes, and we study optimal exact synthesis in this group. That is, given a target unitary and a gate set, output an $n$-qubit circuit implementing the target using the fewest operations. We show that the complexity of this problem strongly depends on the gate set. In particular, we study gate sets consisting of Majorana braids with different connectivity graphs. For path and complete graphs, we prove that the problem is classically solvable in $\mathcal{O}\left(n^2\right)$ time, and we provide explicit gate-optimal compilers. In addition, we prove that when the connectivity graph is a tree, the decision version of the optimal synthesis problem becomes NP-complete. Finally, we benchmark our optimal compiler on chains of up to $n=80$ qubits against those of \texttt{Qiskit} and \texttt{Tket}, obtaining circuits with constant factor improvements $\times2.57$ and $\times2.28$ in the total number of gates, respectively.
summary:
Clifford 和 matchgate 电路是经典可模拟量子电路的典型系列。它们的交集，即匹配门-克利福德群，在随机费米子协议和匹配门合成中发挥着重要作用。它的伴随作用与 $2n$ 马约拉纳模式的单位行列式有符号排列组同构，我们研究了该组中的最佳精确合成。也就是说，给定目标酉和门集，输出使用最少操作实现目标的$n$量子位电路。我们表明这个问题的复杂性很大程度上取决于门的设置。特别是，我们研究了由具有不同连接图的马约拉纳辫子组成的门集。对于路径图和完整图，我们证明该问题通常可以在 $\mathcal{O}\left(n^2\right)$ 时间内解决，并且我们提供显式的门最优编译器。此外，我们证明当连通图是树时，最优综合问题的决策版本变为NP完全问题。

最后，我们在最多 $n=80$ 量子位的链上对我们的最佳编译器与 \texttt{Qiskit} 和 \texttt{Tket} 的链进行基准测试，获得门总数分别具有常数因子改进 $\times2.57$ 和 $\times2.28$ 的电路。

title: Fast convergence of propagation algorithms for open quantum systems
abstract: We establish general conditions for the rapid convergence of propagation algorithms for computing expectation values of local observables in quantum many-body systems, covering both spin and fermionic systems. Our results apply to evolutions that are sufficiently contractive, providing a general mechanism by which contractivity controls the growth generated by local interactions and enables efficient classical simulation. As a first application, we consider noisy time evolution generated by local Hamiltonians on arbitrary interaction graphs. We show that the dynamics can be efficiently simulated when the noise strength $\lambda$ is sufficiently large compared to the degree of the interaction graph. More generally, for systems with an interaction strength $u$, our bounds determine a time horizon $t_{\text{max}}$ as a function of the interaction strength $u$, the noise strength $\lambda$, and the interaction structure below which the algorithm is efficient. In the noiseless limit, $\lambda=0$, our analysis extends the efficiently simulable time scale from $\log(1/u)$ proved in Facelli, Fawzi, and Fawzi (2026) to $t_{\text{max}} \sim 1/u$ matching the recent improvement by Zhao, Marvian and Tong (2026). As a second application, we apply the same framework to the computation of local observables in Gibbs states of local Hamiltonians. We consider a pseudo-Lindbladian whose steady state is the Gibbs state and show that, at sufficiently high temperature, its propagation algorithm converges rapidly. In particular, for weakly-interacting systems with interaction strength $u$, our result applies up to inverse temperatures $\beta\sim\log(1/u)$.
summary:
我们建立了传播算法快速收敛的一般条件，用于计算量子多体系统中局部可观测量的期望值，涵盖自旋和费米子系统。我们的结果适用于足够收缩的演化，提供了一种通用机制，通过该机制收缩性可以控制局部相互作用产生的增长，并实现有效的经典模拟。作为第一个应用，我们考虑由局部哈密顿量在任意交互图上生成的噪声时间演化。我们表明，当噪声强度 $\lambda$ 与交互图的程度相比足够大时，可以有效地模拟动力学。更一般地，对于交互强度为 $u$ 的系统，我们的边界确定时间范围 $t_{\text{max}}$ 作为交互强度 $u$、噪声强度 $\lambda$ 和交互结构的函数，低于该范围算法是有效的。

在无噪声极限 $\lambda=0$ 下，我们的分析将有效可模拟时间尺度从 Facelli、Fawzi 和 Fawzi (2026) 证明的 $\log(1/u)$ 扩展到 $t_{\text{max}} \sim 1/u$，与Zhao、Marvian 和 Tong (2026) 最近的改进相匹配。作为第二个应用，我们应用相同的框架来计算局部哈密顿量的吉布斯状态中的局部可观测量。我们考虑一个稳态为吉布斯态的伪 Lindbladian，并表明，在足够高的温度下，其传播算法快速收敛。特别是，对于相互作用强度为 $u$ 的弱相互作用系统，我们的结果适用于反温度 $\beta\sim\log(1/u)$。

title: Engineering logical gates with irrep surface codes
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation typically relies on a fixed set of logical primitives, while realizing other desired operations can require substantial resources. We introduce irrep surface codes (ISCs), two-dimensional topological quantum error-correcting codes engineered to transversally implement a prescribed set of logical gates. The engineered gates only need to satisfy two conditions: (i) they generate a finite group, which, up to global phases, is forced by the Eastin-Knill theorem, and (ii) they are irreducible, meaning that any operator commuting with the set of gates must be proportional to the identity. This accommodates arbitrary finite groups of diagonal gates and arbitrary reversible classical gates, since each can be embedded into a larger irreducible finite group of gates. It also enables logical gates outside every finite level of the Clifford hierarchy. To incorporate these operations into surface-code computations, we further develop lattice-surgery protocols to transfer the encoded information between surface codes and ISCs obeying either of two sufficient conditions. Together, these results establish a systematic method for tailoring topological codes to desired logical operations and integrating them into conventional computations.
summary:
容错量子计算通常依赖于一组固定的逻辑原语，而实现其他所需的操作可能需要大量资源。我们引入了 irrep 表面码（ISC），这是一种二维拓扑量子纠错码，旨在横向实现一组规定的逻辑门。设计的门只需要满足两个条件：（i）它们生成一个有限群，直到全局阶段，该群都是由 Eastin-Knill 定理强制的；（ii）它们是不可约的，这意味着任何与门集交换的算子必须与身份成比例。这容纳了任意有限对角门组和任意可逆经典门，因为每个门都可以嵌入到更大的不可约有限门组中。它还在 Clifford 层次结构的每个有限级别之外启用逻辑门。为了将这些操作合并到表面代码计算中，我们进一步开发了晶格手术协议，以在满足两个充分条件之一的情况下在表面代码和 ISC 之间传输编码信息。

这些结果共同建立了一种系统方法，用于根据所需的逻辑运算定制拓扑代码并将其集成到传统计算中。

title: Informed Trading model with quantum walks
abstract: The seminal Kyle model offers a framework to understand the price impact of an informed trader in a market model for a single asset. We study variants in which the asset's future value is modeled by a classical random walk and by a continuous-time quantum walk, respectively. With these assumptions, we analytically approximate and numerically identify the market equilibrium between risk-neutral market maker and informed trader. In the classical equilibrium, the informed trader possesses a linear strategy, whereas the market maker's pricing rule resembles a logistic curve. The informed trader's profit is also identified to grow sub-linearly with time t. In the quantum equilibrium, the informed trader's strategy forms multiple clusters and the pricing rule exhibits multiple jumps correspondingly. Despite the increasing non-linearity of the equilibrium, the informed trader's profit grows linearly with time t.
summary: 开创性的凯尔模型提供了一个框架，用于了解知情交易者在单一资产市场模型中的价格影响。我们研究了资产未来价值分别通过经典随机游走和连续时间量子游走建模的变体。有了这些假设，我们就可以分析近似并以数字方式确定风险中性做市商和知情交易者之间的市场均衡。在经典均衡中，知情交易者拥有线性策略，而做市商的定价规则类似于逻辑曲线。知情交易者的利润也被确定为随着时间 t 呈次线性增长。在量子均衡中，知情交易者的策略形成多个簇，定价规则相应地呈现多次跳跃。尽管均衡的非线性程度不断增加，知情交易者的利润仍随时间 t 线性增长。

title: Computational entanglement distillation beyond pure states: efficient protocols and fundamental limitations
abstract: The information-theoretic approach to entanglement typically relies on arbitrarily many input copies and unboundedly complex operations; however, the available resources are constrained in reality. This motivates the study of entanglement theory with limited resources. One of its central questions is which quantities characterize entanglement manipulations, and so far, only the idealized case of pure states has been well explored. In this work, we address entanglement distillation from mixed states and identify the Rényi coherent information as the quantity determining the optimal rate in the worst case under two distinct resource constraints. We first characterize the sample-efficient regime, in which unbounded computational power is allowed. Our universal protocol achieves this rate without knowledge of the input state under certain polynomial rank constraints. This rate is optimal among universal protocols: we construct states whose distillable entanglement is nearly extensive, yet from which no universal sample-efficient protocol attains a rate above their Rényi coherent information. We then push this characterization to the computationally efficient frontier: the same bound holds for any efficient protocol even when the input state is known, and another universal protocol achieves this rate efficiently under additional polynomial constraints on the marginal ranks. Overall, our results give the Rényi coherent information a novel operational meaning in two computational settings: universal distillation with limited copies and efficient distillation even with knowledge of the input state.
summary:
纠缠的信息论方法通常依赖于任意多个输入副本和无限复杂的操作；然而，可用资源实际上是有限的。这激发了在资源有限的情况下对纠缠理论的研究。其核心问题之一是哪些量表征了纠缠操纵，到目前为止，只有纯态的理想化情况得到了很好的探索。在这项工作中，我们解决了混合态的纠缠蒸馏问题，并将 Rényi 相干信息确定为确定两种不同资源约束下最坏情况下最佳速率的量。我们首先描述样本有效机制，其中允许无限的计算能力。我们的通用协议在某些多项式秩约束下无需了解输入状态即可实现此速率。这个速率在通用协议中是最优的：我们构建了可蒸馏纠缠几乎广泛的状态，但没有通用样本有效协议能够达到高于其 Rényi 相干信息的速率。

然后，我们将这种表征推向计算有效的前沿：即使输入状态已知，任何有效协议的界限都成立，而另一个通用协议在边缘等级上的附加多项式约束下有效地实现了该速率。总的来说，我们的结果在两种计算设置中为 Rényi 相干信息赋予了新颖的操作意义：具有有限副本的通用蒸馏和即使知道输入状态的高效蒸馏。

title: Characterizing Quantum Advantage for Generalizations of the Boolean Hidden Matching Problem
abstract: We study the one-way communication complexity of the $f$-Boolean Hidden Partition problem. Here, Alice is given an $n$-bit string and Bob is given $\Omega(n)$ disjoint blocks of its indices together with a string of labels. Under the promise that the evaluations of $f$ on these blocks either agree with all of the labels or disagree with all of them, Bob must determine which is the case using a single message from Alice. This problem generalizes the Boolean Hidden Matching and Hidden Hypermatching problems, which capture the special case where $f$ is the parity function. We establish classical and quantum communication bounds for $f$-Boolean Hidden Partition in terms of the sign degree $d$ of $f$, proving a conjecture of Doriguello and Montanaro (TQC 2020). Their prior work gave logarithmic communication upper bounds for classical protocols when $d \le 1$ and quantum protocols when $d \le 2$, as well as polynomial lower bounds for certain structured functions with larger sign degree. We show that for every $f$ of sign degree $d \ge 2$, the randomized classical communication complexity of this problem is $\Theta(n^{1-1/d})$ while its quantum communication complexity lies between $\Omega(n^{1-2/d})$ and $\bO{n^{1-1/\lceil d/2 \rceil} \log n}$. This completely characterizes the functions $f$ admitting polynomial quantum advantage as those for which $d \ge 2$, with a new infinite family of exponential separations given by the case $d = 2$.
summary:
我们研究 $f$-布尔隐藏分区问题的单向通信复杂性。在这里，Alice 被给予 $n$ 位字符串，Bob 被给予 $\Omega(n)$ 不相交的索引块以及标签字符串。在保证这些区块上的 $f$ 评估要么与所有标签一致，要么与所有标签不一致的情况下，Bob 必须使用来自 Alice 的一条消息来确定是哪种情况。该问题概括了布尔隐藏匹配和隐藏超匹配问题，捕获了 $f$ 是奇偶校验函数的特殊情况。我们根据 $f$ 的符号度 $d$ 建立 $f$-布尔隐藏分区的经典和量子通信界限，证明了 Doriguello 和 Montanaro 的猜想 (TQC 2020)。他们之前的工作给出了 $d \le 1$ 时经典协议的对数通信上限和 $d \le 2$ 时的量子协议，以及具有较大符号度的某些结构化函数的多项式下界。

我们证明，对于符号度为 $d \ge 2$ 的每个 $f$，该问题的随机经典通信复杂度为 $\Theta(n^{1-1/d})$，而其量子通信复杂度介于 $\Omega(n^{1-2/d})$ 和 $\bO{n^{1-1/\lceil d/2 \rceil} \log n}$ 之间。这完全将承认多项式量子优势的函数 $f$ 描述为 $d \ge 2$ 的函数，并具有由 $d = 2$ 情况给出的新的无限指数分离族。

title: Local universality of non-local quantum resources in rotationally invariant scattering
abstract: Elastic scattering can generate entanglement and non-local magic between the spins of the two outgoing particles. The amount of entanglement and magic produced is encoded in the S-matrix; a unitary quantum gate that acts on the joint Hilbert space of the two spin-J particles. Previous work derived the entanglement power in terms of the scattering phase shifts for rotationally invariant S-matrices with J=1/2,1,3/2. In this paper, a closed form solution is derived for all J. We further prove that a broad class of non-local quantum resources depend to leading order only on the squared projective Hilbert-Schmidt distance from the nearest non-entangling gate. This holds for the entanglement power and non-local magic power, and the choice of resource simply changes the overall normalization. This universality establishes a common geometric origin for the leading resource-generating capacity of scattering, independent of the details of the interaction.
summary: 弹性散射可以在两个出射粒子的自旋之间产生纠缠和非局部魔法。产生的纠缠和魔力的量被编码在 S 矩阵中；作用于两个自旋 J 粒子的联合希尔伯特空间的酉量子门。先前的工作根据 J=1/2,1,3/2 的旋转不变 S 矩阵的散射相移导出了纠缠功率。在本文中，为所有 J 导出了一个封闭形式的解。我们进一步证明，一大类非局域量子资源仅依赖于距最近非纠缠门的投影希尔伯特-施密特距离的平方。这对于纠缠力和非局部魔法力来说是成立的，而资源的选择只是改变了整体的常态化。这种普遍性为主要的分散资源生成能力建立了一个共同的几何原点，与相互作用的细节无关。

title: Error Mitigation From a Single Unmodified Error-Corrected Circuit
abstract: Recent work has shown that syndrome information obtained during error-corrected quantum computation can be utilized for logical error mitigation (LEM), yielding exponential reductions in runtime overhead compared to external'' LEM methods, which do not make use of syndrome data. However, these syndrome-aware LEM methods (SALEM) generally require adaptive circuit operations based on real-time processing of syndromes. Here, we introduce syndrome-based offline logical error mitigation (SOLEM), a framework that utilizes syndrome data entirely in post-processing, without any modification to the given error-corrected circuit. In this sense, SOLEM is built into'' error-corrected circuits, and is in fact simpler to implement than external LEM protocols. The basic idea of SOLEM is to use naturally occurring syndrome-conditioned logical error channels in place of deliberate circuit modifications. We develop unbiased and heuristic estimators within this framework, including offline logical versions of probabilistic error cancellation (PEC) and zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE), as well as a global-regression estimator. SOLEM's fully offline nature leads to three significant advantages. First, SOLEM can post-process syndromes with a more powerful decoder than the one used in real time. Second, multiple estimators can be constructed from the same measured data and optimized using empirical statistical errors and related performance metrics. Third, logical error characterization is needed only in post-processing, allowing characterization data to be collected during circuit execution and reducing sensitivity to hardware drift. Remarkably, SOLEM estimators can achieve these advantages while attaining a runtime overhead which is exponentially lower than that of external LEM and is comparable to that of corresponding SALEM estimators.
summary:
最近的工作表明，在纠错量子计算过程中获得的校正子信息可用于逻辑错误缓解 (LEM)，与不使用校正子数据的外部 LEM 方法相比，运行时开销呈指数级减少。然而，这些症状感知 LEM 方法（SALEM）通常需要基于症状实时处理的自适应电路操作。在这里，我们介绍基于综合症的离线逻辑错误缓解（SOLEM），这是一个在后处理中完全利用综合症数据的框架，无需对给定的纠错电路进行任何修改。从这个意义上说，SOLEM 内置于纠错电路中，并且实际上比外部 LEM 协议更容易实现。 SOLEM 的基本思想是使用自然发生的综合症条件逻辑错误通道来代替故意的电路修改。我们在此框架内开发无偏和启发式估计器，包括概率误差消除（PEC）和零噪声外推（ZNE）的离线逻辑版本，以及全局回归估计器。 SOLEM 的完全离线特性带来了三个显着的优势。

首先，SOLEM 可以使用比实时使用的解码器更强大的解码器对综合症进行后处理。其次，可以根据相同的测量数据构建多个估计器，并使用经验统计误差和相关性能指标进行优化。第三，仅在后处理中需要逻辑错误表征，从而允许在电路执行期间收集表征数据并降低对硬件漂移的敏感性。值得注意的是，SOLEM 估计器可以实现这些优点，同时获得比外部 LEM 指数低的运行时开销，并且与相应的 SALEM 估计器相当。

title: Testing bosonic and fermionic Gaussian states with a constant number of copies
abstract: Bosonic and fermionic Gaussian quantum states are families of quantum states that play a central role in quantum physics and quantum information processing. We study the problem of testing whether a given state is either Gaussian, or has bounded overlap with any Gaussian state. Previous analyses of this testing problem led to tests that require a number of copies of the state that scales with the number of modes (the system size). In this work we show that a constant number of copies of the state suffices. We derive these results based on the symmetries of identical copies of Gaussian states, and by bounding the distance to the set of Gaussian states through a gradient flow and a spectral bound studied previously for the Kac random walk on a sphere.
summary: 玻色子和费米子高斯量子态是量子态家族，在量子物理和量子信息处理中发挥着核心作用。我们研究测试给定状态是否为高斯状态或与任何高斯状态有界重叠的问题。之前对该测试问题的分析导致测试需要多个状态副本，这些副本随模式数量（系统大小）而扩展。在这项工作中，我们证明了状态的副本数量恒定就足够了。我们基于高斯状态的相同副本的对称性，并通过梯度流和先前针对球体上的 Kac 随机游走研究的谱界限来限制与高斯状态集的距离，从而得出这些结果。

title: From Quantum Tunneling to Classical Optimization through Instantons
abstract: We use an instanton-based analysis to show that Path Integral Stochastic Gradient Descent (PISGD), a classical optimization algorithm instantiated from path integral Monte Carlo (PIMC), can inherit the quantum tunneling mechanism. Quantum tunneling is the phenomenon in which a quantum particle passes through a potential barrier that a classical trajectory cannot cross in the same way. This mechanism can contribute to the performance of quantum optimization algorithms, since a common bottleneck in optimization is that the solution becomes trapped in a local minimum, separated from better solutions by a potential barrier. Classical noise-driven optimizers, such as stochastic gradient descent (SGD), have escape times that scale exponentially with the potential barrier height. For quantum tunneling, the escape time is instead exponential in the bounce action, which equals twice the Agmon distance between the two basins. When the barrier is tall but thin, quantum tunneling can allow escaping local minima faster than such classical methods. Remarkably, this scaling is not exclusive to algorithms with genuine quantum dynamics. For PISGD applied to classical nonconvex global optimization, we adapt Kramers' escape-rate theory to path space and obtain the same exponential scaling as quantum tunneling, in terms of the bounce action rather than the barrier height. We confirm this scaling numerically by implementing PISGD for both separable and nonseparable potentials. That said, PISGD retains only incoherent tunneling, since coherence among multiple tunneling paths is absent. Our analysis therefore does not rule out a potential quantum advantage for quantum-tunneling-based algorithms over classical ones in general.
summary:
我们使用基于瞬子的分析来证明路径积分随机梯度下降（PISGD）是一种从路径积分蒙特卡罗（PIMC）实例化的经典优化算法，可以继承量子隧道机制。量子隧道效应是一种量子粒子穿过经典轨迹无法以同样方式穿过的势垒的现象。这种机制可以提高量子优化算法的性能，因为优化中的一个常见瓶颈是解决方案陷入局部最小值，并通过势垒与更好的解决方案分开。经典的噪声驱动优化器，例如随机梯度下降 (SGD)，其逃逸时间随势垒高度呈指数级增长。对于量子隧道，逃逸时间在弹跳动作中呈指数变化，等于两个盆地之间阿格蒙距离的两倍。当势垒又高又薄时，量子隧道效应可以比此类经典方法更快地逃离局部极小值。值得注意的是，这种缩放并不是具有真正量子动力学的算法所独有的。

对于应用于经典非凸全局优化的 PISGD，我们将 Kramers 的逃逸率理论应用于路径空间，并根据弹跳作用而不是势垒高度获得与量子隧道相同的指数缩放。我们通过对可分离和不可分离势实施 PISGD 在数值上确认了这种缩放。也就是说，PISGD 仅保留不相干的隧道，因为多个隧道路径之间不存在一致性。因此，我们的分析并不排除基于量子隧道的算法相对于一般经典算法具有潜在的量子优势。

title: Bell nonlocality does not imply violation of nonlocal games
abstract: Nonlocal games offer a conceptually clear way to reason about Bell nonlocality. However, we show that as originally defined, and most commonly used, i.e. with a deterministic predicate, they cannot be complete witnesses of nonlocality. Concretely, we prove the existence of nonlocal behaviours which do not violate any such nonlocal game. Furthermore, we also show that quantum mechanics can produce these game-classical nonlocal behaviours. We prove that this phenomenon exists in every bipartite scenario $(X,Y,A,B)$ with $X,Y\geq2$ and $A,B\geq4$.
summary: 非局域博弈提供了一种概念上清晰的方法来推理贝尔非局域性。然而，我们表明，正如最初定义的和最常用的，即具有确定性谓词，它们不能是非定域性的完整见证。具体来说，我们证明了不违反任何此类非局部博弈的非局部行为的存在。此外，我们还表明量子力学可以产生这些游戏经典的非局域行为。我们证明这种现象存在于每个二分场景 $(X,Y,A,B)$ 中，其中 $X,Y\geq2$ 和 $A,B\geq4$。

title: Polynomial-time classical algorithms for mean-field models up to the glass transition
abstract: The Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model is a strongly interacting fermionic system that has been well-studied in condensed matter and high energy physics. It is highly quantum: Gaussian states are far from the thermal state (Hastings and O'Donnell, STOC'22) and representing the thermal state requires large polynomial-size quantum circuits (Anschuetz et al., QIP'25). Very recently, it was nonetheless proven that classical algorithms can estimate local thermal expectations at sufficiently high temperature in quasipolynomial time (Zlokapa, FOCS'26). We show that classical algorithms can in fact estimate local observables at all constant temperatures in polynomial time. Our techniques also extend straightforwardly to classical systems: we resolve an open question about computing thermal expectations of a classical spin glass up to its phase transition (Bencs et al., STOC'26). Our proof develops a fully rigorous quantum cavity method. Due to the success of the classical cavity method in optimization, sampling, inference and learning, we expect the quantum cavity method to find further applications of independent interest. As an example, we give a quantum algorithm that learns SYK Hamiltonians from the Gibbs state at any constant temperature with polynomial time and sample complexity.
summary:
Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型是一个强相互作用的费米子系统，在凝聚态物质和高能物理领域已得到充分研究。它是高度量子化的：高斯态远离热态（Hastings 和 O'Donnell，STOC'22）并且表示热态需要大型多项式大小的量子电路（Anschuetz 等人，QIP'25）。最近，仍然证明经典算法可以在准多项式时间内估计足够高的温度下的局部热预期（Zlokapa，FOCS'26）。我们证明经典算法实际上可以在多项式时间内估计所有恒定温度下的局部可观测量。我们的技术也可以直接扩展到经典系统：我们解决了一个关于计算经典自旋玻璃直到其相变的热预期的悬而未决的问题（Bencs 等人，STOC'26）。我们的证明开发了一种完全严格的量子腔方法。由于经典腔方法在优化、采样、推理和学习方面的成功，我们期望量子腔方法能够找到更多独立感兴趣的应用。

作为一个例子，我们给出了一种量子算法，可以在任意恒温下以多项式时间和样本复杂度从吉布斯态学习 SYK 哈密顿量。

title: Polynomial-time simulation of non-Clifford quantum error correction
abstract: We show that every intermediate state of a broad class of non-Clifford quantum error-correction circuits is a third-order phase-polynomial state, even under stochastic Pauli noise. The class includes magic state distillation and cultivation, code switching and gauge fixing, transversal non-Clifford gates with syndrome extraction, and injection of diagonal magic states. Third-order phase-polynomial states strictly generalize stabilizer states, and we prove that they are exactly the stabilizer states of the diagonal-Clifford-and-Pauli (DCP) stabilizer formalism that we introduce. We characterize these states and show that their representations can be updated in polynomial time. This yields an exact polynomial-time simulation algorithm for these circuits and, more broadly, a framework for reasoning about their internal states and about magic states in general. We provide an open-source implementation, \texttt{merlin}, and benchmark it against existing non-Clifford simulators on distillation, cultivation, and code switching circuits. The benchmarks demonstrate improved runtime and memory scaling as the number of logical outputs grows in Bravyi-Haah distillation, and simulation of a code switching circuit beyond the reach of all other tested simulators.
summary:
我们证明，即使在随机泡利噪声下，一大类非克利福德量子纠错电路的每个中间状态都是三阶相位多项式状态。该课程包括魔法状态蒸馏和培养、代码切换和规范固定、具有综合症提取的横向非克利福德门以及对角魔法状态的注入。三阶相位多项式态严格概括了稳定器态，并且证明它们正是我们引入的对角克利福德和泡利（DCP）稳定器形式主义的稳定器态。我们描述了这些状态的特征，并表明它们的表示可以在多项式时间内更新。这为这些电路产生了精确的多项式时间模拟算法，更广泛地说，产生了一个用于推理其内部状态和一般魔法状态的框架。我们提供了一个开源实现 \texttt{merlin}，并将其与现有的非 Clifford 模拟器在蒸馏、培养和代码切换电路上进行基准测试。

基准测试表明，随着 Bravyi-Haah 蒸馏中逻辑输出数量的增加，运行时间和内存扩展得到了改善，并且代码切换电路的模拟超出了所有其他测试模拟器的范围。

title: Protecting Quantum Computers against Untrusted Users
abstract: Publicly accessible fault-tolerant quantum computers must preserve scientific utility while limiting cryptanalytic power. We propose the restricted model of computation, 1/2BQP_1: a quantum server provides random computational-basis inputs, revealed only after execution, and one designated output bit. This interface permits arbitrary circuits and system sizes. We conjecture that a classical client making polynomially many adaptive requests cannot efficiently factor RSA moduli. The model subsumes the well-known one-clean-qubit model DQC1, retaining its applications to infinite-temperature multi-time correlations, out-of-time-order correlators, and suitably normalized partition functions. We propose a candidate for separating 1/2BQP_1 from DQC1 based on testing classical predictions of quantum spin dynamics. We argue security in two steps. First, we show that one-bit readout makes the quantum stages of standard factoring algorithms classically simulable, even when their preparation and postprocessing are redesigned within a broad family around a single arithmetic-oracle call. This covers the quantum stages of Shor, Ekera-Hastad, Kitaev, and Regev factoring constructions. Second, we examine the workaround of coherently implementing rational reconstruction to release a factor bit. Random inputs obstruct this straightforward attack: known techniques accommodate logarithmic-depth classical circuits, but rational reconstruction has resisted such parallelization for decades. Therefore, we show that security of our protocol is built on not only classical hardness for factoring, but also conjectured circuit lowerbounds for rational reconstruction.
summary:
公开可用的容错量子计算机必须在限制密码分析能力的同时保留科学实用性。我们提出计算的受限模型，1/2BQP_1：量子服务器提供随机计算基础输入，仅在执行后显示，以及一个指定的输出位。该接口允许任意电路和系统尺寸。我们推测，发出多项式多项式自适应请求的经典客户端无法有效分解 RSA 模数。该模型包含了著名的单干净量子位模型 DQC1，保留了其在无限温度多时间相关性、乱序相关器和适当归一化配分函数方面的应用。我们基于测试量子自旋动力学的经典预测，提出了一种将 1/2BQP_1 与 DQC1 分离的候选方案。我们分两步讨论安全性。首先，我们表明，一位读出使得标准因式分解算法的量子阶段可以进行经典模拟，即使它们的准备和后处理是在围绕单个算术预言机调用的广泛系列中重新设计的。这涵盖了 Shor、Ekera-Hastad、Kitaev 和 Regev 因式分解结构的量子阶段。

其次，我们研究了连贯实施合理重构以释放因素位的解决方法。随机输入阻碍了这种直接的攻击：已知技术适应对数深度经典电路，但理性重构几十年来一直抵制这种并行化。因此，我们表明，我们协议的安全性不仅建立在因式分解的经典难度之上，而且还建立在理性重构的推测电路下界之上。

title: CV-QAOA: Efficient Low-Depth Quantum Optimization of Continuous Variables
abstract: We study a Continuous-Variable Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (CV-QAOA) for high-dimensional continuous optimization. Our formulation extends an earlier CV-QAOA proposal with a variationally optimized initial state and recovers the convergence guarantees of Quantum Hamiltonian Descent (QHD) in the high-depth limit. We prove rigorous performance guarantees of CV-QAOA on several families of cost functions. First, we show $d$-step CV-QAOA minimizes any $d$-dimensional strictly convex quadratic function with $2d$ quantum queries to the cost function. We then analyze a family of nonconvex "Rotated Double Well" (RDW) functions with $2^d$ local minima introduced by arXiv:2311.00811 . While prior work showed QHD reaches its global minimum with $\tilde O(d^3)$ queries, we prove that 1-step CV-QAOA solves RDW with just two quantum queries. Although general-purpose classical solvers need superpolynomial time for RDW and structure-awareness can reduce the cost to polynomial time, we show that the 1-step CV-QAOA protocol can be efficiently dequantized, and that a gradient-aligned line search succeeds with $O(d)$ queries, nearly matching the information-theoretic $\Omega(d/\log d)$ query lower bound. To move beyond the dequantizable regime, we introduce a ``Rotated Square Well'' (RSW) problem, whose globally flat landscape suppresses useful local gradient information. For this family, we show that an adiabatic evolution simulated by CV-QAOA can reach the global minimum using $d^{o(1)}$ queries. On the other hand, any classical algorithm that learn the hidden rotation in RSW provably requires $\Omega(d^2/\log d)$ queries, a bound we nearly match with an explicit $\Theta(d^2\log d)$-query classical this http URL simulations on deflected corrugated spring and Easom functions illustrate the promising performance of CV-QAOA on more general problems.
summary:
我们研究了用于高维连续优化的连续变量量子近似优化算法（CV-QAOA）。我们的公式通过变分优化的初始状态扩展了早期的 CV-QAOA 提案，并在高深度限制下恢复了量子哈密顿下降 (QHD) 的收敛保证。我们在几个成本函数族上证明了 CV-QAOA 的严格性能保证。首先，我们展示了 $d$ 步 CV-QAOA 通过对成本函数的 $2d$ 量子查询来最小化任何 $d$ 维严格凸二次函数。然后，我们分析了 arXiv:2311.00811 引入的具有 $2^d$ 局部最小值的一系列非凸“旋转双井”(RDW) 函数。虽然之前的工作表明 QHD 通过 $\tilde O(d^3)$ 查询达到其全局最小值，但我们证明了 1 步 CV-QAOA 只需两个量子查询即可解决 RDW。
